Sandbox_NumbTrait_B42_V2_RemoveSmoker_to.cn: 解锁麻木特质时移除嗜烟如命特质.

Sandbox_NumbTrait_B42_V2_SuppressSmokerS.en: When enabled, nicotine withdrawal stress is suppressed while a stress-capping progression trait (Hardened or higher) is active. When disabled, Smoker stress accumulates freely on top of all stat caps.
Sandbox_NumbTrait_B42_V2_SuppressSmokerS.ch: 啟用後, 當壓力上限類的進階特質 (鐵石心腸或更高階) 生效時, 尼古丁戒斷所產生的壓力會被抑制. 停用後, 菸癮壓力會無視所有數值上限持續累積.
Sandbox_NumbTrait_B42_V2_SuppressSmokerS.cn: 启用后, 当压力上限类的进阶特质 (铁石心肠或更高阶) 生效时, 尼古丁戒断所产生的压力会被抑制. 禁用后, 烟瘾压力会无视所有数值上限持续累积.

Sandbox_Bicycle_LoadPenaltyEnabled_toolt.en: When enabled, attaching containers makes the bike harder to turn and heavy cargo slows it down. Disable for vanilla bike handling regardless of load.
Sandbox_Bicycle_LoadPenaltyEnabled_toolt.ch: 啟用後, 掛上容器會讓腳踏車更難轉向, 沉重的貨物也會拖慢速度. 停用則不論負載都維持原版腳踏車操控.
Sandbox_Bicycle_LoadPenaltyEnabled_toolt.cn: 启用后, 挂上容器会让自行车更难转向, 沉重的货物也会拖慢速度. 禁用则不论负载都保持原版自行车操控.

Sandbox_Bicycle_MaxSpeedPenalty_tooltip.en: Maximum reduction in bike speed at 20kg of cargo inside containers. Heavy cargo slows both pedal speeds proportionally; fast pedal stays faster than slow. 0 = no speed penalty.
Sandbox_Bicycle_MaxSpeedPenalty_tooltip.ch: 容器內貨物達 20 公斤時的最大速度降幅. 沉重貨物會等比拖慢快慢兩種踩踏速度; 快速踩踏仍會比慢速快. 0 = 無速度懲罰.
Sandbox_Bicycle_MaxSpeedPenalty_tooltip.cn: 容器内货物达 20 公斤时的最大速度降幅. 沉重货物会等比拖慢快慢两种踩踏速度; 快速踩踏仍会比慢速快. 0 = 无速度惩罚.

Sandbox_Bicycle_MaxTurnPenalty_tooltip.en: Maximum reduction in turn rate when all 6 containers are attached. 0 = no turning penalty. Capped at 75% to keep the bike usable.
Sandbox_Bicycle_MaxTurnPenalty_tooltip.ch: 掛滿 6 個容器時的最大轉向速率降幅. 0 = 無轉向懲罰. 上限為 75%%, 以確保腳踏車仍能使用.
Sandbox_Bicycle_MaxTurnPenalty_tooltip.cn: 挂满 6 个容器时的最大转向速率降幅. 0 = 无转向惩罚. 上限为 75%%, 以确保自行车仍能使用.

Sandbox_Bicycle_SidecarSpawnRate_tooltip.en: Percent-based multiplier applied to sidecar spawn chances - both for sidecars found loose in garages, storage units, and sheds, and for sidecars rarely pre-attached to a newly spawned bicycle. Set to 0 to disable sidecar spawns entirely.
Sandbox_Bicycle_SidecarSpawnRate_tooltip.ch: 基於百分比的倍率, 用於調整側車的生成機率 - 包含在車庫, 倉儲間和棚屋中散落找到的側車, 以及極少數新生成腳踏車上預先掛好的側車. 設 0 可完全停用側車生成.
Sandbox_Bicycle_SidecarSpawnRate_tooltip.cn: 基于百分比的倍率, 用于调整边车的生成概率 - 包含在车库, 仓储间和棚屋中散落找到的边车, 以及极少数新生成自行车上预先挂好的边车. 设 0 可完全禁用边车生成.

Sandbox_Bicycle_ZombieContactSensitivity.en: How close a zombie must be to count as touching. Higher widens the contact range slightly so zombies count from a touch further out; 0 requires true body overlap.
Sandbox_Bicycle_ZombieContactSensitivity.ch: 殭屍要多近才算接觸到你. 數值越高會略微放寬接觸範圍, 讓稍遠的殭屍也算數; 0 表示必須真正身體重疊.
Sandbox_Bicycle_ZombieContactSensitivity.cn: 僵尸要多近才算接触到你. 数值越高会略微放宽接触范围, 让稍远的僵尸也算数; 0 表示必须真正身体重叠.

Sandbox_Bicycle_ZombieSlowdownEnabled_to.en: When riding, zombies that physically press against you slow the bike - a single bump bleeds off a little speed, and being surrounded slows you toward a near-stop. Sustained contact from a full surround also knocks you off the bike.
Sandbox_Bicycle_ZombieSlowdownEnabled_to.ch: 騎乘時, 實際擠壓到你的殭屍會拖慢腳踏車 - 單隻碰撞會削減一點速度, 被包圍則會慢到近乎停止. 完全被包圍且持續接觸還會把你撞下腳踏車.
Sandbox_Bicycle_ZombieSlowdownEnabled_to.cn: 骑行时, 实际挤压到你的僵尸会拖慢自行车 - 单只碰撞会削减一点速度, 被包围则会慢到近乎停止. 完全被包围且持续接触还会把你撞下自行车.

Sandbox_Bicycle_ZombieSlowdownStrength_t.en: Scales how hard contacting zombies slow you. 100 = default curve (1 zombie ~85% speed, 4+ near stop). Lower is gentler, higher is harsher. Does not affect the knock-off.
Sandbox_Bicycle_ZombieSlowdownStrength_t.ch: 調整接觸殭屍的減速力道. 100 = 預設曲線 (1 隻殭屍約 85%% 速度, 4 隻以上近乎停止). 數值越低越溫和, 越高越嚴苛. 不影響撞下車的判定.
Sandbox_Bicycle_ZombieSlowdownStrength_t.cn: 调整接触僵尸的减速力度. 100 = 默认曲线 (1 只僵尸约 85%% 速度, 4 只以上近乎停止). 数值越低越温和, 越高越严苛. 不影响撞下车的判定.

Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_ElectricitySh.en:
Sets the day range for a random permanent electricity shutoff.
Format: minimum day - maximum day
Examples: 0-30 = random day, 30-30 = fixed day.
Changes the vanilla 'Electricity Shutoff' day setting.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_ElectricitySh.ch:
設定隨機永久停電發生的日期範圍.
格式: 最小天數 - 最大天數
範例: 0-30 = 隨機日期, 30-30 = 固定日期.
此設定會變更原版的「停電時間」設定.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_ElectricitySh.cn:
设定随机永久停电发生的日期范围.
格式: 最小天数 - 最大天数
示例: 0-30 = 随机日期, 30-30 = 固定日期.
此设定会变更原版的“停电时间”设定.

Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_ElectricitySt.en: How many days before the scheduled electricity shutoff random outages will begin.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_ElectricitySt.ch: 在預定停電日的前幾天開始出現隨機停電.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_ElectricitySt.cn: 在预定停电日的前几天开始出现随机停电.

Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_IgnoreElectri.en: If enabled, random power outages will occur regardless of the 'Days Before Electricity Shutoff' setting.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_IgnoreElectri.ch: 如果啟用, 無論「停電前天數」設定為何, 都會發生隨機停電.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_IgnoreElectri.cn: 如果启用, 无论“停电前天数”如何设置, 都会发生随机停电.

Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_IgnoreWaterSt.en: If enabled, random water outages will occur regardless of the 'Days Before Water Shutoff' setting.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_IgnoreWaterSt.ch: 如果啟用, 無論「停水前天數」設定為何, 都會發生隨機停水.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_IgnoreWaterSt.cn: 如果启用, 无论“停水前天数”如何设置, 都会发生随机停水.

Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_Radio_tooltip.en:
Enables automatic emergency radio broadcasts from the Knox Emergency Regional Infrastructure Service on 89.2 MHz.
The radio will provide information about upcoming water and power outages, current infrastructure status, and other emergency events.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_Radio_tooltip.ch:
啟用諾克斯緊急區域基礎設施服務處在 89.2 MHz 上的自動緊急廣播.
該廣播會提供即將到來的停水停電, 目前基礎設施狀態以及其他緊急事件的資訊.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_Radio_tooltip.cn:
启用诺克斯紧急区域基础设施服务处在 89.2 MHz 上的自动紧急广播.
该广播会提供即将到来的停水停电, 当前基础设施状态以及其他紧急事件的信息.

Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_WaterShutoffD.en:
Sets the day range for a random permanent water shutoff.
Format: minimum day - maximum day
Examples: 0-30 = random day, 30-30 = fixed day.
Changes the vanilla 'Water Shutoff' day setting.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_WaterShutoffD.ch:
設定隨機永久停水發生的日期範圍.
格式: 最小天數 - 最大天數
範例: 0-30 = 隨機日期, 30-30 = 固定日期.
此設定會變更原版的「停水時間」設定.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_WaterShutoffD.cn:
设定随机永久停水发生的日期范围.
格式: 最小天数 - 最大天数
示例: 0-30 = 随机日期, 30-30 = 固定日期.
此设定会变更原版的“停水时间”设定.

Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_WaterStartDay.en: How many days before the scheduled water shutoff random outages will begin.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_WaterStartDay.ch: 在預定停水日的前幾天開始出現隨機停水.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_WaterStartDay.cn: 在预定停水日的前几天开始出现随机停水.

Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_AluminumFragments.en: Maximum aluminum fragments dropped when its chance succeeds.
Sandbox_DestroyBoulder_AluminumFragments.ch: 機率判定成功時掉落的鋁碎片最大數量.

Sandbox_XVirus_AdminSpawnOnly_tooltip.en: When enabled, the X-Virus will not spawn in loot anywhere. Only admins can spawn it via the item picker or /additem. Useful for servers that want the virus available but tightly controlled. Changes take effect after a server restart.
Sandbox_XVirus_AdminSpawnOnly_tooltip.ch: 啟用後, X病毒不會出現在任何戰利品中. 只有管理員能透過物品選擇器或 /additem 生成它. 適合想保留此病毒但嚴格控管的伺服器. 變更會在伺服器重新啟動後生效.
Sandbox_XVirus_AdminSpawnOnly_tooltip.cn: 启用后, X病毒不会出现在任何战利品中. 只有管理员能通过物品选择器或 /additem 生成它. 适合想保留此病毒但严格管控的服务器. 变更会在服务器重新启动后生效.

Sandbox_XVirus_AlreadyInfected_tooltip.en: What happens when a player uses the X-Virus while already infected. No Effect = virus is wasted. Grant Mutations = grants mutation traits without re-infecting.
Sandbox_XVirus_AlreadyInfected_tooltip.ch: 玩家在已感染狀態下使用 X病毒時的結果. 無效果 = 浪費一劑病毒. 授予突變 = 不重新感染, 僅授予突變特質.
Sandbox_XVirus_AlreadyInfected_tooltip.cn: 玩家在已感染状态下使用 X病毒时的结果. 无效果 = 浪费一剂病毒. 授予突变 = 不重新感染, 仅授予突变特质.

Sandbox_XVirus_TraitCorpses_tooltip.en: Grants immunity to stress from corpses on injection. Re-injecting with different settings updates the trait. Random = coin flip per player.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitCorpses_tooltip.ch: 注射後可免疫屍體造成的壓力. 以不同設定重新注射會更新該特質. 隨機 = 每位玩家各擲一次硬幣決定.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitCorpses_tooltip.cn: 注射后可免疫尸体造成的压力. 以不同设置重新注射会更新该特质. 随机 = 每位玩家各掷一次硬币决定.

Sandbox_XVirus_TraitDexterity_tooltip.en: Modifies item transfer speed on injection. Dextrous = 2x faster. All Thumbs = 2x slower. Random = picks one per player.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitDexterity_tooltip.ch: 注射後改變物品搬運速度. 眼疾手快 = 快 2 倍. 笨手笨腳 = 慢 2 倍. 隨機 = 每位玩家各挑一項.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitDexterity_tooltip.cn: 注射后改变物品搬运速度. 眼疾手快 = 快 2 倍. 笨手笨脚 = 慢 2 倍. 随机 = 每位玩家各挑一项.

Sandbox_XVirus_TraitFear_tooltip.en: Modifies fear response on injection. Brave = halved stress. Cowardly = doubled stress. Random = picks one per player.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitFear_tooltip.ch: 注射後改變恐懼反應. 無所畏懼 = 壓力減半. 畏首畏尾 = 壓力加倍. 隨機 = 每位玩家各挑一項.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitFear_tooltip.cn: 注射后改变恐惧反应. 无所畏惧 = 压力减半. 畏首畏尾 = 压力加倍. 随机 = 每位玩家各挑一项.

Sandbox_XVirus_TraitLearning_tooltip.en: Modifies research speed on injection. Fast = 30% faster. Slow = 30% slower. Random = picks one per player.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitLearning_tooltip.ch: 注射後改變研究速度. 快 = 加快 30%%. 慢 = 減慢 30%%. 隨機 = 每位玩家各挑一項.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitLearning_tooltip.cn: 注射后改变研究速度. 快 = 加快 30%%. 慢 = 减慢 30%%. 随机 = 每位玩家各挑一项.

Sandbox_XVirus_TraitReading_tooltip.en: Modifies reading speed on injection. Fast = 30% faster. Slow = 30% slower. Random = picks one per player.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitReading_tooltip.ch: 注射後改變閱讀速度. 快 = 加快 30%%. 慢 = 減慢 30%%. 隨機 = 每位玩家各挑一項.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitReading_tooltip.cn: 注射后改变阅读速度. 快 = 加快 30%%. 慢 = 减慢 30%%. 随机 = 每位玩家各挑一项.

Sandbox_XVirus_TraitVision_tooltip.en: Grants wider vision arc on injection. Re-injecting with different settings updates the trait. Random = coin flip per player.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitVision_tooltip.ch: 注射後獲得更寬的視野範圍. 以不同設定重新注射會更新該特質. 隨機 = 每位玩家各擲一次硬幣決定.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitVision_tooltip.cn: 注射后获得更宽的视野范围. 以不同设置重新注射会更新该特质. 随机 = 每位玩家各掷一次硬币决定.

Sandbox_XVirus_VirusRarity_tooltip.en: Controls how often the X-Virus spawns in loot. Common = 2x spawn rate, Uncommon = 1x, Rare = 0.4x (default), Very Rare = 0.15x. Changes take effect after a server restart. Ignored if Admin Spawn Only is enabled.
Sandbox_XVirus_VirusRarity_tooltip.ch: 控制 X病毒在戰利品中出現的頻率. 常見 = 2 倍生成率, 不常見 = 1 倍, 稀少 = 0.4 倍 (預設), 非常稀少 = 0.15 倍. 變更會在伺服器重新啟動後生效. 若已啟用僅限管理員生成, 則忽略此設定.
Sandbox_XVirus_VirusRarity_tooltip.cn: 控制 X病毒在战利品中出现的频率. 常见 = 2 倍生成率, 不常见 = 1 倍, 稀少 = 0.4 倍 (默认), 非常稀少 = 0.15 倍. 变更会在服务器重新启动后生效. 若已启用仅限管理员生成, 则忽略此设置.

Sandbox_ammomaker_CraftingSpeed_tooltip.en: Adjust crafting speed for all Ammo Maker recipes
Sandbox_ammomaker_CraftingSpeed_tooltip.ch: 調整彈藥製造系統所有配方的製作速度.
Sandbox_ammomaker_CraftingSpeed_tooltip.cn: 调整弹药制造系统所有配方的制作速度.

Sandbox_ZombieVirusVaccineBETA_AllowWind.ch: 允許從窗戶取得碎玻璃
Sandbox_ZombieVirusVaccineBETA_AllowWind.cn: 允许从窗户获得碎玻璃

Sandbox_ZombieVirusVaccineBETA_AllowWind.en: If enabled, each time a player remove glasses from a broken window, it will give a shattered glass material<LINE><LINE>Even if it's off, players still can pick up the shattered glass from the ground.
Sandbox_ZombieVirusVaccineBETA_AllowWind.ch: 若啟用, 玩家每次從破窗上清除碎玻璃時, 都會獲得碎玻璃材料<LINE><LINE>即使停用, 玩家仍可從地面撿拾碎玻璃.
Sandbox_ZombieVirusVaccineBETA_AllowWind.cn: 若启用, 玩家每次从破窗上清除碎玻璃时, 都会获得碎玻璃材料<LINE><LINE>即使禁用, 玩家仍可从地面捡拾碎玻璃.

Sandbox_ZombieVirusVaccineBETA_AutopsyMa.en: The maximum number of hours before a corpse is considered too decomposed for an autopsy.
Sandbox_ZombieVirusVaccineBETA_AutopsyMa.ch: 屍體被視為腐敗過度而無法屍檢前的最長小時數.
Sandbox_ZombieVirusVaccineBETA_AutopsyMa.cn: 尸体被视为腐败过度而无法尸检前的最长小时数.

Sandbox_ZombieVirusVaccineBETA_EnableWat.en: Enable water purification through heat (stoves, microwaves, etc). If disabled, water purification will only be possible by using chlorine tablets. <LINE><BHC>It might cause heavy CPU usage for multiplayer servers. If so, consider disabling this feature.
Sandbox_ZombieVirusVaccineBETA_EnableWat.ch: 啟用透過加熱 (爐具, 微波爐等) 淨化水的功能. 若停用, 則只能使用氯錠淨水. <LINE><BHC>此功能可能對多人遊戲伺服器造成大量 CPU 負擔. 若是如此, 請考慮停用此功能.
Sandbox_ZombieVirusVaccineBETA_EnableWat.cn: 启用通过加热 (炉具, 微波炉等) 净化水的功能. 若禁用, 则只能使用氯锭净水. <LINE><BHC>此功能可能对多人游戏服务器造成大量 CPU 负担. 若是如此, 请考虑禁用此功能.

Sandbox_ZombieVirusVaccineBETA_WaterPuri.en: The radius within which flasks with water in containers will be searched for purification. Ticks onEveryTenMinutes.
Sandbox_ZombieVirusVaccineBETA_WaterPuri.ch: 搜尋容器內裝水燒瓶以進行淨化的半徑範圍. 每十分鐘 (onEveryTenMinutes) 觸發一次.
Sandbox_ZombieVirusVaccineBETA_WaterPuri.cn: 搜索容器内装水烧瓶以进行净化的半径范围. 每十分钟 (onEveryTenMinutes) 触发一次.

Sandbox_StartingInjuriesMod_EnableBandag.en: Check to add adhesive bandages to starting inventory when taking certain challenge traits, reducing initial difficulty.
Sandbox_StartingInjuriesMod_EnableBandag.ch: 勾選後, 選取特定挑戰特質時會在初始物品欄中加入 OK 繃, 以降低初期難度.
Sandbox_StartingInjuriesMod_EnableBandag.cn: 勾选后, 选取特定挑战特质时会在初始物品栏中加入创可贴, 以降低初期难度.

Sandbox_StartingInjuriesMod_EnableBlacko.en: Check to enable the initial fires for the Blackout (CDDA) trait.
Sandbox_StartingInjuriesMod_EnableBlacko.ch: 勾選以啟用「斷片 (CDDA)」特質的初始火災.
Sandbox_StartingInjuriesMod_EnableBlacko.cn: 勾选以启用“断片 (CDDA)”特质的初始火灾.

Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionRespawnBas.en: How long respawned factions should strongly avoid recently abandoned homes in the same town.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionRespawnBas.ch: 重新生成的陣營應強烈迴避同一城鎮內近期被廢棄住所的天數.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionRespawnBas.cn: 重新生成的阵营应强烈回避同一城镇内近期被废弃住所的天数.

Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionRespawnBas.en: Small chance for a respawned faction to reclaim a recently abandoned base instead of taking a fresh one.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionRespawnBas.ch: 重新生成的陣營有小機率會接收近期廢棄的據點, 而非另尋新據點.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionRespawnBas.cn: 重新生成的阵营有小概率会接收近期废弃的据点, 而非另寻新据点.

Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionRespawnDel.en: Minimum in-game days before a wiped town can receive a replacement faction again.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionRespawnDel.ch: 被清空的城鎮再次獲得替補陣營前, 所需的最少遊戲內天數.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionRespawnDel.cn: 被清空的城镇再次获得替补阵营前, 所需的最少游戏内天数.

Sandbox_DynamicTrading.MaxFactionsPerCou.en: How much room a county has for long-term system-generated replacement factions after wipes and collapse.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.MaxFactionsPerCou.ch: 在清空與崩潰之後, 一個郡能容納多少由系統長期生成的替補陣營.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.MaxFactionsPerCou.cn: 在清空与崩溃之后, 一个郡能容纳多少由系统长期生成的替补阵营.

Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCDamageDealtMul.en: Scales damage dealt by DT NPC melee and ranged attacks without changing their max HP.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCDamageDealtMul.ch: 縮放動態交易NPC近戰與遠程攻擊所造成的傷害, 但不改變其最大生命值.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCDamageDealtMul.cn: 缩放动态交易NPC近战与远程攻击所造成的伤害, 但不改变其最大生命值.

Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCDamageTakenMul.en: Scales real damage applied to DT NPC virtual HP. Lower than 1.0 makes them tankier, higher than 1.0 makes them easier to kill.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCDamageTakenMul.ch: 縮放施加到動態交易NPC虛擬生命值上的實際傷害. 低於 1.0 會讓他們更耐打, 高於 1.0 則更容易被擊殺.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCDamageTakenMul.cn: 缩放施加到动态交易NPC虚拟生命值上的实际伤害. 低于 1.0 会让他们更耐打, 高于 1.0 则更容易被击杀.

Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCMeleeStaminaCo.en: Base stamina cost for each melee swing at skill level 0. Higher melee skill lowers this cost, down to about 10% at level 20.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCMeleeStaminaCo.ch: 技能等級 0 時每次近戰揮擊的基礎耐力消耗. 近戰技能越高消耗越低, 到 20 級時約降至 10%%.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCMeleeStaminaCo.cn: 技能等级 0 时每次近战挥击的基础耐力消耗. 近战技能越高消耗越低, 到 20 级时约降至 10%%.

Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCPlayerWounds_t.en: If enabled, DT NPC attacks can cause bleeding, cuts, scratches, and pain on players in addition to reducing overall health.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCPlayerWounds_t.ch: 啟用後, 動態交易NPC的攻擊除了扣減總體健康外, 還會讓玩家出血, 割傷, 抓傷並產生疼痛.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCPlayerWounds_t.cn: 启用后, 动态交易NPC的攻击除了扣减总体健康外, 还会让玩家出血, 割伤, 抓伤并产生疼痛.

Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCRangedStaminaC.en: Base stamina cost for each shot at skill level 0. Higher shooting skill lowers this cost, down to about 10% at level 20.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCRangedStaminaC.ch: 技能等級 0 時每次射擊的基礎耐力消耗. 射擊技能越高消耗越低, 到 20 級時約降至 10%%.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCRangedStaminaC.cn: 技能等级 0 时每次射击的基础耐力消耗. 射击技能越高消耗越低, 到 20 级时约降至 10%%.

Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCStaminaRegenMu.en: Scales how quickly NPCs recover stamina when resting or active. 1.0 is default, higher values recover faster.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCStaminaRegenMu.ch: 縮放NPC在休息或活動時回復耐力的速度. 1.0 為預設值, 數值越高回復越快.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCStaminaRegenMu.cn: 缩放NPC在休息或活动时恢复耐力的速度. 1.0 为默认值, 数值越高恢复越快.

Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCStaminaThresho.en: The stamina percentage (0.05 to 0.95) at which an exhausted NPC can resume normal activity. Default is 0.40 (40%).
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCStaminaThresho.ch: 力竭的NPC可以恢復正常活動的耐力百分比 (0.05 至 0.95). 預設為 0.40 (40%%).
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCStaminaThresho.cn: 力竭的NPC可以恢复正常活动的耐力百分比 (0.05 至 0.95). 默认为 0.40 (40%%).

Sandbox_DynamicTrading.ReviveCostMax_too.en: Maximum number of bandages or ripped sheets required to revive a non-hostile incapacitated NPC.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.ReviveCostMax_too.ch: 救活一名非敵對且失去行動能力的NPC所需的繃帶或碎布條最大數量.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.ReviveCostMax_too.cn: 救活一名非敌对且失去行动能力的NPC所需的绷带或碎布条最大数量.

Sandbox_DynamicTrading.ReviveCostMin_too.en: Minimum number of bandages or ripped sheets required to revive a non-hostile incapacitated NPC.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.ReviveCostMin_too.ch: 救活一名非敵對且失去行動能力的NPC所需的繃帶或碎布條最小數量.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.ReviveCostMin_too.cn: 救活一名非敌对且失去行动能力的NPC所需的绷带或碎布条最小数量.

Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_EnhancedRainEx.en: Rain now increases wetness progressively. Prolonged high wetness amplifies cold damage indirectly; rain does not cause direct illness.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_EnhancedRainEx.ch: 淋雨會逐漸提高潮濕度. 長時間維持高潮濕度會間接放大寒冷造成的傷害; 雨水本身不會直接致病.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_EnhancedRainEx.cn: 淋雨会逐渐提高潮湿度. 长时间维持高潮湿度会间接放大寒冷造成的伤害; 雨水本身不会直接致病.

Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_LightningAttra.en: If true, lightning strikes emit a strong world sound that attracts zombies like a global meta event. Default: off.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_LightningAttra.ch: 啟用時, 落雷會發出強烈的世界音效, 像全域事件一樣吸引殭屍. 預設: 停用.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_LightningAttra.cn: 启用时, 落雷会发出强烈的世界音效, 像全局事件一样吸引僵尸. 默认: 禁用.

Sandbox_rSemiTruck_GuaranteedMilitarySpa.en: If enabled, the fixed-coordinate W900 military vehicle spawns are created. If disabled, only normal zone-based military spawning remains active.
Sandbox_rSemiTruck_GuaranteedMilitarySpa.ch: 若啟用, 會建立固定座標的 W900 軍用車輛生成點. 若停用, 則僅保留一般的區域軍用生成.
Sandbox_rSemiTruck_GuaranteedMilitarySpa.cn: 若启用, 会创建固定坐标的 W900 军用车辆生成点. 若禁用, 则仅保留普通的区域军用生成.

Sandbox_rSemiTruck_MultiWreckerSlots_too.en:
Sets how many vehicles the MultiWrecker can carry at once.
Lowering this setting only blocks new loads into higher slots; already loaded vehicles can still be unloaded.
Sandbox_rSemiTruck_MultiWreckerSlots_too.ch:
設定運車拖車一次可載運的車輛數量.
調低此設定只會阻止新車裝入較高的槽位; 已裝載的車輛仍可卸下.
Sandbox_rSemiTruck_MultiWreckerSlots_too.cn:
设置运车拖车一次可载运的车辆数量.
调低此设置只会阻止新车装入较高的槽位; 已装载的车辆仍可卸下.

Sandbox_Printer3D_EnablePrintingFailures.en: Allows 3D printers to suffer jams, print failures, and extrusion errors.
Sandbox_Printer3D_EnablePrintingFailures.ch: 允許3D印表機發生堵塞, 列印失敗與擠出錯誤.
Sandbox_Printer3D_EnablePrintingFailures.cn: 允许3D打印机发生堵塞, 打印失败与挤出错误.

Sandbox_Printer3D_PrintingFailureMultipl.en: Adjusts the chance of failures during printing.
Sandbox_Printer3D_PrintingFailureMultipl.ch: 調整列印過程中發生失敗的機率.
Sandbox_Printer3D_PrintingFailureMultipl.cn: 调整打印过程中发生失败的几率.

Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_EnableGodRays_Too.en: When enabled, sun rays will be visually rendered on the screen during sunrise and sunset, depending on the sun's position.
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_EnableGodRays_Too.ch: 啟用後, 日出與日落期間會依據太陽位置在畫面上繪製陽光光束.
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_EnableGodRays_Too.cn: 启用后, 日出与日落期间会依据太阳位置在画面上绘制阳光光束.

Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_EnableStormMood_T.en: When enabled, storms can push a cinematic desaturation + darker ambient mood (with smooth fade).
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_EnableStormMood_T.ch: 啟用後, 暴風雨可帶來電影感的降低飽和度與更陰暗的環境氛圍 (含平滑淡入淡出).
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_EnableStormMood_T.cn: 启用后, 暴风雨可带来电影感的降低饱和度与更阴暗的环境氛围 (含平滑淡入淡出).

Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_StormMoodPreset.ch: 暴風雨氛圍去飽和預設
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_StormMoodPreset.cn: 暴风雨氛围去饱和预设

Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_StormMoodPreset_T.en: Choose how strong the storm desaturation should be: Soft, Recommended, Night of the Living Dead (Black & White).
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_StormMoodPreset_T.ch: 選擇暴風雨去飽和的強度: 柔和, 建議, 活死人之夜 (黑白).
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_StormMoodPreset_T.cn: 选择暴风雨去饱和的强度: 柔和, 建议, 活死人之夜 (黑白).

Sandbox_SaucedCarts_LoadedCartSpawns.ch: 載貨手推車生成 [測試版]
Sandbox_SaucedCarts_LoadedCartSpawns.cn: 载货手推车生成 [测试版]

Sandbox_SaucedCarts_LoadedCartSpawns_too.en: EXPERIMENTAL — off by default. How often a spawned cart comes pre-loaded with loot that fits where it spawned — groceries outside homes and lots, materials/tools in warehouses and stores, and (very rarely) a survivor's cache of weapons and ammo. Most carts stay empty, so a loaded one is a find. Still being tested — opt in if you want to try it; expect rough edges. Off = always empty (default).
Sandbox_SaucedCarts_LoadedCartSpawns_too.ch: 實驗性功能——預設停用. 決定生成的手推車有多常預先裝有符合該地點的物資: 住宅與停車場外是雜貨, 倉庫與商店裡是材料/工具, 極少數情況下則是倖存者囤放的武器彈藥. 大多數手推車仍是空的, 因此裝有物資的手推車算是一項發現. 此功能仍在測試中——想嘗試再啟用, 並請預期會有粗糙之處. 停用 = 永遠是空的 (預設).
Sandbox_SaucedCarts_LoadedCartSpawns_too.cn: 实验性功能——默认禁用. 决定生成的手推车有多常预先装有符合该地点的物资: 住宅与停车场外是杂货, 仓库与商店里是材料/工具, 极少数情况下则是幸存者囤放的武器弹药. 大多数手推车仍是空的, 因此装有物资的手推车算是一项发现. 此功能仍在测试中——想尝试再启用, 并请预期会有粗糙之处. 禁用 = 永远是空的 (默认).

Sandbox_RealisticCold_ConvectiveBridgeSt.ch: 對流過渡強度 (1.0 = 基礎)
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ConvectiveBridgeSt.cn: 对流过渡强度 (1.0 = 基础)

Sandbox_RealisticCold_ConvectiveBridgeSt.en: Smoothes the warming-rate cliff right at normal body temperature. 1.0 is baseline. 0 disables the bridge, warming up from cold to normal feels fast, but heating past normal in hot air feels much slower.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ConvectiveBridgeSt.ch: 平滑正常體溫附近的升溫速率斷崖. 1.0 為基礎值. 0 會停用此過渡, 從寒冷回升到正常體溫感覺很快, 但在熱空氣中升到正常體溫以上則會慢得多.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ConvectiveBridgeSt.cn: 平滑正常体温附近的升温速率断崖. 1.0 为基础值. 0 会禁用此过渡, 从寒冷回升到正常体温感觉很快, 但在热空气中升到正常体温以上则会慢得多.

Sandbox_RealisticCold_InsulationSpreadBi.ch: 各身體部位保溫偏重 (預設 0.30)
Sandbox_RealisticCold_InsulationSpreadBi.cn: 各身体部位保温偏重 (默认 0.30)

Sandbox_RealisticCold_InsulationSpreadBi.en: Controls how strongly uneven loadouts (e.g. parka + bare legs) deviate from the simple body-wide average. 0.0 = pure average (all parts treated equally); 1.0 = always pulled toward the weakest part in cold and the most-trapping part in heat. 0.30 is the recommended middle ground.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_InsulationSpreadBi.ch: 控制不均衡的穿著 (例如厚外套 + 光著腿) 偏離全身平均值的程度. 0.0 = 純平均 (所有部位一視同仁); 1.0 = 寒冷時始終偏向最薄弱的部位, 炎熱時始終偏向最悶熱的部位. 0.30 是建議的折衷值.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_InsulationSpreadBi.cn: 控制不均衡的穿着 (例如厚外套 + 光着腿) 偏离全身平均值的程度. 0.0 = 纯平均 (所有部位一视同仁); 1.0 = 寒冷时始终偏向最薄弱的部位, 炎热时始终偏向最闷热的部位. 0.30 是建议的折衷值.

Sandbox_RealisticCold_WarmingRateCapCPM.ch: 升溫速率上限 (°C 每分鐘)
Sandbox_RealisticCold_WarmingRateCapCPM.cn: 升温速率上限 (°C 每分钟)

Sandbox_RealisticCold_WarmingRateCapCPM_.en: Hard ceiling on how fast body temperature can rise from environmental warming (warm air, heaters, hot drinks combined). 0.5 °C/min is the default. Lower for slower recovery from cold; raise for instant warm-up at fires.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_WarmingRateCapCPM_.ch: 體溫因環境加溫 (暖空氣, 暖爐, 熱飲的綜合作用) 而上升速度的硬性上限. 預設為 0.5 °C/分鐘. 調低可讓從寒冷中恢復得更慢; 調高則可在火堆旁瞬間回暖.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_WarmingRateCapCPM_.cn: 体温因环境加温 (暖空气, 暖炉, 热饮的综合作用) 而上升速度的硬性上限. 默认为 0.5 °C/分钟. 调低可让从寒冷中恢复得更慢; 调高则可在火堆旁瞬间回暖.

Sandbox_Moodles_SixthSenseWorksOnAnimals.ch: 第六感特質對動物生效
Sandbox_Moodles_SixthSenseWorksOnAnimals.cn: 第六感特质对动物生效

Sandbox_Moodles_SixthSenseWorksOnZombies.ch: 第六感特質對殭屍生效
Sandbox_Moodles_SixthSenseWorksOnZombies.cn: 第六感特质对丧尸生效

Sandbox_Moodles_SixthSenseWorksOnZombies.en: That's the point of the mod, right !?
Sandbox_Moodles_SixthSenseWorksOnZombies.ch: 這就是這個模組的重點, 對吧!?
Sandbox_Moodles_SixthSenseWorksOnZombies.cn: 这就是这个模组的重点, 对吧!?

Sandbox_DAMN_AllowSuckyMcSuckfaceSpawns.en: Enable preset '93 Ford CF-8000 Elgin Street Sweeper spawns
Sandbox_DAMN_AllowSuckyMcSuckfaceSpawns.ch: 啟用預設93款福特CF8000 Elgin街道清掃車生成
Sandbox_DAMN_AllowSuckyMcSuckfaceSpawns.cn: 启用预设93款福特CF8000 Elgin街道清扫车生成

Sandbox_WellWaterRainFactor_tooltip.en: Additional multiplier applied to the water refill rate of the well when it is raining. This simulates the effect of rainwater contributing to the well's water supply.

Sandbox_WellWaterRainFactor_tooltip.cn: 下雨时额外应用于水井补水速率的倍率. 用以模拟雨水补充水井水源的效果.

Sandbox_RainCleansBlood_AlsoCleanDroppin.en: Also clean animal droppings (dung) left on the ground.
Sandbox_RainCleansBlood_AlsoCleanDroppin.ch: 同時清除地面上殘留的動物糞便.
Sandbox_RainCleansBlood_AlsoCleanDroppin.cn: 同时清除地面上残留的动物粪便.

Sandbox_NLKAlwaysKnowRoads_tooltip.en: New Characters start with knowledge of their immediate location and Kentucky's Roads.
Sandbox_NLKAlwaysKnowRoads_tooltip.ch: 新角色一開始就知曉自身所在區域與肯塔基州的道路.
Sandbox_NLKAlwaysKnowRoads_tooltip.cn: 新角色一开始就知晓自身所在区域与肯塔基州的道路.

Sandbox_FruitTreeChop_RottenFruitChance_.en: Chance for each fruit to spawn rotten. Fruit is always rotten in winter.
Sandbox_FruitTreeChop_RottenFruitChance_.ch: 每顆果實生成為腐爛狀態的機率. 冬季的果實一律為腐爛.
Sandbox_FruitTreeChop_RottenFruitChance_.cn: 每颗果实生成为腐烂状态的几率. 冬季的果实一律为腐烂.

Sandbox_zReV2_AntibodyPower2_tooltip.en:
Affects how quickly resistant antibodies eliminate the zombie virus from the body after activation in the stage.
-This trait is acquired by injecting the level 4 vaccine;
-If potency = 6, then ~5% infection is removed per hour;
-If potency = 12, then ~10% infection is removed per hour;
-If potency = 24, then ~20% infection is removed per hour.
Sandbox_zReV2_AntibodyPower2_tooltip.ch:
影響抗性抗體在該階段啟動後, 從體內清除殭屍病毒的速度.
-此特質透過注射第 4 級疫苗取得;
-效力 = 6 時, 每小時清除約 5%% 的感染度;
-效力 = 12 時, 每小時清除約 10%% 的感染度;
-效力 = 24 時, 每小時清除約 20%% 的感染度.
Sandbox_zReV2_AntibodyPower2_tooltip.cn:
影响抗性抗体在该阶段启动后, 从体内清除僵尸病毒的速度.
-此特质通过注射第 4 级疫苗获得;
-效力 = 6 时, 每小时清除约 5%% 的感染度;
-效力 = 12 时, 每小时清除约 10%% 的感染度;
-效力 = 24 时, 每小时清除约 20%% 的感染度.

Sandbox_zReV2_AntibodyPower_tooltip.en:
Affects at which infection stage the resistant antibodies activate.
-This trait is acquired by injecting the level 4 vaccine;
-TERMINAL - when infected over 80%, health drains, high chance of death;
-PRETERMINAL - when infected over 60% (nausea, fever)(RECOMMENDED!);
-MODERATE - when infected over 40% (mild nausea);
-INITIAL - when infected over 20% (no symptoms).
Sandbox_zReV2_AntibodyPower_tooltip.ch:
影響抗性抗體在哪個感染階段啟動.
-此特質透過注射第 4 級疫苗取得;
-末期 - 感染度超過 80%% 時啟動, 生命值會流失, 死亡機率極高;
-瀕末期 - 感染度超過 60%% 時啟動 (噁心、發燒)(推薦!);
-中期 - 感染度超過 40%% 時啟動 (輕微噁心);
-初期 - 感染度超過 20%% 時啟動 (無症狀).
Sandbox_zReV2_AntibodyPower_tooltip.cn:
影响抗性抗体在哪个感染阶段启动.
-此特质通过注射第 4 级疫苗获得;
-末期 - 感染度超过 80%% 时启动, 生命值会流失, 死亡几率极高;
-濒末期 - 感染度超过 60%% 时启动 (恶心、发烧)(推荐!);
-中期 - 感染度超过 40%% 时启动 (轻微恶心);
-初期 - 感染度超过 20%% 时启动 (无症状).

Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchRand.ch: 研究 - 進度加成. 數值:
Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchRand.cn: 研究 - 进度加成. 数值:

Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchRand_tooltip.en:
Only works for the vaccine improvement research type "PROGRESSIVE CHANCE" and "FULL RESEARCH"!
-In case of failed research, increases the result by a randomizer depending on this number (hereafter referred to as X);
-The formula works as:
Rand(X, X*2) for research up to level 2;
Rand(X*0.75, X*1.5) for research up to level 3;
Rand(X*0.5, X) for research up to level 4!
-Rounded up to the nearest whole number;
-Simply put: the randomizer decreases for researching a new vaccine by ~30% on average.
Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchRand_tooltip.ch:
僅對疫苗改良研究類型「累進機率」與「完整研究」有效!
-研究失敗時, 會依此數值 (以下稱為 X) 以隨機值提升結果;
-公式如下:
研究至第 2 級為 Rand(X, X*2);
研究至第 3 級為 Rand(X*0.75, X*1.5);
研究至第 4 級為 Rand(X*0.5, X)!
-結果無條件進位為整數;
-簡單來說: 研究更高等級疫苗時, 隨機值平均約降低 30%%.
Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchRand_tooltip.cn:
仅对疫苗改良研究类型“累进几率”与“完整研究”有效!
-研究失败时, 会依此数值 (以下称为 X) 以随机值提升结果;
-公式如下:
研究至第 2 级为 Rand(X, X*2);
研究至第 3 级为 Rand(X*0.75, X*1.5);
研究至第 4 级为 Rand(X*0.5, X)!
-结果向上取整为整数;
-简单来说: 研究更高等级疫苗时, 随机值平均约降低 30%%.

Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchType.cn: 研究 - 疫苗改良. 类型:

Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchType_tooltip.en:
Choice of result type for improving (researching) new vaccine levels.
-PROGRESSIVE CHANCE - on failure, the next success chance increases (accumulates);
-STATIC CHANCE - fixed percentage chance of success (30,20,14% from second to fourth);
-FULL RESEARCH - there is a hidden progress bar for study (100 units, conditionally, each research fills the bar).
Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchType_tooltip.ch:
改良 (研究) 新疫苗等級時的結果判定類型.
-累進機率 - 失敗時, 下一次的成功機率會提升 (可累積);
-固定機率 - 固定的成功百分比 (第二至第四級分別為 30, 20, 14%%);
-完整研究 - 存在一條隱藏的研究進度條 (概念上為 100 點, 每次研究會填充進度).
Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchType_tooltip.cn:
改良 (研究) 新疫苗等级时的结果判定类型.
-累进几率 - 失败时, 下一次的成功几率会提升 (可累积);
-固定几率 - 固定的成功百分比 (第二至第四级分别为 30, 20, 14%%);
-完整研究 - 存在一条隐藏的研究进度条 (概念上为 100 点, 每次研究会填充进度).

Sandbox_zReV2_chanceToRare_tooltip.cn: 决定击杀僵尸后获得稀有样本的几率.

Sandbox_DAYZPZ_LootAmount_tooltip.ch: 調整槍械專案物品出現的頻率 (0 表示完全移除, 「到處都是!」則極為常見).
Sandbox_DAYZPZ_LootAmount_tooltip.cn: 调整枪械项目物品出现的频率 (0 表示完全移除, “到处都是!”则极为常见).

Sandbox_DAYZPZ_M4_hg.cn: 枪上出现 M4 护木

Sandbox_DAYZPZ_M4_scope.cn: 枪上出现 M4 瞄准镜

Sandbox_DAYZPZ_M4_stock.ch: 槍上出現 M4 槍托零件
Sandbox_DAYZPZ_M4_stock.cn: 枪上出现 M4 枪托零件

Sandbox_DAYZPZ_SG5_stock.cn: 枪上出现 SG5-K 枪托

Sandbox_DrinkSmart_AddSipOption_tooltip.en: If enabled, the Drink Smart submenu adds a Sip option after All, 1/2, or 1/4. It drinks the smallest practical amount: about 0.01 L, or all remaining liquid if less.
Sandbox_DrinkSmart_AddSipOption_tooltip.ch: 啟用後, 智慧飲水子選單會在「全部」, 「1/2」, 「1/4」之後多出「啜飲」選項. 它會喝下實際可行的最小份量: 約 0.01 公升, 若剩餘液體不足則全部喝完.
Sandbox_DrinkSmart_AddSipOption_tooltip.cn: 启用后, 智慧饮水子菜单会在“全部”, “1/2”, “1/4”之后多出“啜饮”选项. 它会喝下实际可行的最小分量: 约 0.01 升, 若剩余液体不足则全部喝完.

Sandbox_DrinkSmart_ShowSmartDrinkAmount.ch: 顯示 0%% 口渴度所需份量
Sandbox_DrinkSmart_ShowSmartDrinkAmount.cn: 显示 0%% 口渴度所需分量

Sandbox_DrinkSmart_ShowSmartDrinkAmount_.en: If enabled, the 0%% Thirst option shows the estimated liquid amount that will be consumed, based on the container's current amount.
Sandbox_DrinkSmart_ShowSmartDrinkAmount_.ch: 啟用後, 「0%% 口渴度」選項會依容器目前的存量, 顯示預估會喝掉的液體份量.
Sandbox_DrinkSmart_ShowSmartDrinkAmount_.cn: 启用后, “0%% 口渴度”选项会依容器目前的存量, 显示预估会喝掉的液体分量.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_DebugCommandAccessL.en: Controls which multiplayer roles may use BSJ debug commands when enabled. Single-player remains available to the local player.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_DebugCommandAccessL.ch: 啟用除錯指令時, 控制多人遊戲中哪些身分可以使用 BSJ 除錯指令. 單人遊戲仍開放給本機玩家.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_DebugCommandAccessL.cn: 启用调试命令时, 控制多人游戏中哪些身份可以使用 BSJ 调试命令. 单人游戏仍开放给本地玩家.

Sandbox_CommonSense_CanWoundChance_toolt.en: Determines the chance of getting wounded if a Player fails to open a can with an improvised tool.
Sandbox_CommonSense_CanWoundChance_toolt.ch: 使用刀具、剪刀開罐頭時劃傷手部的機率.
Sandbox_CommonSense_CanWoundChance_toolt.cn: 使用刀具、剪刀开罐头时划伤手部的概率.

Sandbox_CommonSense_ColorFilter_tooltip.en: Toggles friendly User Interface colors for those affected by color blindness.
Sandbox_CommonSense_ColorFilter_tooltip.ch: 開啟適配色盲玩家的介面色彩最佳化濾鏡.
Sandbox_CommonSense_ColorFilter_tooltip.cn: 开启适配色盲玩家的界面色彩优化滤镜.

Sandbox_CommonSense_GunStats_tooltip.en: Toggles a custom User Interface that displays a gun's ammunition type, current ammo, state, etc. when one is equipped.
Sandbox_CommonSense_GunStats_tooltip.ch: 開啟後, 裝備槍械時會使用UI展示其彈藥類型、剩餘子彈、槍械狀態等資訊.
Sandbox_CommonSense_GunStats_tooltip.cn: 开启后, 装备枪械时会使用UI展示其弹药类型、剩余子弹、枪械状态等信息.

Sandbox_CommonSense_OC_DisableLoot_toolt.en: Toggles whether removing obvious stuff off the ground such as twigs, rocks, weeds, bushes, etc. will grant the Player the item they just removed.
Sandbox_CommonSense_OC_DisableLoot_toolt.ch: 開啟後拾取樹枝、石塊等地面物資無法獲得對應物品.
Sandbox_CommonSense_OC_DisableLoot_toolt.cn: 开启后拾取树枝、石块等地面物资无法获得对应物品.

Sandbox_CommonSense_OC_LootMultiplier_to.en: Multiplies the amount of loot the Player receives when picking obvious stuff off the ground.
Sandbox_CommonSense_OC_LootMultiplier_to.ch: 調整拾取地面基礎物資時獲得物品的數量倍率.
Sandbox_CommonSense_OC_LootMultiplier_to.cn: 调整拾取地面基础物资时获得物品的数量倍率.

Sandbox_CommonSense_ObviousCollecting_to.en: Toggles the ability to pick up obvious stuff off the ground, such as twigs, rocks, weeds, bushes, etc.
Sandbox_CommonSense_ObviousCollecting_to.ch: 開啟後可直接拾取地面的樹枝、石塊、雜草、灌木等基礎物資.
Sandbox_CommonSense_ObviousCollecting_to.cn: 开启后可直接拾取地面的树枝、石块、杂草、灌木等基础物资.

Sandbox_CommonSense_PryAllDoors_tooltip.en:
Toggles whether all doors can be pried open or not.
By default, reinforced doors (Prison doors, metal grid doors, etc.) cannot be pried open up unless the Player has a Strength level equal to or higher than the Min. Reinforced Door Level.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PryAllDoors_tooltip.ch: 開啟後所有門都能被撬開. 預設加固門 (監獄門, 金屬格柵門等) 需要達到指定力量等級才能撬動.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PryAllDoors_tooltip.cn: 开启后所有门都能被撬开. 默认加固门 (监狱门, 金属格栅门等) 需要达到指定力量等级才能撬动.

Sandbox_CommonSense_PryBuildingDoors_too.en: Toggles whether Players can pry open building doors, such as doors on houses, apartments, etc.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PryBuildingDoors_too.ch: 開啟後玩家可撬動房屋、公寓等建築的房門.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PryBuildingDoors_too.cn: 开启后玩家可撬动房屋、公寓等建筑的房门.

Sandbox_CommonSense_PryGarageDoors_toolt.en: Toggles whether Players can pry open garage doors.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PryGarageDoors_toolt.ch: 開啟後玩家可撬動車庫大門.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PryGarageDoors_toolt.cn: 开启后玩家可撬动车库大门.

Sandbox_CommonSense_PrySafeDoors_tooltip.en:
Toggles whether Players can pry open reinforced doors (Prison doors, metal grid doors, etc.)
These doors cannot be pried open unless the Player has a Strength level equal to or higher than the Min. Reinforced Door Level.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PrySafeDoors_tooltip.ch: 開啟後可撬動監獄門、金屬格柵門等加固門. 需達到設定力量等級.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PrySafeDoors_tooltip.cn: 开启后可撬动监狱门、金属格栅门等加固门. 需达到设定力量等级.

Sandbox_CommonSense_PryVehicleDoors_tool.en: Toggles whether Players can pry open vehicle doors.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PryVehicleDoors_tool.ch: 開啟後允許玩家撬動各類載具車門.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PryVehicleDoors_tool.cn: 开启后允许玩家撬动各类载具车门.

Sandbox_CommonSense_PryWindows_tooltip.en: Toggles whether Players can pry open building windows, such as windows on houses, apartments, etc.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PryWindows_tooltip.ch: 開啟後可撬動房屋、公寓等建築的窗戶.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PryWindows_tooltip.cn: 开启后可撬动房屋、公寓等建筑的窗户.

Sandbox_CommonSense_PryingChanceMultipli.en:
Determines the difficulty of prying open objects with a crowbar.
A higher multiplier makes it more difficult to pry open objects successfully, while a lower multiplier makes it easier.
0 = Always Succeed.
1 = Default Difficulty.
5 = Highest Difficulty.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PryingChanceMultipli.ch: 調整撬開物品的難度. 數值越高越難撬開,越低越容易; 0代表必定成功, 1為預設難度, 5為最高難度.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PryingChanceMultipli.cn: 调整撬开物品的难度. 数值越高越难撬开,越低越容易; 0代表必定成功, 1为默认难度, 5为最高难度.

Sandbox_CommonSense_PryingMechanic_toolt.en: Toggles whether Players can pry open doors, windows, etc. using a Crowbar.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PryingMechanic_toolt.ch: 開啟或關閉玩家可使用撬棍撬開門窗等物品的功能.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PryingMechanic_toolt.cn: 开启或关闭玩家可使用撬棍撬开门窗等物品的功能.

Sandbox_CommonSense_ReinforcedDoorLevel.ch: 撬開加固門最低力量等級
Sandbox_CommonSense_ReinforcedDoorLevel.cn: 撬开加固门最低力量等级

Sandbox_CommonSense_ReinforcedDoorLevel_.en: Determines the Minimum level of Strength at which Players can pry open reinforced doors (Prison doors, metal grid doors, etc.)
Sandbox_CommonSense_ReinforcedDoorLevel_.ch: 設定玩家撬開監獄門、金屬格柵門等加固門所需最低力量等級.
Sandbox_CommonSense_ReinforcedDoorLevel_.cn: 设定玩家撬开监狱门、金属格栅门等加固门所需最低力量等级.

Sandbox_CommonSense_ShatterVehicleWindow.en:
Determines whether Players can accidentally smash Vehicle door windows when failing to pry them open.
If enabled, this can happen at random (Based on the Window Shatter Chance setting).
Sandbox_CommonSense_ShatterVehicleWindow.ch: 開啟後撬動車門失敗時有機率打碎車窗, 機率遵循上方撬窗碎玻璃數值.
Sandbox_CommonSense_ShatterVehicleWindow.cn: 开启后撬动车门失败时有概率打碎车窗, 概率遵循上方撬窗碎玻璃数值.

Sandbox_CommonSense_WindowShatterChance_.en: Determines the chance of breaking the glass of a window when a Player fails an attempt to pry it open.
Sandbox_CommonSense_WindowShatterChance_.ch: 設定撬動窗戶失敗時打碎玻璃的機率.
Sandbox_CommonSense_WindowShatterChance_.cn: 设定撬动窗户失败时打碎玻璃的概率.

Sandbox_VMZ_RoadStoriesMultiplier_toolti.en: Allows you to edit the chances of military road stories appearing.
Sandbox_VMZ_RoadStoriesMultiplier_toolti.ch: 允許你調整軍用車輛在道路事件中出現的機率.
Sandbox_VMZ_RoadStoriesMultiplier_toolti.cn: 允许你调整军用车辆在道路事件中出现的概率.

Sandbox_WZDirector_MigrateCooldown_toolt.en:
Time required to pass before the Migrate Event can trigger.
The cooldown is constantly refreshed while the number of zombies is at, or above the %AAAAFFZombie Threshold%FFFFFF.
Value is in in-game minutes.
Sandbox_WZDirector_MigrateCooldown_toolt.ch:
遷移事件觸發前需要經過的時間.
當殭屍數量達到或超過%%AAAAFF遷移殭屍門檻值%%FFFFFF時, 冷卻時間會持續重新整理.
數值以遊戲分鐘為單位.
Sandbox_WZDirector_MigrateCooldown_toolt.cn:
迁移事件触发前需要经过的时间.
当僵尸数量达到或超过%%AAAAFF迁移僵尸阈值%%FFFFFF时, 冷却时间会持续刷新.
数值以游戏分钟为单位.

Sandbox_WZDirector_MigrateDistance_toolt.en:
This value determines how large of an area to give to the world sound.
Make sure to adjust the vanilla option Zombie Follow Distance to match.
Zombies inside a 120 radius of the world sound's location ignore the sound.
%DDDD00Setting this value too high can cause performance issues%FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WZDirector_MigrateDistance_toolt.ch:
該值確定世界聲音的影響區域大小.
請確保調整原版選項 "殭屍跟隨距離" 與之匹配.
世界聲音位置120半徑範圍內的殭屍會忽略該聲音.
%%DDDD00該值設定過高可能會導致效能問題%%FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WZDirector_MigrateDistance_toolt.cn:
该值确定世界声音的影响区域大小.
请确保调整原版选项 "僵尸跟随距离" 与之匹配.
世界声音位置120半径范围内的僵尸会忽略该声音.
%%DDDD00该值设置过高可能会导致性能问题%%FFFFFF.

Sandbox_WZDirector_MigrateEnabled_toolti.en:
When enabled (checked), allows the director to send out world sounds to attract distant zombies to a random location around the player.
%DDDD00This event is currently hardcoded to be disabled in MP%FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WZDirector_MigrateEnabled_toolti.ch:
啟用後 (勾選) , 允許導演發出世界聲音，將遠處的殭屍吸引到玩家周圍的隨機位置.
%%DDDD00此事件目前在多人遊戲中硬編碼為停用%%FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WZDirector_MigrateEnabled_toolti.cn:
启用后 (勾选) , 允许导演发出世界声音，将远处的僵尸吸引到玩家周围的随机位置.
%%DDDD00此事件当前在多人游戏中硬编码为禁用%%FFFFFF.

Sandbox_WZDirector_MigrateZombieThreshol.en: The director will only send out the world sound when there are less than this many active zombies.
Sandbox_WZDirector_MigrateZombieThreshol.ch: 僅當活躍殭屍少於該值時，導演才會發出世界聲音.
Sandbox_WZDirector_MigrateZombieThreshol.cn: 仅当活跃僵尸少于该值时，导演才会发出世界声音.

Sandbox_WZDirector_PullEnabled_tooltip.en: When enabled (checked), allows the director to randomly pull zombies to a random location around the player, inside a radius, when the player has been unseen for a period of time.
Sandbox_WZDirector_PullEnabled_tooltip.ch: 啟用後 (勾選) , 若玩家長時間未被發現, 導演可將殭屍隨機拉至附近.
Sandbox_WZDirector_PullEnabled_tooltip.cn: 启用后 (勾选) , 若玩家长时间未被发现, 导演可将僵尸随机拉至附近.

Sandbox_WZDirector_PullMaxRadius_tooltip.en:
The starting and maximum size of the radius.
Upon being seen, the radius reverts to this value.
Sandbox_WZDirector_PullMaxRadius_tooltip.ch:
半徑的初始值與最大值.
被發現後，半徑重置為該值.
Sandbox_WZDirector_PullMaxRadius_tooltip.cn:
半径的初始值与最大值.
被发现后，半径重置为该值.

Sandbox_WZDirector_PullMinRadius_tooltip.en:
The smallest the radius can be.
Every in-game minute while you remain unseen, after the unseen time limit has been reached, the radius decreases by 1% of Max Radius.
Sandbox_WZDirector_PullMinRadius_tooltip.ch:
可能的最小半徑.
在達到未被發現時間限制後，每保持1遊戲分鐘，半徑減小最大半徑的1%%.
Sandbox_WZDirector_PullMinRadius_tooltip.cn:
可能的最小半径.
在达到未被发现时间限制后，每保持1游戏分钟，半径减小最大半径的1%%.

Sandbox_WZDirector_PullUnseenTime_toolti.en:
Player must remain unseen for this period of time before the director can begin pulling zombies, and shrinking the radius.
Value is in in-game minutes.
Sandbox_WZDirector_PullUnseenTime_toolti.ch:
玩家必須在這段時間內保持未被發現, 之後導演才能開始拉殭屍並縮小半徑.
數值以遊戲內分鐘為單位.
Sandbox_WZDirector_PullUnseenTime_toolti.cn:
玩家必须在这段时间内保持未被发现, 之后导演才能开始拉僵尸并缩小半径.
数值以游戏内分钟为单位.

Sandbox_WZShared_ChebyshevDistance_toolt.en:
When enabled (checked), Wandering Zombies will use Chebyshev for distance instead of Euclidean.
Chebyshev measures distance in a square.
Euclidean measures distance in a circle.
Chebyshev distance may slightly improve performance.
Sandbox_WZShared_ChebyshevDistance_toolt.ch:
啟用後 (勾選) , 漫遊殭屍將使用切比雪夫距離替代歐幾里得距離.
切比雪夫距離以方形區域測量距離.
歐幾里得距離以圓形區域測量距離.
切比雪夫距離可能略微提升效能.
Sandbox_WZShared_ChebyshevDistance_toolt.cn:
启用后 (勾选) , 漫游僵尸将使用切比雪夫距离替代欧几里得距离.
切比雪夫距离以方形区域测量距离.
欧几里得距离以圆形区域测量距离.
切比雪夫距离可能略微提升性能.

Sandbox_WZShared_DumbZombiesExplore_tool.en:
When enabled (checked), all zombies are allowed to explore.
When disabled (unchecked), only smart zombies are allowed to explore.

%DDDD00This option requires the mod Reflection Enabler.
Without the Reflection Enabler:
- All zombies are considered dumb.
- This option is forcefully enabled.%FFFFFF
Sandbox_WZShared_DumbZombiesExplore_tool.ch:
啟用後 (勾選) , 所有殭屍都允許進行探索.
停用後 (取消勾選), 只有智慧殭屍允許進行探索.

%%DDDD00該選項需要模組 Reflection Enabler.
如果沒有 Reflection Enabler:
- 所有殭屍均被視為笨拙殭屍.
- 此選項將被強制啟用. %%FFFFFF
Sandbox_WZShared_DumbZombiesExplore_tool.cn:
启用后 (勾选) , 所有僵尸都允许进行探索.
禁用后 (取消勾选), 只有智能僵尸允许进行探索.

%%DDDD00该选项需要模组 Reflection Enabler.
如果没有 Reflection Enabler:
- 所有僵尸均被视为笨拙僵尸.
- 此选项将被强制启用. %%FFFFFF

Sandbox_WZShared_ExploreDestructive_tool.en: When enabled (checked), exploring zombies will destroy objects in their path.
Sandbox_WZShared_ExploreDestructive_tool.ch: 啟用後 (勾選) , 殭屍在探索時會破壞路徑上的物體.
Sandbox_WZShared_ExploreDestructive_tool.cn: 启用后 (勾选) , 僵尸在探索时会破坏路径上的物体.

Sandbox_WZShared_ForcePathfind_tooltip.en:
%AAAAFFNever%FFFFFF: Let the game decide when pathfinding should be used.
%AAAAFFIndoors%FFFFFF: Attempt to force pathfinding for indoor zombies.
%AAAAFFAlways%FFFFFF: Attempt to force pathfinding for all zombies.
Sandbox_WZShared_ForcePathfind_tooltip.ch:
%%AAAAFF永不%%FFFFFF: 讓遊戲決定何時使用尋路.
%%AAAAFF室內%%FFFFFF: 嘗試讓室內殭屍強制尋路.
%%AAAAFF總是%%FFFFFF: 嘗試讓所有殭屍強制尋路.
Sandbox_WZShared_ForcePathfind_tooltip.cn:
%%AAAAFF永不%%FFFFFF: 让游戏决定何时使用寻路.
%%AAAAFF室内%%FFFFFF: 尝试让室内僵尸强制寻路.
%%AAAAFF总是%%FFFFFF: 尝试让所有僵尸强制寻路.

Sandbox_WZShared_ForcedExploreChance_too.en:
Chance that a zombie passing through a building will stop, and explore it.
Zombies that come to a stop inside a building will always explore, as long as exploring is enabled.
Sandbox_WZShared_ForcedExploreChance_too.ch:
殭屍在穿過建築時停下並探索該建築的機率.
只要探索功能已啟用，在建築內停下的殭屍總會探索該建築.
Sandbox_WZShared_ForcedExploreChance_too.cn:
僵尸在穿过建筑时停下并探索该建筑的概率.
只要探索功能已启用，在建筑内停下的僵尸总会探索该建筑.

Sandbox_WZShared_OutOfCellPaths_tooltip.en: When enabled (checked), zombies are allowed to select a path that leads to them walking out of the loaded area / active cell.
Sandbox_WZShared_OutOfCellPaths_tooltip.ch: 啟用 (勾選) 後, 殭屍將允許選擇一條路徑, 使其走出已載入區域/活動單元格.
Sandbox_WZShared_OutOfCellPaths_tooltip.cn: 启用 (勾选) 后, 僵尸将允许选择一条路径, 使其走出已加载区域/活动单元格.

Sandbox_WZShared_OutOfCellThreshold_tool.en: Only allow Out Of Cell Paths when the number of zombies exceeds this value.
Sandbox_WZShared_OutOfCellThreshold_tool.ch: 僅在殭屍數量超出該值時允許單元外路徑.
Sandbox_WZShared_OutOfCellThreshold_tool.cn: 仅在僵尸数量超出该值时允许单元外路径.

Sandbox_WZShared_RepeatExplore_tooltip.en: When enabled (checked), a zombie that has finished exploring will start exploring again if they are not on the ground floor.
Sandbox_WZShared_RepeatExplore_tooltip.ch: 啟用後 (勾選) , 已完成探索的殭屍如果不在底層,將重新開始探索.
Sandbox_WZShared_RepeatExplore_tooltip.cn: 启用后 (勾选) , 已完成探索的僵尸如果不在底层,将重新开始探索.

Sandbox_WZShared_RoomExploreLimit_toolti.en:
Maximum random number of times a zombie will select a room from the building they're in to explore.
Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_WZShared_RoomExploreLimit_toolti.ch:
殭屍從所在建築中選擇房間進行探索的最大隨機次數.
設為 0 則停用該功能.
Sandbox_WZShared_RoomExploreLimit_toolti.cn:
僵尸从所在建筑中选择房间进行探索的最大随机次数.
设为 0 则禁用该功能.

Sandbox_WanderingZombies_CooldownHoursMi.en:
The amount of time that must elapse before the next period of activity.
If this value is not set to a multiple of 24, or is randomised to a value that is not a multiple of 24, the remainder is used to adjust Start Hour for that period of activity.
For example, if Start Hour is set to 0 (12:00am), and Cooldown Hours is set to 26, the next Start Hour would be 2am.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_CooldownHoursMi.ch:
在下一活動時段開始前必須經過的時間.
若該值 (隨機) 設為非24的倍數，則使用餘數來調整活動時段的起始時間.
例如，若起始時間設為0 (12:00am), 冷卻時間設為26, 則下一個起始時間為 2am.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_CooldownHoursMi.cn:
在下一活动时段开始前必须经过的时间.
若该值 (随机) 设为非24的倍数，则使用余数来调整活动时段的起始时间.
例如，若起始时间设为0 (12:00am), 冷却时间设为26, 则下一个起始时间为 2am.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_ConvertBloodyDesc.en:
Open the crafting menu (B) to find 'Clean and Convert Bloody Journal'.
Requires: Soap, Cloth, Leather, Thread, Needle, Tailoring Lv1.
WARNING: Destroys any remaining rewards!
Tooltip_BurdJournals_ConvertBloodyDesc.ch:
開啟製作選單 (B鍵) 找到「清潔並轉換血跡斑斑日記」選項.
所需材料: 肥皂, 布料, 皮革, 線團, 縫針, 縫紉1級.
警告: 此操作會銷燬日記中所有未領取的獎勵!
Tooltip_BurdJournals_ConvertBloodyDesc.cn:
打开制作菜单 (B键)找到“清洁并转换血迹斑斑日记”选项.
所需材料: 肥皂, 布料, 皮革, 线团, 缝针, 缝纫1级.
警告: 此操作会销毁日记中所有未领取的奖励!

Tooltip_BurdJournals_ConvertBloodyToClea.en: Use crafting to convert this bloody journal to a clean personal journal.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_ConvertBloodyToClea.ch: 透過製作將這本血跡斑斑的日記轉換為乾淨的個人日記.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_ConvertBloodyToClea.cn: 通过制作将这本血迹斑斑的日记转换为干净的个人日记.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_ConvertToClean.ch: 重新裝訂為個人生存日記
Tooltip_BurdJournals_ConvertToClean.cn: 重新装订为个人生存日记

Tooltip_BurdJournals_ConvertToCleanDesc.en: Rebind this worn journal into a clean blank survival journal for personal use. Requires tailoring supplies.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_ConvertToCleanDesc.ch: 將這本破舊日記重新裝訂為乾淨的空白生存日記, 供個人使用. 需要縫紉相關材料.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_ConvertToCleanDesc.cn: 将这本破旧日记重新装订为干净的空白生存日记, 供个人使用. 需要缝纫相关材料.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_CursedInsightFaint.en: The seal hints at a specific kind of punishment.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_CursedInsightFaint.ch: 封印暗示著某種特定的懲罰.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_CursedInsightFaint.cn: 封印暗示着某种特定的惩罚.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_CursedInsightHidden.en: Insight: the blood is hiding something.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_CursedInsightHidden.ch: 洞察: 血跡正在掩藏某些東西.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_CursedInsightHidden.cn: 洞察: 血迹正在隐藏某些东西.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_CursedInsightHidden.ch: 一本普通的血跡斑斑日記.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_CursedInsightHidden.cn: 一本普通的血迹斑斑日记.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_CursedJournalDesc.en: Breaking the seal marks the first reader, but unlocks a richer bloody reward journal.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_CursedJournalDesc.ch: 打破封印會標記首位閱讀者, 同時解鎖一本獎勵更豐厚的血跡斑斑日記.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_CursedJournalDesc.cn: 打破封印会标记首位阅读者, 同时解锁一本奖励更丰厚的血迹斑斑日记.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_DisassembleDesc.en:
Tear apart this journal for materials.

You will receive:
  2x Paper
  1x Leather Strips
Tooltip_BurdJournals_DisassembleDesc.ch:
拆解這本日記以回收製作材料.

你將獲得:
 2x 紙張
 1x 皮革條
Tooltip_BurdJournals_DisassembleDesc.cn:
拆解这本日记以回收制作材料.

你将获得:
 2x 纸张
 1x 皮条

Tooltip_BurdJournals_EraseContentsDesc.en:
Erases all recorded data, returning the journal to a blank state.
Requires an eraser.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_EraseContentsDesc.ch:
清除所有記錄的資料, 將日記恢復為空白狀態.
需要橡皮擦.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_EraseContentsDesc.cn:
清除所有记录的数据, 将日记恢复为空白状态.
需要橡皮擦.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_HiddenCursedInsight.en: A bloody journal with a few odd details.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_HiddenCursedInsight.ch: 一本血跡斑斑的日記, 有幾處奇怪的細節.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_HiddenCursedInsight.cn: 一本血迹斑斑的日记, 有几个奇怪细节.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_IlliterateDesc.en: You cannot read or write. Journals are useless to you.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_IlliterateDesc.ch: 你不識字. 日記對你毫無用處.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_IlliterateDesc.cn: 你不识字. 日记对你毫无用处.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedEraser.en: Requires an eraser to wipe the contents.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedEraser.ch: 需要橡皮擦才能擦除內容.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedEraser.cn: 需要橡皮擦才能擦除内容.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedPen.en: Requires a pen or pencil to write.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedPen.ch: 需要鋼筆或鉛筆才能書寫.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedPen.cn: 需要钢笔或铅笔才能书写.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedsCleaning.en: This journal is too worn to read.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedsCleaning.ch: 這本日記過於破舊, 無法閱讀.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedsCleaning.cn: 这本日记过于破旧, 无法阅读.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedsCleaningDesc.en: Use soap and cloth to clean it, duct tape to patch it, or leather strips to rebind it.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_NoPermissionClaim.cn: 你没有权限从此日记领取.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_ReadingSpeedNote.en: This will take time based on your reading speed.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_ReadingSpeedNote.cn: 耗时长短取决于你的阅读速度.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_RecordProgressDesc.en:
Opens journal to record your current skills and traits.
Recorded values are only updated if your current level is higher.

開啟日記以記錄你目前的技能和特質.
僅當目前等級高於日記記錄值時, 才會更新記錄.

打开日记以记录你当前的技能和特质.
仅当当前等级高于日记记录值时, 才会更新记录.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_SealedDesc.en: A sealed journal. Break the seal to reveal what lies within.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_SealedDesc.ch: 一本被封印的日記. 打破封印以揭示其中的內容.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_SealedDesc.cn: 一本被封印的日记. 打破封印以揭示其中的内容.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_SetModeDesc.en: Reading will SET your XP to match recorded levels (if higher).

Tooltip_BurdJournals_SetModeDesc.cn: 阅读将设置你的经验值以匹配记录的等级 (如果更高).

Tooltip_BurdJournals_UpdateRecordsDesc.en:
Opens journal to update your recorded skills.
Recorded values are only updated if your current level is higher.

開啟日記以更新你已記錄的技能.
僅當目前等級高於日記記錄值時, 才會更新記錄.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_UpdateRecordsDesc.cn:
打开日记以更新你已记录的技能.
仅当当前等级高于日记记录值时, 才会更新记录.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_YuletideJournalDesc.en: A wrapped holiday journal. Unwrap it to reveal the journal and its bundled supplies.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_MeadFermentationBarre.en: A mead barrel with tracked fermentation stages. Load 500 mL honey and 500 mL water per bottle, add fruit and yeast, then wait through the full aging window. Mead is bottleable after the early window, matures later, grows stronger with extra time, and eventually becomes a bad batch. Finished mead can be filled into bottles or compatible empty containers.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_MeadFermentationBarre.ch: 可追蹤發酵階段的蜂蜜酒桶. 每瓶份量需投入 500 毫升蜂蜜和 500 毫升水, 加入水果與酵母, 再等過完整的熟成期. 蜂蜜酒在初期階段後即可裝瓶, 之後會繼續熟成, 放得越久酒體越烈, 最終則會變成失敗的一批. 完成的蜂蜜酒可裝入酒瓶或相容的空容器.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_MeadFermentationBarre.cn: 可追踪发酵阶段的蜂蜜酒桶. 每瓶份量需投入 500 毫升蜂蜜和 500 毫升水, 加入水果与酵母, 再等过完整的熟成期. 蜂蜜酒在初期阶段后即可装瓶, 之后会继续熟成, 放得越久酒体越烈, 最终则会变成失败的一批. 完成的蜂蜜酒可装入酒瓶或兼容的空容器.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_WaxCoatedZucchini.cn: 以蜡封保存的西葫芦. 烹饪或去蜡后即可食用.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_WildBottle.en: A hardened hand-made bottle formed from beeswax sticky resin. Good for wilderness brewing and storing liquids.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_WildBottle.ch: 用蜂蠟黏性樹脂手工塑成並硬化的瓶子. 適合在野外釀造和儲存液體.

Tooltip_HydeCoBees_WildBottleUncured.en: A freshly shaped bottle blank made from beeswax sticky resin. It still needs to be fired in a kiln.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_WildBottleUncured.ch: 用蜂蠟黏性樹脂剛塑好的瓶胚. 還需要放進窯爐燒製.
Tooltip_HydeCoBees_WildBottleUncured.cn: 用蜂蜡粘性树脂刚塑好的瓶胚. 还需要放进窑炉烧制.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CastFrame.en: Used to hold molds for casting.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CastFrame.ch: 用於固定鑄造用的模具.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CastFrame.cn: 用于固定铸造用的模具.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicGnome.en: A fired ceramic gnome that can be painted for decoration.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicGnome.ch: 已燒製的陶瓷侏儒, 可彩繪作為裝飾.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicGnome.cn: 已烧制的陶瓷侏儒, 可彩绘作为装饰.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicGnomePainted.en: A painted ceramic gnome for decoration.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicGnomePainted.ch: 彩繪過的陶瓷侏儒, 可作裝飾.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicGnomePainted.cn: 彩绘过的陶瓷侏儒, 可作装饰.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicGnomeUnfired.en: Needs to be fired before use.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicJackOLantern.en: A fired ceramic jack o lantern that can be painted for decoration.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicJackOLantern.ch: 已燒製的陶瓷南瓜燈, 可彩繪作為裝飾.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicJackOLantern.cn: 已烧制的陶瓷南瓜灯, 可彩绘作为装饰.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicJackOLanternPa.en: A painted ceramic jack o lantern for decoration.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicJackOLanternPa.ch: 彩繪過的陶瓷南瓜燈, 可作裝飾.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicJackOLanternPa.cn: 彩绘过的陶瓷南瓜灯, 可作装饰.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicJackOLanternUn.en: Needs to be fired before use.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicMushroom.en: A fired ceramic mushroom that can be painted for decoration.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicMushroom.ch: 已燒製的陶瓷蘑菇, 可彩繪作為裝飾.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicMushroom.cn: 已烧制的陶瓷蘑菇, 可彩绘作为装饰.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicMushroomPainte.en: A painted ceramic mushroom for decoration.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicMushroomPainte.ch: 彩繪過的陶瓷蘑菇, 可作裝飾.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicMushroomPainte.cn: 彩绘过的陶瓷蘑菇, 可作装饰.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicMushroomUnfire.en: Needs to be fired before use.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicShiv.en: A sharp ceramic blade for close combat.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicShiv.ch: 鋒利的陶瓷刀刃, 適合近身戰鬥.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicShiv.cn: 锋利的陶瓷刀刃, 适合近身战斗.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_CeramicSpearHead.en: Used to craft a ceramic spear.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_HydeCoCeramicDecorati.en: A HydeCo magazine covering ceramic painting and decoration. Reading it teaches the painting recipes (you still need Pottery skill to perform them).
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_HydeCoCeramicDecorati.ch: 一本 HydeCo 雜誌, 內容涵蓋陶瓷彩繪與裝飾. 閱讀後可學會彩繪配方 (仍需陶藝技能才能製作).
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_HydeCoCeramicDecorati.cn: 一本 HydeCo 杂志, 内容涵盖陶瓷彩绘与装饰. 阅读后可学会彩绘配方 (仍需陶艺技能才能制作).

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_HydeCoSlipCastingMag.en: A HydeCo magazine covering ceramic reclamation, slip, and grog slurry. Reading it teaches the related recipes (you still need Pottery skill to perform them).
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_HydeCoSlipCastingMag.ch: 一本 HydeCo 雜誌, 內容涵蓋陶瓷回收再利用, 泥漿與熟料漿. 閱讀後可學會相關配方 (仍需陶藝技能才能製作).
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_HydeCoSlipCastingMag.cn: 一本 HydeCo 杂志, 内容涵盖陶瓷回收再利用, 泥浆与熟料浆. 阅读后可学会相关配方 (仍需陶艺技能才能制作).

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_BindSpear.en: Bind a ceramic spearhead to a shaft using ties, strips, twine, or tape.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_BindSpear.ch: 用綁帶, 布條, 麻繩或膠帶把陶瓷矛頭綁到矛桿上.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_BindSpear.cn: 用绑带, 布条, 麻绳或胶带把陶瓷矛头绑到矛杆上.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Buckets.en: Mix ingredients in a bucket to create ceramic fluids.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Buckets.ch: 在桶中混合材料, 製成陶藝用液體.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Buckets.cn: 在桶中混合材料, 制成陶艺用液体.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Cast.en: Cast slip into a plaster mold to form an unfired piece.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Cast.ch: 將泥漿注入石膏模具, 成形出未燒製的坯體.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Cast.cn: 将泥浆注入石膏模具, 成形出未烧制的坯体.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_CastFrame.en: Build a casting frame used to hold plaster molds.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_CastFrame.ch: 製作用來固定石膏模具的鑄造框.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_CastFrame.cn: 制作用来固定石膏模具的铸造框.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Cast_Grogged.en: Cast grogged slip (made with reclaimed ceramics) into a plaster mold to form a hollow unfired piece.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Cast_Grogged.ch: 將熟料泥漿 (以回收陶瓷製成) 注入石膏模具, 成形出中空的未燒製坯體.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Cast_Grogged.cn: 将熟料泥浆 (以回收陶瓷制成) 注入石膏模具, 成形出中空的未烧制坯体.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Cast_Slip.en: Cast regular slip into a plaster mold to form a hollow unfired piece.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Cast_Slip.ch: 將一般泥漿注入石膏模具, 成形出中空的未燒製坯體.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Cast_Slip.cn: 将普通泥浆注入石膏模具, 成形出中空的未烧制坯体.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Fire.en: Fire the unfired piece in a kiln to harden it.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Fire.ch: 在窯爐中燒製坯體使其硬化.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Fire.cn: 在窑炉中烧制坯体使其硬化.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_GrindPowder.en: Grind ceramic shards into fine powder using a mortar and pestle.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_GrindPowder.ch: 用研缽和研杵把陶瓷碎片磨成細粉.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_GrindPowder.cn: 用研钵和研杵把陶瓷碎片磨成细粉.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Knapping.en: Knapp ceramic shards into a usable tool or weapon part using a hammer.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Knapping.ch: 用錘子把陶瓷碎片敲製成可用的工具或武器部件.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Knapping.cn: 用锤子把陶瓷碎片敲制成可用的工具或武器部件.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_KneadModelingC.en: Knead modeling clay back into regular clay.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_KneadModelingC.ch: 把塑形黏土揉回一般黏土.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_KneadModelingC.cn: 把塑形黏土揉回普通黏土.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_ModelingClay.en: Mix grogged slip with an additive to make modeling clay.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_ModelingClay.ch: 把熟料泥漿與添加物混合, 製成塑形黏土.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_ModelingClay.cn: 把熟料泥浆与添加物混合, 制成塑形黏土.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Paint.en: Paint a fired ceramic piece using a paintbrush and paint cans.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Paint.ch: 用油漆刷和油漆罐為燒製好的陶瓷上色.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Paint.cn: 用油漆刷和油漆罐为烧制好的陶瓷上色.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PlasterMold.en: Make a plaster mold from a modeling-clay master using a casting frame.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PlasterMold.ch: 用鑄造框以塑形黏土原模翻製石膏模具.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PlasterMold.cn: 用铸造框以塑形黏土原模翻制石膏模具.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Shape.en: Carve a solid modeling-clay master used to make a plaster mold.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Shape.ch: 雕刻實心的塑形黏土原模, 用於翻製石膏模具.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Shape.cn: 雕刻实心的塑形黏土原模, 用于翻制石膏模具.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_SpearCeramic.en: A spear with a ceramic tip.

Tooltip_VFXCheeseAge.en: Aging cheese will increase it's quality.
Tooltip_VFXCheeseAge.ch: 熟成可以提升乳酪的品質.
Tooltip_VFXCheeseAge.cn: 熟成可以提升奶酪的品质.

Tooltip_VFXCookMash.en: Cook to turn into a Pot of Wort.
Tooltip_VFXCookMash.ch: 烹煮後會變成一鍋麥汁.
Tooltip_VFXCookMash.cn: 烹饪后会变成一锅麦汁.

Tooltip_VFXCookSugarBeetPulp.en: Cook to turn into a Pot of Sugar Beet Syrup.
Tooltip_VFXCookSugarBeetPulp.ch: 烹煮後會變成一鍋甜菜糖漿.
Tooltip_VFXCookSugarBeetPulp.cn: 烹饪后会变成一锅甜菜糖浆.

Tooltip_VFXCookSugarBeetSyrup.en: Cook to turn into a Pot of Molasses.
Tooltip_VFXCookSugarBeetSyrup.ch: 烹煮後會變成一鍋糖蜜.
Tooltip_VFXCookSugarBeetSyrup.cn: 烹饪后会变成一锅糖蜜.

Tooltip_VFXCottageCheese.en: Cook to turn into Pot of Cottage Cheese Curds.
Tooltip_VFXCottageCheese.ch: 烹煮後會變成一鍋鄉村乳酪凝乳.
Tooltip_VFXCottageCheese.cn: 烹饪后会变成一锅乡村奶酪凝乳.

Tooltip_VFXEvaporatedMilk.en: Cook to turn into a Pot of Evaporated Milk.
Tooltip_VFXEvaporatedMilk.ch: 烹煮後會變成一鍋淡奶.
Tooltip_VFXEvaporatedMilk.cn: 烹饪后会变成一锅淡奶.

Tooltip_VFXHomemadeVinegar.en: Can be used to make homemade vinegar.

Tooltip_VFXPressBottle.en: Use a Hand-Operated Press to seal bottle.

Tooltip_VFXSourdoughStarter.en: Feed daily with flour and water to keep fresh.
Tooltip_VFXSourdoughStarter.ch: 每天餵入麵粉和水以保持新鮮.
Tooltip_VFXSourdoughStarter.cn: 每天喂入面粉和水以保持新鲜.

Tooltip_VFXSourdoughStarterDead.en: You neglected your starter and it died. Pour it out and try again.
Tooltip_VFXSourdoughStarterDead.ch: 你疏於照顧麵種, 它已經死了. 倒掉重來吧.
Tooltip_VFXSourdoughStarterDead.cn: 你疏于照顾面种, 它已经死了. 倒掉重来吧.

Tooltip_VFXSourdoughStarterUnfed.en: Add flour and water to renew freshness, will die in about one day if left unfed.
Tooltip_VFXSourdoughStarterUnfed.ch: 加入麵粉和水可恢復新鮮度, 若一天左右未餵食就會死亡.
Tooltip_VFXSourdoughStarterUnfed.cn: 加入面粉和水可恢复新鲜度, 若一天左右未喂食就会死亡.

Tooltip_VFXStarterBlue.en: Can be used to make Blue Cheese.
Tooltip_VFXStarterBlue.ch: 可以用來製作藍紋乳酪.
Tooltip_VFXStarterBlue.cn: 可以用来制作蓝纹奶酪.

Tooltip_VFXStarterFrench.en: Can be used to make Brie and Camembert Cheese.
Tooltip_VFXStarterFrench.ch: 可以用來製作布里乳酪和卡蒙貝爾乳酪.
Tooltip_VFXStarterFrench.cn: 可以用来制作布里奶酪和卡蒙贝尔奶酪.

Tooltip_VFXStarterMesophilic.en: Can be used to make Buttermilk, Cream Cheese, Feta and Cheddar.
Tooltip_VFXStarterMesophilic.ch: 可以用來製作酪乳, 奶油乳酪, 費達乳酪和切達乳酪.
Tooltip_VFXStarterMesophilic.cn: 可以用来制作酪乳, 奶油芝士, 菲达奶酪和切达奶酪.

Tooltip_VFXStarterSwiss.en: Can be used to make Swiss Cheese.
Tooltip_VFXStarterSwiss.ch: 可以用來製作瑞士乳酪.
Tooltip_VFXStarterSwiss.cn: 可以用来制作瑞士奶酪.

Tooltip_VFXStarterThermophilic.en: Can be used to make Yogurt and Mozzarella.
Tooltip_VFXStarterThermophilic.ch: 可以用來製作優格和莫札瑞拉乳酪.
Tooltip_VFXStarterThermophilic.cn: 可以用来制作酸奶和马苏里拉奶酪.

Tooltip_VFXTomatoPulpPot.en: Cook to turn into a Pot of Tomato Paste.
Tooltip_VFXTomatoPulpPot.ch: 烹煮後會變成一鍋番茄糊.
Tooltip_VFXTomatoPulpPot.cn: 烹饪后会变成一锅番茄糊.

Tooltip_VFXVinegarStarter.en: Combine with alcohol, jar and lid to make Homemade Vinegar.
Tooltip_VFXVinegarStarter.ch: 與酒精, 玻璃罐和罐蓋組合可製作自製醋.
Tooltip_VFXVinegarStarter.cn: 与酒精, 玻璃罐和罐盖组合可制作自制醋.

Tooltip_VFXYeastStarter.en: Feed every second day with sugar and water to keep fresh.
Tooltip_VFXYeastStarter.ch: 每兩天餵入糖和水以保持新鮮.
Tooltip_VFXYeastStarter.cn: 每两天喂入糖和水以保持新鲜.

Tooltip_VFXYeastStarterDead.en: You neglected your starter and it died. Pour it out and try again. It can also be used to create homemade vinegar.
Tooltip_VFXYeastStarterDead.ch: 你疏於照顧菌種, 它已經死了. 倒掉重來吧. 它也可以用來製作自製醋.
Tooltip_VFXYeastStarterDead.cn: 你疏于照顾菌种, 它已经死了. 倒掉重来吧. 它也可以用来制作自制醋.

Tooltip_VFXYeastStarterUnfed.en: Add sugar and water to renew freshness, will die in about two days if left unfed.
Tooltip_VFXYeastStarterUnfed.ch: 加入糖和水可恢復新鮮度, 若兩天左右未餵食就會死亡.
Tooltip_VFXYeastStarterUnfed.cn: 加入糖和水可恢复新鲜度, 若两天左右未喂食就会死亡.

Tooltip_VFX_StarterParmesan.en: Can be used to make Parmesan Cheese.
Tooltip_VFX_StarterParmesan.ch: 可以用來製作帕瑪森乳酪.
Tooltip_VFX_StarterParmesan.cn: 可以用来制作帕玛森奶酪.

Tooltip_CCUpgrade_Tier1.en: Applies a Tier 1 storage upgrade. Final capacity depends on the container's size class and sandbox settings.
Tooltip_CCUpgrade_Tier1.ch: 套用第 1 階容量升級套件. 最終容量取決於容器的尺寸等級與沙盒設定.
Tooltip_CCUpgrade_Tier1.cn: 应用第 1 阶容量升级套件. 最终容量取决于容器的尺寸级别与沙盒设置.

Tooltip_Eureka.en: Need more time to think of new ideas after the last invention.
Tooltip_Eureka.ch: 上次發明之後, 還需要一些時間才能想出新點子.
Tooltip_Eureka.cn: 上次发明之后, 还需要一些时间才能想出新点子.

Tooltip_InvNeuralHat_Off.en: Deactivate the gadget. Small chance to trigger a cooldown period.
Tooltip_InvNeuralHat_Off.ch: 關閉此裝置. 有小機率觸發冷卻期.
Tooltip_InvNeuralHat_Off.cn: 关闭此装置. 有小几率触发冷却期.

Tooltip_InvNeuralHat_On.en: Activate to sporadically gain more experience and shorten reading time.
Tooltip_InvNeuralHat_On.ch: 啟動後可不定時獲得更多經驗值並縮短閱讀時間.
Tooltip_InvNeuralHat_On.cn: 启动后可不定时获得更多经验值并缩短阅读时间.

Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Get.en: Gets the completed invention and clears the workbench. You need enough inventory space to be able to pick it. <LINE> Only the creator can get this invention.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Get.ch: 取得完成的發明並清空工作臺. 你需要有足夠的背包空間才能拿取. <LINE> 只有製作者才能取走這件發明.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Get.cn: 获得完成的发明并清空工作台. 你需要有足够的背包空间才能拿取. <LINE> 只有制作者才能取走这件发明.

Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Get_NoRoom.en: Not enough inventory space to get invention.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Get_NoRoom.ch: 背包空間不足, 無法取出發明.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Get_NoRoom.cn: 背包空间不足, 无法取出发明.

Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Invent.en: Attempt to create a new gadget.

Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Invent_NotAvailable.ch: 沒有新的東西可以製作.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Invent_NotAvailable.cn: 没有新的东西可以制作.

Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Invention_a1.en: Every creation has to start somewhere.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Invention_a1.ch: 任何創造都得有個起頭.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Invention_a1.cn: 任何创造都得有个起头.

Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Invention_a2.en: Throw a bunch of stuff together and build something.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Invention_a2.ch: 把一堆東西湊在一起, 做出點什麼來.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Invention_a2.cn: 把一堆东西凑在一起, 做出点什么来.

Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Invention_a3.en: Gather the necessary materials to build the first prototype of a new complex gadget.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Invention_a3.ch: 蒐集必要的材料, 打造新型複雜裝置的第一個原型.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Invention_a3.cn: 搜集必要的材料, 打造新型复杂装置的第一个原型.

Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Invention_b1.en: You might be on the verge of a new discovery.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Invention_b1.ch: 你可能就快有新的發現了.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Invention_b1.cn: 你可能就快有新的发现了.

Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Invention_b2.en: You have a feeling that whatever it is that you're trying to create its big and will require more resources.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Invention_b2.ch: 你有種預感: 不管你想做的是什麼, 那玩意兒都不小, 而且會需要更多資源.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Invention_b2.cn: 你有种预感: 不管你想做的是什么, 那玩意儿都不小, 而且会需要更多资源.

Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Production.en: Recreate a known gadget. <LINE> Invention skill and certain improvements can lower time and materials required to create stuff.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Production.ch: 重新製作已知的裝置. <LINE> 發明技能和某些改進可以降低製作所需的時間和材料.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Production.cn: 重新制作已知的装置. <LINE> 发明技能和某些改进可以降低制作所需的时间和材料.

Tooltip_InvWorkbench_ProductionList.en: Start production on this gadget (resources will be consumed).
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_ProductionList.ch: 開始生產這件裝置 (將會消耗資源).
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_ProductionList.cn: 开始生产这件装置 (将会消耗资源).

Tooltip_InvWorkbench_ProductionList_Add.en: Donate items to the project (resources will be consumed).
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_ProductionList_Add.ch: 為此專案捐出物品 (將會消耗資源).
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_ProductionList_Add.cn: 为此项目捐出物品 (将会消耗资源).

Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Production_NotAvail.en: Once you invent something, you can recreate it here.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Production_NotAvail.ch: 只要你發明過某樣東西, 就能在這裡重新製作.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Production_NotAvail.cn: 只要你发明过某样东西, 就能在这里重新制作.

Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Production_a1.en: Recreate an exact replica of a previously discovered item, together with any improvements it might have.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Production_a1.ch: 完全複製先前已發現的物品, 連同它所擁有的各項改進一併重現.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Production_a1.cn: 完全复制先前已发现的物品, 连同它所拥有的各项改进一并重现.

Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Research_NotAvailab.en: Must invent a complex gadget first.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Research_NotAvailab.ch: 必須先發明出複雜裝置.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Research_NotAvailab.cn: 必须先发明出复杂装置.

Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Research_a1.en: The first steps at attempting to develop or improve a technology are always the hardest and may take several tries.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Research_a1.ch: 想開發或改進一項技術, 最初的幾步總是最難的, 而且可能要試上好幾次.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Research_a1.cn: 想开发或改进一项技术, 最初的几步总是最难的, 而且可能要试上好几次.

Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Research_a2.en: The acquisition, implementation and testing of all sorts of materials is required before an improvement can be applied to new gadgets.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Research_a2.ch: 各種材料的取得, 應用與測試都完成後, 改進才能套用到新的裝置上.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Research_a2.cn: 各种材料的获取, 应用与测试都完成后, 改进才能应用到新的装置上.

Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Research_b1.en: Eureka! After much tinkering your research can finally progress to its final steps.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Research_b1.ch: 靈光乍現! 一番鑽研之後, 你的研究終於能推進到最後階段.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Research_b1.cn: 灵光乍现! 一番钻研之后, 你的研究终于能推进到最后阶段.

Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Ruined.en: Either due to an accident, negligence or sheer incompetence this project was utterly ruined beyond recognition. <LINE> Its best to just get rid of it.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Ruined.ch: 由於意外, 疏忽或純粹的無能, 這個專案已經徹底毀了, 面目全非. <LINE> 最好直接把它處理掉.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Ruined.cn: 由于意外, 疏忽或纯粹的无能, 这个项目已经彻底毁了, 面目全非. <LINE> 最好直接把它处理掉.

Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Scrap.en: Clears the workbench for future use. The current work will be destroyed along with any resources spent on it.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Scrap.ch: 清空工作臺以供日後使用. 目前的成果以及投入的所有資源都會被銷毀.
Tooltip_InvWorkbench_Scrap.cn: 清空工作台以供日后使用. 当前的成果以及投入的所有资源都会被销毁.

Tooltip_Inventions_Costumes_desc.en: A garment or accessory that favors appearance over function, which is the entire point.
Tooltip_Inventions_Costumes_desc.ch: 一件重外觀甚於功能的服裝或配件, 而這正是它存在的全部意義.
Tooltip_Inventions_Costumes_desc.cn: 一件重外观甚于功能的服装或配件, 而这正是它存在的全部意义.

Tooltip_Inventions_Curios_desc.en: A peculiar creation that might serve a singular purpose or act as proof of concept for an idea, assuming it does not explode. Usually the first step toward something better.
Tooltip_Inventions_Curios_desc.ch: 一件古怪的創作, 也許只有單一用途, 也許只是某個想法的概念驗證, 前提是它不會爆炸. 通常是邁向更好成果的第一步.
Tooltip_Inventions_Curios_desc.cn: 一件古怪的创作, 也许只有单一用途, 也许只是某个想法的概念验证, 前提是它不会爆炸. 通常是迈向更好成果的第一步.

Tooltip_Inventions_DemonCore_desc.en: A compact sphere of glowing potential, this incredible replica is positively charged with countless FUN! Just be careful... too much exposure may leave you feeling a little too hot.
Tooltip_Inventions_DemonCore_desc.ch: 一顆閃著微光, 蘊含無限潛能的小球; 這件驚人的複製品帶著滿滿的「正」電與數不清的樂趣! 只是要小心… 接觸太久可能會讓你覺得有點太燙.
Tooltip_Inventions_DemonCore_desc.cn: 一颗闪着微光, 蕴含无限潜能的小球; 这件惊人的复制品带着满满的“正”电与数不清的乐趣! 只是要小心… 接触太久可能会让你觉得有点太烫.

Tooltip_Inventions_DrinkingBuddy_desc.en: A cute little toy or the physical manifestation of a sisyphean nightmare? How does it move on its own? Is there liquid in the can? Why must it drink? Our brave buddy has no time for answers as it is nearly time for another sip.
Tooltip_Inventions_DrinkingBuddy_desc.ch: 一個可愛的小玩具, 還是薛西弗斯式噩夢的具象化? 它怎麼會自己動? 罐子裡真的有液體嗎? 它為什麼非喝不可? 我們勇敢的小夥伴沒空回答, 因為又快到下一口的時間了.
Tooltip_Inventions_DrinkingBuddy_desc.cn: 一个可爱的小玩具, 还是西西弗斯式噩梦的具象化? 它怎么会自己动? 罐子里真的有液体吗? 它为什么非喝不可? 我们勇敢的小伙伴没空回答, 因为又快到下一口的时间了.

Tooltip_Inventions_FoodSynthesizer_desc.en: A cutting-edge culinary reprocessor that breaks down food items into an unsettling pink nutrient-rich paste. Technically edible and packed with all the essentials, it will never go bad and not even insects go near it for some reason, but its revolting flavor and texture don't make it very appealing to one's taste buds.
Tooltip_Inventions_FoodSynthesizer_desc.ch: 一臺尖端的食物再處理機, 能把食材分解成令人不安的粉紅色高營養糊. 技術上可以吃, 營養也一應俱全, 永遠不會腐壞, 不知為何連蟲子都不靠近, 但那令人反胃的味道和口感實在難以取悅味蕾.
Tooltip_Inventions_FoodSynthesizer_desc.cn: 一台尖端的食物再处理机, 能把食材分解成令人不安的粉红色高营养糊. 技术上可以吃, 营养也一应俱全, 永远不会腐烂, 不知为何连虫子都不靠近, 但那令人反胃的味道和口感实在难以取悦味蕾.

Tooltip_Inventions_Gramophone_desc.en: A mechanical audio device that plays music with surprising clarity, while sporting the fashionable look of an old style brass gramophone without any of its shortcomings.
Tooltip_Inventions_Gramophone_desc.ch: 一臺機械式音響裝置, 播放音樂的清晰度出人意料, 同時保有老式黃銅留聲機的時髦外型, 卻沒有它的任何缺點.
Tooltip_Inventions_Gramophone_desc.cn: 一台机械式音响装置, 播放音乐的清晰度出人意料, 同时保有老式黄铜留声机的时髦外型, 却没有它的任何缺点.

Tooltip_Inventions_NeuralHat_desc.en: A large cap lined with neural interface needles that tap directly into your cerebral cortex, using low-voltage neural induction to boost cognitive processing. Prolonged use may cause mild dependency, nosebleeds, existential dread, and an inexplicable urge to reorganize socks by color.
Tooltip_Inventions_NeuralHat_desc.ch: 一頂內襯神經介面探針的大帽子, 能直接接入你的大腦皮質, 以低電壓神經誘導提升認知處理能力. 長期使用可能導致輕微依賴, 流鼻血, 存在焦慮, 以及一股莫名想把襪子按顏色重新整理的衝動.
Tooltip_Inventions_NeuralHat_desc.cn: 一顶内衬神经接口探针的大帽子, 能直接接入你的大脑皮层, 以低电压神经诱导提升认知处理能力. 长期使用可能导致轻微依赖, 流鼻血, 存在焦虑, 以及一股莫名想把袜子按颜色重新整理的冲动.

Tooltip_Inventions_ScrapBushSeed_desc.en: A remarkable large synthetic seed assembled from various scrap metal parts and assorted components. Defy all logic and current understanding of botany by planting it in soil and, with enough patience and a pinch of insanity, it may grow into a fully functional plant.
Tooltip_Inventions_ScrapBushSeed_desc.ch: 一顆用各式廢金屬零件與雜項元件組裝而成的驚人巨大人造種子. 把它種進土裡, 徹底違背一切邏輯與現代植物學的認知, 只要有足夠的耐心再加上一點瘋狂, 它或許真能長成一株功能完整的植物.
Tooltip_Inventions_ScrapBushSeed_desc.cn: 一颗用各式废金属零件与杂项元件组装而成的惊人巨大人造种子. 把它种进土里, 彻底违背一切逻辑与现代植物学的认知, 只要有足够的耐心再加上一点疯狂, 它或许真能长成一株功能完整的植物.

Tooltip_Inventions_ToothpasteCurio_desc.en: Brush your teeth with this marvelous gift of science and wash away even the most stubborn food cravings! How does it work? Can it really cause uncontrollable rage? Why are my gums bleeding? Only YOU know the answers.
Tooltip_Inventions_ToothpasteCurio_desc.ch: 用這份科學的絕妙贈禮刷牙, 連最頑固的食慾都能一併沖掉! 它是怎麼運作的? 真的會引發無法控制的暴怒嗎? 我的牙齦為什麼在流血? 只有「你」知道答案.
Tooltip_Inventions_ToothpasteCurio_desc.cn: 用这份科学的绝妙赠礼刷牙, 连最顽固的食欲都能一并冲掉! 它是怎么运作的? 真的会引发无法控制的暴怒吗? 我的牙龈为什么在流血? 只有“你”知道答案.

Tooltip_Inventions_Toys_desc.en: An item with little practical value beyond amusement, distraction and the satisfaction of having made it.
Tooltip_Inventions_Toys_desc.ch: 一件除了娛樂, 打發時間, 以及親手做出來的成就感之外, 沒什麼實用價值的物品.
Tooltip_Inventions_Toys_desc.cn: 一件除了娱乐, 打发时间, 以及亲手做出来的成就感之外, 没什么实用价值的物品.

Tooltip_Inventions_UmbrellaHat_desc.en: A hands-free rain protection system that keeps the user mostly dry and in (theoretical) great style!
Tooltip_Inventions_UmbrellaHat_desc.ch: 一套免用手的防雨系統, 能讓使用者大致保持乾爽, 而且 (理論上) 相當有型!
Tooltip_Inventions_UmbrellaHat_desc.cn: 一套免用手的防雨系统, 能让用户大致保持干爽, 而且 (理论上) 相当有型!

Tooltip_LSRSM_ClockBtn_GameMinutes.en: <TEXT> Displaying: average completion time in <SPACE><ORANGE> real minutes (approx.). <LINE><TEXT> Click to change to <SPACE><ORANGE> ticks.
Tooltip_LSRSM_ClockBtn_GameMinutes.ch: <TEXT> 顯示中: 平均完成時間, 單位為 <SPACE><ORANGE> 實際分鐘 (約略). <LINE><TEXT> 點選可切換為 <SPACE><ORANGE> 遊戲刻.
Tooltip_LSRSM_ClockBtn_GameMinutes.cn: <TEXT> 显示中: 平均完成时间, 单位为 <SPACE><ORANGE> 实际分钟 (大约). <LINE><TEXT> 点击可切换为 <SPACE><ORANGE> 游戏刻.

Tooltip_LSRSM_ClockBtn_Ticks.en: <TEXT> Displaying: average completion time in <SPACE><ORANGE> ticks. <LINE><TEXT> Click to change to <SPACE><ORANGE> real minutes (approx.).
Tooltip_LSRSM_ClockBtn_Ticks.ch: <TEXT> 顯示中: 平均完成時間, 單位為 <SPACE><ORANGE> 遊戲刻. <LINE><TEXT> 點選可切換為 <SPACE><ORANGE> 實際分鐘 (約略).
Tooltip_LSRSM_ClockBtn_Ticks.cn: <TEXT> 显示中: 平均完成时间, 单位为 <SPACE><ORANGE> 游戏刻. <LINE><TEXT> 点击可切换为 <SPACE><ORANGE> 实际分钟 (大约).

Tooltip_LSRSM_Improvements_common_desc.en: (improvements increase the costs for future research, production and repairs)
Tooltip_LSRSM_Improvements_common_desc.ch: (改進會提高未來研究, 生產與維修的成本)
Tooltip_LSRSM_Improvements_common_desc.cn: (改进会提高未来研究, 生产与维修的成本)

Tooltip_LSRSM_Improvements_costDecrease_.en: (reduces the costs for future research, production and repairs)
Tooltip_LSRSM_Improvements_costDecrease_.ch: (降低未來研究, 生產與維修的成本)
Tooltip_LSRSM_Improvements_costDecrease_.cn: (降低未来研究, 生产与维修的成本)

Tooltip_LSRSM_Improvements_standardizati.en: (reduces the costs for production and repairs only)

Tooltip_LSRSM_ProdBtn.en: Start production on the selected item.

Tooltip_LSRSM_ResBtn.en: Start research on the selected improvement.

Tooltip_LSRSM_ResBtnOff_b.en: Workbench is busy with another project.
Tooltip_LSRSM_ResBtnOff_b.ch: 工作臺正忙於另一個專案.
Tooltip_LSRSM_ResBtnOff_b.cn: 工作台正忙于另一个项目.

Tooltip_craft_DiscoBallDesc.en:
Showers its surroudings with a variety of
light schemes.
Tooltip_craft_DiscoBallDesc.ch:
以多種燈光模式
照亮周圍的環境.
Tooltip_craft_DiscoBallDesc.cn:
以多种灯光模式
照亮周围的环境.

Tooltip_craft_DiscoFloorDesc.en:
Connects to other disco floors to display
complex color patterns.
Tooltip_craft_DiscoFloorDesc.ch:
可與其他迪斯科地板相連,
展示複雜的色彩圖樣.
Tooltip_craft_DiscoFloorDesc.cn:
可与其他迪斯科地板相连,
展示复杂的色彩图样.

Tooltip_craft_DjBoothDesc.en:
A complete DJ Booth set. Can be used to
play music and manipulate disco floors.
Tooltip_craft_DjBoothDesc.ch:
完整的DJ臺套組. 可以用來
播放音樂並操控迪斯科地板.
Tooltip_craft_DjBoothDesc.cn:
完整的DJ台套组. 可以用来
播放音乐并操控迪斯科地板.

Tooltip_craft_EaselDesc.en:
Create paintings with a variety of sizes that
can be hanged on walls for decoration.
Tooltip_craft_EaselDesc.ch:
創作各種尺寸的畫作,
可掛在牆上作為裝飾.
Tooltip_craft_EaselDesc.cn:
创作各种尺寸的画作,
可挂在墙上作为装饰.

Tooltip_craft_InvWorkbenchDesc.en:
A wooden workbench for tinkering with scrap
and other materials to create all sorts of items.
Tooltip_craft_InvWorkbenchDesc.ch:
一張木製工作臺, 可用廢料
和其他材料搗鼓出各式各樣的物品.
Tooltip_craft_InvWorkbenchDesc.cn:
一张木制工作台, 可用废料
和其他材料捣鼓出各式各样的物品.

Tooltip_craft_MicrophoneDesc.en: A standing microphone. Can be used to sing.
Tooltip_craft_MicrophoneDesc.ch: 一支落地麥克風. 可以用來唱歌.
Tooltip_craft_MicrophoneDesc.cn: 一支落地麦克风. 可以用来唱歌.

Tooltip_craft_SculptingStationDesc.en:
A support frame for sculpting. Can be used
to create all kinds of sculptures.
Tooltip_craft_SculptingStationDesc.ch:
用於雕塑的支撐架. 可以用來
創作各式各樣的雕塑作品.
Tooltip_craft_SculptingStationDesc.cn:
用于雕塑的支撑架. 可以用来
创作各式各样的雕塑作品.

Tooltip_item_DemonCoreCurio.en: You'll be fine, just don't let it slip.
Tooltip_item_DemonCoreCurio.ch: 你不會有事的, 只要別讓它滑掉就好.
Tooltip_item_DemonCoreCurio.cn: 你不会有事的, 只要别让它滑掉就好.

Tooltip_item_PasteBurger.ch: 現在 100%% 不會食物中毒!
Tooltip_item_PasteBurger.cn: 现在 100%% 不会食物中毒!

Tooltip_item_PasteGrub.en: Eating too much might make you sick. The 'plate' is edible paste too!
Tooltip_item_PasteGrub.ch: 吃太多可能會讓你不舒服. 連那個「盤子」也是可以吃的營養糊!
Tooltip_item_PasteGrub.cn: 吃太多可能会让你不舒服. 连那个“盘子”也是可以吃的营养糊!

Tooltip_item_PasteRuined.en: This 'food' is completely ruined. Not fit for anything, much less eating. DON'T EAT IT.
Tooltip_item_PasteRuined.ch: 這份「食物」已經徹底壞掉了. 什麼用都沒有, 更別說拿來吃. 千萬別吃!
Tooltip_item_PasteRuined.cn: 这份“食物”已经彻底坏掉了. 什么用都没有, 更别说拿来吃. 千万别吃!

Tooltip_item_ScrapBushSeed.en: A jumbo-sized 'seed' made out of different metal parts. If all goels well, it should grow into a bountiful Scrap-Bush plant.
Tooltip_item_ScrapBushSeed.ch: 一顆用各種金屬零件做成的巨無霸「種子」. 如果一切順利, 它應該會長成一株果實纍纍的廢料灌木.

STATION 9 - COMPILED DOSSIER <LINE> <LINE> The shift logs chronicle Station 9's final days of operation. <LINE> Chief Martinez organized an emergency supply cache before the <LINE> crew was forced to abandon the station. Tooltip_DMD_FirefighterComplete.ch: 消防局 9 號站 - 彙整檔案 <LINE>  <LINE> 值班日誌記錄了 9 號站最後幾天的運作. <LINE> 馬丁內斯局長在隊員被迫棄守消防站之前, <LINE> 設置了一處緊急補給藏匿點. 彙整的文件裡 <LINE> 附有藏匿點位置的草圖, 旁邊寫著: <LINE> 「消防裝備與工具——世界末日時打破玻璃取用. 」
Tooltip_DMD_FirefighterComplete.cn: 消防局 9 号站 - 汇总档案 <LINE>  <LINE> 值班日志记录了 9 号站最后几天的运作. <LINE> 马丁内斯局长在队员被迫弃守消防站之前, <LINE> 设置了一处紧急补给藏匿点. 汇总的文件里 <LINE> 附有藏匿点位置的草图, 旁边写着: <LINE> “消防装备与工具——世界末日时打破玻璃取用. ”

Tooltip_DMD_FirefighterPage1.en: KNOX COUNTY FIRE DEPARTMENT <LINE> STATION 9 - SHIFT LOG <LINE> <LINE> Multiple structure fires reported across the county. All units <LINE> deployed. Engine 9 responded to a warehouse blaze on Industrial <LINE> Ave - found the building barricaded from inside. Screaming from <LINE> upper floors. Attempted rescue. Lost contact with Firefighter <LINE> Kowalski on the second floor. Chief ordered full withdrawal.
Tooltip_DMD_FirefighterPage1.ch: 諾克斯縣消防局 <LINE> 9 號站 - 值班日誌 <LINE>  <LINE> 全縣傳出多起建物火警. 所有分隊出動. <LINE> 9 號車前往工業大道的倉庫火場——發現建物 <LINE> 從內側被封死. 樓上傳來尖叫. 嘗試救援. <LINE> 與二樓的科瓦爾斯基隊員失去聯絡. 局長下令 <LINE> 全員撤離.
Tooltip_DMD_FirefighterPage1.cn: 诺克斯县消防局 <LINE> 9 号站 - 值班日志 <LINE>  <LINE> 全县传出多起建物火警. 所有分队出动. <LINE> 9 号车前往工业大道的仓库火场——发现建物 <LINE> 从内侧被封死. 楼上传来尖叫. 尝试救援. <LINE> 与二楼的科瓦尔斯基队员失去联系. 局长下令 <LINE> 全员撤离.

Tooltip_DMD_FirefighterPage2.en: KNOX COUNTY FIRE DEPARTMENT (CONT.) <LINE> STATION 9 - SHIFT LOG <LINE> <LINE> Station 9 is now our last holdout. Chief Martinez stashed our <LINE> remaining gear - axes, helmets, protective equipment - in the <LINE> emergency cache behind the station before things got bad. The <LINE> combination is on the whiteboard in the break room. If you're <LINE> reading this and the station is empty, check the cache. Stay safe.
Tooltip_DMD_FirefighterPage2.ch: 諾克斯縣消防局 (續) <LINE> 9 號站 - 值班日誌 <LINE>  <LINE> 9 號站現在是我們最後的據點. 情況惡化前, <LINE> 馬丁內斯局長把我們剩下的裝備——斧頭, 頭盔, <LINE> 防護具——全收進消防站後方的緊急藏匿點. <LINE> 密碼寫在休息室的白板上. 如果你讀到這段而 <LINE> 站裡空無一人, 就去看看那個藏匿點. 保重.
Tooltip_DMD_FirefighterPage2.cn: 诺克斯县消防局 (续) <LINE> 9 号站 - 值班日志 <LINE>  <LINE> 9 号站现在是我们最后的据点. 情况恶化前, <LINE> 马丁内斯局长把我们剩下的装备——斧头, 头盔, <LINE> 防护具——全收进消防站后方的紧急藏匿点. <LINE> 密码写在休息室的白板上. 如果你读到这段而 <LINE> 站里空无一人, 就去看看那个藏匿点. 保重.
