{{survivorName}}帶著{{supplyNoun}}爬了上去, 下來的時候整個人蒼老了許多. 關於{{skillName}}的那一頁是他們的. 關於{{recipeName}}的那一頁是我的. 兩頁下方的抓痕都屬於{{omenNoun}}.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedSilo.cn:
粮仓里有东西敲了三天. 不是人. 不是动物. 它敲的是紧急广播的节奏, 并在有人祈祷时停止.

{{survivorName}}带着{{supplyNoun}}爬了上去, 下来时苍老了许多. 关于{{skillName}}的那一页是他们的. 关于{{recipeName}}的那一页是我的. 两页下方的划痕均属于{{omenNoun}}.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedSkill.en:
Count the dead. Count the doors. Count the lessons that keep you separate from the first category and moving through the second. {{skillNameA}} is one. {{skillNameB}} is two. The third count belongs to {{omenNoun}}, so stop early. Stop while you can still pretend the numbers are just numbers and not a conversation you're having with something that counts back.

{{authorName}} did not stop early. That is why the page has room for {{openerName}}. That is why the margin is wide and the ink is fresh and the binding doesn't crack when you open it. The journal has been waiting. Journals do that, if they're made right, if they're opened right, if they're read by the right eyes at the wrong time.

I counted to fifty before I realized the counting was counting me. Fifty dead I had seen. Fifty doors I had closed. Fifty skills I wished I had, and only two - {{skillNameA}} and {{skillNameB}} - that I had actually learned. The wish counted too. The wish counted as three, and three is {{omenNoun}}'s favorite number, the number of sides on a warning, the number of points on a star that fell over Knox County in 1991 and nobody talks about anymore except in whispers that sound like static.

Practice {{skillNameA}} where mirrors cannot see you practice. Practice {{skillNameB}} where radios cannot hear the repetition. If either lesson improves too quickly, if your hands know the motions before your mind knows the meaning, thank nobody. Thanking is naming. Naming is inviting. Inviting is how the door opens from the outside even when you locked it from the in.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedSkill.ch:
數一數死者. 數一數門. 數一數那些讓你不至於淪為前者, 又能穿過後者的教訓.{{skillNameA}}是一.{{skillNameB}}是二. 第三個數屬於{{omenNoun}}, 所以要提早停下. 趁你還能假裝數字只是數字, 而不是你正在和某個會反過來數你的東西對話時, 停下來.

{{authorName}}沒有提早停下. 所以這一頁才會給{{openerName}}留了位置. 所以頁邊的留白才這麼寬, 墨水才這麼新, 翻開時裝訂處才不會發出斷裂聲. 這本日記一直在等. 日記就是會這樣——只要它被做得正確, 被打開得正確, 又在錯誤的時刻被正確的眼睛讀到.

我數到五十, 才發現這場計數也在數我. 我見過五十個死者. 我關上過五十扇門. 我希望自己擁有五十種技能, 但真正學會的只有兩種——{{skillNameA}}和{{skillNameB}}.那個願望也被算了進去. 那個願望算作三, 而三是{{omenNoun}}最喜歡的數字, 是警告標誌的邊數, 也是1991年墜落在諾克斯縣上空的那顆星星的尖角數——如今除了聽起來像電波雜訊的耳語, 再沒有人談起它.

在鏡子看不見你練習的地方練習{{skillNameA}}.在收音機聽不見你重複動作的地方練習{{skillNameB}}.如果哪一課進步得太快, 如果你的手在腦子明白意義之前就記住了動作, 那就誰也別感謝. 感謝就是喊出名字. 喊出名字就是發出邀請. 而邀請, 就是門從外面被打開的方式——即使你明明從裡面上了鎖.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedSkill.cn:
数一数死者. 数一下门. 计算一下让你脱离第一类并进入第二类的教训.{{skillNameA}}是一.{{skillNameB}}是二. 第三个计数属于{{omenNoun}}, 所以早点停止. 趁你还能假装这些数字只是数字, 而不是你正在与某个会反过来数你的东西对话时, 停下来.

{{authorName}}并没有提前停下来. 这就是为什么该页面有{{openerName}}的空间. 这就是为什么页边距很宽, 墨水很新鲜, 打开它时装订不会破裂. 这本日记一直在等待. 如果日记制作正确, 打开方式正确, 在错误的时间被正确的眼睛阅读, 日记就能做到这一点.

我数到五十才意识到计数正在数我. 我见过五十人死亡. 我关上了五十扇门. 我希望拥有五十种技能, 但我实际上学到的只有两种——{{skillNameA}}和{{skillNameB}}.这个愿望也被算了进去. 这个愿望算作三, 而三是{{omenNoun}}最喜欢的数字, 是警告标志的边数, 是1991年坠落在诺克斯县上空的那颗星星的尖角数, 如今除了听起来像电流杂音的低语, 再没有人谈论它.

在镜子看不到你练习的地方练习{{skillNameA}}.在收音机听不到重复的地方练习{{skillNameB}}.如果任何一堂课进步得太快, 如果你的手在你的头脑知道含义之前就知道了动作, 那就谁也不要感谢. 感谢就是命名. 命名就是邀请. 而邀请, 就是即使你从里面锁上了门, 门也会从外面打开的方式.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedSkill.en:
The ink refused every word except {{skillNameA}}. When {{authorName}} tried to write "help," the page sweated until {{skillNameB}} appeared underneath. When I tried to write my name, the letters rearranged into something that sounded almost like a cough. The paper is thirsty. The paper is particular. The paper wants what it wants.

{{openerName}} should learn them in order. The page likes order. It punishes curiosity in ways that don't show up immediately, ways that wait, ways that accumulate like interest on a debt you didn't know you'd signed. I signed. I broke the seal. I opened the cover and read the first line and now I am the first line, written in something that isn't ink but flows like it.

{{skillNameA}} is useful. {{skillNameB}} is useful. Both work. Both teach what they claim to teach. The knowledge is real, tested, practical. You can use it to survive {{dangerNoun}}, to find {{supplyNoun}}, to make it through another night of the Knox Event which is not just an event anymore but a condition, a state of being, a permanent weather system that rains teeth and dead air.

But after you learn, after {{openerName}} closes the book and walks away with new abilities nestled in their muscles and mind, remember that something walks away with you. Something that was waiting for a reader. Something that needed hands to hold it, eyes to read it, a voice to speak its contents aloud even in silence. The page is warm. The page is patient. The page has time that we don't.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedSkill.ch:
墨水拒絕寫下除了{{skillNameA}}以外的任何字. 當{{authorName}}試著寫下「救命」時, 紙頁不停滲出汗水, 直到{{skillNameB}}從底下浮現. 當我試著寫下自己的名字, 字母重新排列成某種聽起來幾乎像咳嗽的東西. 這紙很渴. 這紙很挑剔. 這紙想要什麼, 就非要到手不可.

{{openerName}}應該按順序學習它們. 這一頁喜歡秩序. 它懲罰好奇心的方式不會立刻顯現——它會等待, 會累積, 像一筆你根本不知道自己簽過的債務所滾出的利息. 我簽了. 我打破了封印. 我翻開封面, 讀了第一行, 而現在我就是第一行, 由某種不是墨水, 卻像墨水一樣流動的東西寫成.

{{skillNameA}}很有用.{{skillNameB}}很有用. 兩者都有效. 兩者教的都是它們聲稱要教的東西. 這些知識真實, 經過驗證, 實用. 你可以靠它撐過{{dangerNoun}}, 找到{{supplyNoun}}, 熬過諾克斯事件的又一個夜晚——諾克斯事件早已不只是一場事件, 而是一種狀態, 一種存在方式, 一套下著牙齒與死寂空氣的永久天氣系統.

但在你學會之後, 在{{openerName}}闔上書, 帶著棲進肌肉與心智裡的新能力走遠之後, 記住: 有什麼東西也跟著你走了. 一個一直在等待讀者的東西. 一個需要有手捧著它, 有眼睛閱讀它, 有聲音即使在沉默中也替它念出內容的東西. 這一頁是溫熱的. 這一頁很有耐心. 這一頁擁有我們所沒有的時間.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedSkill.cn:
墨水拒绝了除了{{skillNameA}}之外的每一个字. 当{{authorName}}尝试写“救命”时, 页面一直在冒汗, 直到下面出现{{skillNameB}}.当我试图写下自己的名字时, 字母重新排列成听起来几乎像咳嗽的东西. 纸渴了. 这纸很挑剔. 这纸想要它想要的东西.

{{openerName}}应该按顺序学习. 该页面喜欢顺序. 它以不会立即显现的方式惩罚好奇心, 以等待的方式, 以累积的方式, 就像你不知道自己签署的债务的利息一样. 我签了. 我打破了封印. 我打开封面, 读了第一行, 现在我就是第一行, 用不是墨水但像墨水一样流动的东西写成.

{{skillNameA}}很有用.{{skillNameB}}很有用. 两者都有效. 两者都教授他们声称所教授的内容. 这些知识是真实的, 经过检验的, 实用的. 你可以用它挺过{{dangerNoun}}, 找到{{supplyNoun}}, 度过诺克斯事件的另一个夜晚, 诺克斯事件不再只是一个事件, 而是一种条件, 一种存在状态, 一个下着牙齿和死寂空气的永久天气系统.

但是当你学习之后, 当{{openerName}}合上书并带着隐藏在他们的肌肉和思想中的新能力离开时, 请记住, 有些东西会随着你离开. 正在等待读者的东西. 有些东西需要双手来握住它, 需要眼睛来阅读它, 需要一个声音即使在沉默中也能大声说出它的内容. 页面很温暖. 页面很有耐心. 这一页拥有我们所没有的时间.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedSkill.en:
{{skillNameA}} was written in {{authorName}}'s hand. {{skillNameB}} was written in mine. I had not opened the journal yet.

If {{openerName}} sees their own handwriting later, do not correct the spelling. The page enjoys attention.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedSkill.ch:
{{skillNameA}}是{{authorName}}的筆跡.{{skillNameB}}是我的筆跡. 而那時, 我甚至還沒有翻開過這本日記.

如果{{openerName}}之後看見了自己的筆跡, 不要去糾正拼寫. 這一頁很享受被關注.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedSkill.cn:
{{skillNameA}}是{{authorName}}亲手写的.{{skillNameB}}是我写的. 而那时我还没有打开过日记.

如果{{openerName}}稍后看到自己的笔迹, 请不要纠正拼写. 这一页很享受被关注.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedSkill.en:
The margin offered power, answers, and the location of every locked pharmacy in Knox County. {{authorName}} chose {{skillNameA}} because it looked least hungry.

{{skillNameB}} chose itself. If {{openerName}} feels the page get warm, close it after the lesson and before the bargain.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedSkill.ch:
頁邊的空白處開出了條件: 力量, 答案, 還有諾克斯縣每一家上鎖藥局的位置.{{authorName}}選了{{skillNameA}}, 因為它看起來最不飢餓.

{{skillNameB}}選中了它自己. 如果{{openerName}}感覺到紙頁開始發熱, 請在上完這一課之後, 談成交易之前, 把它闔上.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedSkill.cn:
页边的空白处提供了力量, 答案, 以及诺克斯县每家上锁药店的位置.{{authorName}}选择{{skillNameA}}, 因为它看起来最不饿.

{{skillNameB}}选择了自己. 如果{{openerName}}感觉页面变热, 请在课程结束后, 交易开始之前将其合上.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedSkill.en:
Practice {{skillNameA}} where mirrors cannot watch. Practice {{skillNameB}} where radios cannot listen. If either lesson improves too quickly, thank nobody.

{{authorName}} wrote that warning after {{noun}} {{verb}} {{adverb}}. {{openerName}} should treat it as instruction, not superstition.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedSkill.ch:
在鏡子看不見的地方練習{{skillNameA}}.在收音機聽不見的地方練習{{skillNameB}}.如果哪一課進步得太快, 誰也別感謝.

{{authorName}}是在{{noun}}{{verb}}{{adverb}}之後寫下這條警告的.{{openerName}}應該把它當作指示, 而不是迷信.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedSkill.cn:
在镜子看不到的地方练习{{skillNameA}}.在收音机听不到的地方练习{{skillNameB}}.如果任何一门课进步得太快, 那就谁也不要感谢.

{{authorName}}在{{noun}}{{verb}}{{adverb}}之后写下该警告.{{openerName}}应该把它当作指导, 而不是迷信.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedStati.en:
There is a choir under the static. You hear it best when the batteries are dying and the room is too tired to lie. It sings numbers, road names, and sometimes the recipe you needed yesterday.

{{openerName}}, take {{entryNameA}} and {{entryNameB}} before the chorus notices. If it harmonizes with your breathing, turn the radio off with a hammer.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedStati.ch:
電波雜訊的底下藏著一支唱詩班. 當電池快要耗盡, 房間累得連謊都說不動的時候, 你聽得最清楚. 它唱數字, 唱路名, 有時還會唱出你昨天正需要的那份配方.

{{openerName}}, 趁合唱團還沒注意到, 把{{entryNameA}}和{{entryNameB}}拿走. 如果它開始跟著你的呼吸和聲, 就用鐵鎚把收音機關掉.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedStati.cn:
静电下面有一个唱诗班. 当电池快没电, 房间累得连谎都懒得说的时候, 你听得最清楚. 它会唱出数字, 道路名称, 有时还会唱出你昨天需要的配方.

{{openerName}}, 趁合唱团还没注意到, 拿走{{entryNameA}}和{{entryNameB}}.如果它开始与你的呼吸唱和, 请用锤子关掉收音机.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedStorm.en:
The storm drains carried more than rain after the sirens stopped. Whispers came up through the grates near {{noun}}, offering shortcuts, cures, and old names nobody should have known.

{{authorName}} followed one. I found the journal instead. If {{openerName}} keeps it, learn {{skillName}}, forget the whisper, and never trade {{traitName}} for an answer.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedStorm.ch:
警報停止之後, 雨水下水道裡流動的就不只是雨水了. 低語從{{noun}}附近的排水柵欄裡冒上來, 兜售捷徑, 療法, 還有那些不該有人知道的古老名字.

{{authorName}}跟著其中一句走了. 而我找到的是這本日記. 如果{{openerName}}要留著它, 就學會{{skillName}}, 忘掉那句低語, 並且永遠不要拿{{traitName}}去換一個答案.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedStorm.cn:
警报停止后, 雨水渠输送的不仅仅是雨水.{{noun}}附近的格栅里传出窃窃私语, 提供捷径, 治疗方法和没人应该知道的旧名字.

{{authorName}}跟着其中一个走了. 我反而找到了这本日记. 如果{{openerName}}保留它, 请学习{{skillName}}, 忘记耳语, 永远不要用{{traitName}}换取答案.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedTaxOf.en:
The tax office survived the first riots because nobody wanted paperwork at the end of the world. Inside, every filing cabinet had been sorted into sins instead of surnames. {{traitName}} was stamped on more folders than seemed fair.

I found {{authorName}} under penalties due. The notes on {{entryNameA}} were audited. The notes on {{entryNameB}} were forgiven. {{openerName}} should avoid the drawer marked extensions.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedTaxOf.ch:
稅務局在第一波暴動中倖存了下來, 因為世界末日沒有人想碰文書作業. 在裡面, 每一個檔案櫃都不是按姓氏, 而是按罪孽分類的.{{traitName}}被蓋在多得有失公允的資料夾上.

我在「應繳罰款」底下找到了{{authorName}}.關於{{entryNameA}}的筆記被審計過了. 關於{{entryNameB}}的筆記獲得了減免.{{openerName}}最好避開標著「延期」的那個抽屜.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedTaxOf.cn:
税务局在第一次骚乱中幸存下来, 因为在世界末日没有人想要文书工作. 里面的每一个文件柜都按照罪名而不是姓氏进行分类.{{traitName}}被盖在了多得有失公允的文件夹上.

我在“应缴罚款”底下找到了{{authorName}}.关于{{entryNameA}}的笔记已被审计. 关于{{entryNameB}}的笔记已获减免.{{openerName}}应避开标着“延期”的那个抽屉.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedVotin.en:
The voting machine in city hall kept printing results after the election was canceled. Sick won by a landslide. Dead took every precinct. One ballot had {{openerName}} written where the office should be.

{{authorName}} took the tape and hid it behind {{stashNoun}}. These notes on {{skillName}} and {{recipeName}} were printed on the back. Democracy has strange handwriting now.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedVotin.ch:
選舉被取消之後, 市政廳的投票機仍在不停印出結果.「生病」以壓倒性優勢獲勝.「死亡」拿下了每一個選區. 有一張選票上, 本該填寫職位的地方寫著{{openerName}}.

{{authorName}}取走了那捲紙帶, 把它藏在{{stashNoun}}後面. 這些關於{{skillName}}和{{recipeName}}的筆記就印在背面. 如今的民主, 筆跡變得很古怪.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedVotin.cn:
选举被取消之后, 市政厅的投票机仍在不停打印结果.“生病”以压倒性优势获胜.“死亡”拿下了每一个选区. 有一张选票上, 本该写职位的地方写着{{openerName}}.

{{authorName}}取走了纸带, 把它藏在{{stashNoun}}后面. 这些关于{{skillName}}和{{recipeName}}的笔记就印在背面. 如今的民主有着古怪的笔迹.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedWater.en:
People blamed the water because water goes everywhere and never testifies. {{survivorName}} boiled it, filtered it, prayed over it, and still dreamed of {{omenNoun}} drinking first.

If {{openerName}} wants a practical answer, take {{skillName}} and {{recipeName}}. If you want the true answer, ask why the page stays dry when everything else in this county sweats.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedWater.ch:
人們怪罪水, 因為水無處不在, 卻從不作證.{{survivorName}}煮過它, 濾過它, 為它禱告過, 卻仍然夢見{{omenNoun}}搶在所有人之前先喝.

如果{{openerName}}想要一個實用的答案, 就拿走{{skillName}}和{{recipeName}}.如果你想要真正的答案, 就問問為什麼這個縣裡的其他一切都在冒汗, 唯獨這一頁始終乾燥.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedWater.cn:
人们指责水, 因为水无处不在, 却从不作证.{{survivorName}}煮过它, 过滤过它, 为它祈祷过, 却仍然梦见{{omenNoun}}先喝.

如果{{openerName}}想要一个实用的答案, 请拿走{{skillName}}和{{recipeName}}.如果你想要真正的答案, 就问问为什么这个县的其他一切都在出汗时, 这一页却始终保持干燥.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedWell.en:
The well water was clean until the bucket came up with hair. After that it gave different gifts: teeth, radio parts, a school photograph, one wet page already covered in {{authorName}}'s handwriting.

I added {{entryNameA}} because the page left room. {{entryNameB}} appeared while I slept. If {{openerName}} lowers a bucket, do not ask for water by name.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedWell.ch:
井水一直很乾淨, 直到吊桶撈上來一把頭髮為止. 從那之後, 它開始送上別的禮物: 牙齒, 無線電零件, 一張學校照片, 還有一頁早已寫滿{{authorName}}筆跡的濕紙.

我補上了{{entryNameA}}, 因為那一頁還留有空位.{{entryNameB}}是在我睡著時自己出現的. 如果{{openerName}}要放下吊桶, 千萬別指名要水.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedWell.cn:
井水一直很干净, 直到桶里捞上来头发为止. 之后它送出了不同的礼物: 牙齿, 无线电部件, 一张学校照片, 一张已经写满了{{authorName}}笔迹的湿纸页.

我添加了{{entryNameA}}, 因为页面留有空间.{{entryNameB}}在我睡觉时出现. 如果{{openerName}}放下水桶, 请勿指名要水.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusBell.en:
The bell tower rang at midnight without a rope. Every dead thing in three blocks turned its head like children hearing dinner. {{survivorName}} cried because the rhythm sounded almost festive.

If {{openerName}} reads this, keep {{supplyNoun}} wrapped, keep {{traitName}} quiet, and remember {{entryName}} before the next bell. Some invitations are shaped like songs.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusBell.ch:
午夜時分, 鐘樓在沒有繩索的情況下自己響了. 三個街區內所有死去的東西都轉過頭來, 像聽見開飯的孩子們.{{survivorName}}哭了, 因為那節奏聽起來幾乎像在過節.

如果{{openerName}}讀到這裡, 請把{{supplyNoun}}包好, 讓{{traitName}}保持安靜, 並在下一次鐘響之前記住{{entryName}}.有些邀請函長得像歌.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusBell.cn:
半夜钟楼敲响, 没有绳索. 三个街区里的所有死物都转过头来, 就像孩子们听到晚餐一样.{{survivorName}}哭了, 因为节奏听起来近乎喜庆.

如果{{openerName}}读到此内容, 请将{{supplyNoun}}包裹起来, 保持{{traitName}}安静, 并在下一个铃声之前记住{{entryName}}.有些邀请函的形状像歌曲.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusCand.en:
The candle factory kept working after everyone left. Wax poured, wicks twisted, and every label printed the same warning: good enough is not good. {{authorName}} stole three candles and came back with four shadows.

This journal was inside the fourth. {{skillName}} is legible. {{recipeName}} smells faintly of smoke. If {{openerName}} lights anything from that place, do it outdoors.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusCand.ch:
所有人都離開之後, 蠟燭工廠仍在運作. 蠟繼續澆注, 燭芯繼續搓捻, 每一張標籤都印著同一句警告: 夠好, 並不算好.{{authorName}}偷了三根蠟燭, 回來時卻帶著四道影子.

這本日記就在第四道影子裡.{{skillName}}的字跡還算清晰.{{recipeName}}聞起來有淡淡的煙味. 如果{{openerName}}要點燃任何來自那個地方的東西, 請到室外進行.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusCand.cn:
所有人都离开后, 蜡烛厂继续工作. 蜡被浇上, 灯芯被扭曲, 每个标签上都印着同样的警告: 足够好并不好.{{authorName}}偷了三根蜡烛, 回来时带着四个影子.

这本日记就在第四个影子里.{{skillName}}清晰可见.{{recipeName}}闻起来有淡淡的烟味. 如果{{openerName}}从那个地方点燃任何东西, 请在室外进行.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusChim.en:
The chimney ash spelled names after midnight. Not every name belonged to the living, and not every living name stayed in one place. {{authorName}} swept it twice before the broom started bleeding soot.

The gift for {{openerName}} is {{entryNameA}} and {{entryNameB}}, wrapped before the ash could correct them. If the fireplace coughs, do not answer in your own voice.

給{{openerName}}的禮物是{{entryNameA}}和{{entryNameB}}, 在灰燼來得及竄改它們之前就包好了. 如果壁爐咳嗽, 千萬別用自己的聲音回答.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusChim.cn:
午夜过后, 烟囱灰拼出了名字. 并不是每个名字都属于生者, 也不是每个生者的名字都留在一个地方.{{authorName}}在扫帚开始渗出烟灰之前扫了两次.

给{{openerName}}的礼物是{{entryNameA}}和{{entryNameB}}, 在灰烬来得及纠正它们之前就包裹好了. 如果壁炉发出咳嗽声, 请勿用自己的声音回答.

Coal would have been kinder. The package left soot on {{survivorName}}'s hands and a smell like old churches after rain. Inside were notes, a ribbon, and a warning that changed words whenever nobody watched.

For {{openerName}}: {{entryNameA}} first, {{entryNameB}} second, and no bargains after sundown. If {{noun}} {{verb}} {{adverb}}, pretend you heard nothing.

如果只是煤炭, 那反倒仁慈. 那個包裹在{{survivorName}}手上留下了煤灰, 還有一股雨後老教堂的氣味. 裡面裝著字條, 一條緞帶, 還有一則只要沒人盯著看就會自行改寫措辭的警告.

給{{openerName}}的話: 先是{{entryNameA}}, 再來是{{entryNameB}}, 而且日落之後不談任何交易. 如果{{noun}}{{verb}}{{adverb}}, 就假裝你什麼也沒聽見.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusCoal.cn:
煤炭反倒会更仁慈. 包裹在{{survivorName}}的手上留下了烟灰, 还有雨后老教堂的味道. 里面有便条, 一条丝带和一条警告, 只要没有人看到, 警告就会改变措辞.

Krampus does not need confession, but he enjoys bookkeeping. The box behind {{noun}} was full of apology notes, ration tickets, and a single gift tag with {{openerName}} already written on it.

{{entryNameA}} is what the tag offered. {{entryNameB}} is what {{authorName}} added in defiance. Keep both, but do not apologize to the box.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusConf.ch:
坎卜斯不需要告解, 但他喜歡記帳.{{noun}}後面的那個箱子裡塞滿了道歉字條, 配給券, 還有一張早已寫著{{openerName}}的禮物吊牌.

{{entryNameA}}是吊牌上開出的東西.{{entryNameB}}是{{authorName}}賭氣加上的. 兩樣都留著, 但別對箱子道歉.

{{survivorName}} found this journal in the gift wrap aisle. I added {{entryNameA}} beside a roll of red paper and {{entryNameB}} beside the tape. If {{openerName}} sees the chair, keep walking.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusScho.en:
The school had two lists on the bulletin board: children accounted for, children missing. Standard emergency protocol. Standard bureaucracy. Standard attempt to impose order on a situation that had stopped responding to order sometime around July 4th when the first dogs got sick and the first rumors started spreading faster than the first fever. Krampus added a third list in careful red ink. It was only adults. It was only names that had made a decision at a checkpoint, on a road, in a dark room with no witnesses. Every name had a tally beside it that didn't correspond to anything visible.

{{openerName}} does not need to know which list this journal came from. You don't need to know if I found it, if it was given to me, if I took it from someone who didn't need it anymore or from someone who needed it very much but had other priorities like breathing, like not being on any list at all, like disappearing completely which is harder than it sounds when {{omenNoun}} keeps excellent records and has a very particular filing system.

Learn {{entryNameA}}. It's useful knowledge, practical, the kind that keeps you alive. Carry {{entryNameB}}. It's heavier, more complicated, the kind of knowledge that keeps you human which is different from keeping you alive and sometimes conflicts with it. Do not laugh if bells ring from an empty classroom. The school is empty. The bells shouldn't ring. If they do, it's not Santa, it's not a holiday announcement, it's not a malfunction of the electrical system that stopped working weeks ago.

Krampus doesn't care about naughty or nice. Those are marketing terms, Santa-brand concepts, consumer-friendly binaries. Krampus cares about survival and what you do to achieve it. The lists aren't moral judgments. They're observations. They're data. They're the record of who made it through and how and whether the how was worth the what. {{openerName}} is being observed now. The page knows you're reading it. The ink is interested. Finish quickly. Move on. Try to stay off any list that requires red ink to maintain.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusScho.ch:
學校的布告欄上貼著兩張名單: 已確認下落的孩子, 失蹤的孩子. 標準的緊急應變程序. 標準的官僚作風. 標準的做法——想把秩序強加在一個早已不再理會秩序的局面上; 大約在7月4日前後, 第一批狗病倒, 第一批謠言開始傳得比第一波高燒還快的時候, 秩序就已經失靈了. 坎卜斯用工整的紅墨水添了第三張名單. 上面只有成年人. 只有那些曾在檢查哨, 在路上, 在沒有目擊者的暗室裡做過某個決定的名字. 每個名字旁邊都畫著一排計數記號, 卻對不上任何看得見的東西.

{{openerName}}不需要知道這本日記來自哪張名單. 你不需要知道它是我找到的, 還是別人給我的; 是我從一個再也用不著它的人那裡拿來的, 還是從一個非常需要它, 卻有其他優先事項的人那裡拿來的——比如呼吸, 比如壓根不出現在任何名單上, 比如徹底消失; 而徹底消失比聽起來難得多, 因為{{omenNoun}}的紀錄做得極好, 歸檔系統也非常講究.

學會{{entryNameA}}.那是有用的知識, 實用, 是能讓你活下去的那種. 帶上{{entryNameB}}.它更沉重, 更複雜, 是能讓你保住人性的那種知識——那和讓你活下去不一樣, 有時甚至彼此衝突. 如果鈴聲從空無一人的教室裡響起, 不要笑. 學校是空的. 鈴聲不該響. 要是響了, 那不是聖誕老人, 不是節慶廣播, 也不是那套幾週前就停擺的電力系統出了故障.

坎卜斯不在乎頑皮還是乖巧. 那些是行銷術語, 是聖誕老人牌的概念, 是討好消費者的二分法. 坎卜斯在乎的是生存, 以及你為了活下去做了什麼. 那些名單不是道德審判. 它們是觀察. 是資料. 是一份紀錄, 記著誰熬了過來, 是怎麼熬過來的, 以及那些手段配不配得上換來的結果.{{openerName}}現在正被觀察著. 這一頁知道你正在讀它. 墨水起了興趣. 快點讀完. 繼續前進. 盡量別上任何需要紅墨水來維護的名單.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusScho.cn:
学校的布告栏上有两个名单: 已确认下落的儿童, 失踪的儿童. 标准紧急协议. 标准的官僚作风.7 月 4 日左右的某个时候, 当第一批狗生病了, 而且第一个谣言开始比第一次发烧传播得更快时, 对一个已经不再回应秩序的局面强加秩序是标准的尝试. 坎卜斯用红色墨水小心地添加了第三个清单. 那上面只有成年人. 只有那些在检查站, 在路上, 在没有目击者的暗室里做出过决定的名字. 每个名字旁边都有一个与任何可见的东西都不对应的计数.

{{openerName}}不需要知道这本日记来自哪个名单. 你不需要知道我是否找到了它, 是否是给我的, 是否是我从不再需要它的人那里拿走的, 或者是从非常需要它但有其他优先事项的人那里拿走的, 比如呼吸, 比如根本不在任何名单上, 比如完全消失, 这比听起来更难, 因为{{omenNoun}}保留了出色的记录并拥有非常特殊的归档系统.

学习{{entryNameA}}.这是有用的知识, 实用的知识, 能让你活下去的知识. 携带{{entryNameB}}.它更重, 更复杂, 是一种让你保持人性的知识, 它不同于让你生存的知识, 有时甚至会发生冲突. 如果铃声从空荡荡的教室响起, 请不要笑. 学校空无一人. 铃声不应响起. 如果它响了, 那不是圣诞老人, 不是假期公告, 也不是几周前停止工作的电力系统故障.

坎卜斯不在乎淘气还是友善. 这些是营销术语, 圣诞老人品牌概念, 消费者友好的二元对立. 坎卜斯关心生存以及你为实现生存所做的一切. 这些清单不是道德判断. 它们是观察. 它们是数据. 它们记录了谁活了下来, 是怎么活下来的, 以及那些手段是否值得. 现在正在观察{{openerName}}.该页面知道你正在阅读它. 墨水起了兴趣. 快点读完. 继续前行. 尽量远离任何需要红墨水维护的清单.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusSkil.en:
Every bell meant practice. One ring for {{skillNameA}}, two rings for {{skillNameB}}, three rings for running before the lesson becomes personal.

{{authorName}} made it to two. {{openerName}} should not wait for three.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusSkil.ch:
每一聲鐘響都代表練習. 一響是{{skillNameA}}, 兩響是{{skillNameB}}, 三響就是要在這堂課衝著你來之前拔腿就跑.

{{authorName}}撐到了第二響.{{openerName}}別等到第三響.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusSkil.cn:
每一声钟声都意味着练习. 响一声是{{skillNameA}}, 响两声是{{skillNameB}}, 响三声就得在这堂课冲着你来之前赶紧跑.

{{authorName}}撑到了第二声.{{openerName}}不该等到第三声.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusSkil.en:
The bundle had no candy, no coal, and no apology. Only {{skillNameA}} folded around {{skillNameB}}, tied with string that felt warm through gloves.

{{openerName}} should learn both before nightfall. Krampus gives warnings in the shape of gifts because people open gifts faster.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusSkil.ch:
包裹裡沒有糖果, 沒有煤炭, 也沒有道歉. 只有{{skillNameA}}裹著{{skillNameB}}, 用一條隔著手套都覺得溫熱的繩子綁著.

{{openerName}}最好在天黑前把兩樣都學會. 坎卜斯用禮物的形狀發出警告, 因為人們拆禮物拆得比較快.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusSkil.cn:
包裹里没有糖果, 没有煤炭, 也没有道歉. 只有 {{skillNameA}} 折叠在 {{skillNameB}} 周围, 用绳子绑着, 戴着手套感觉很温暖.

{{openerName}} 应该在夜幕降临之前学习两者. 坎卜斯以礼物的形式发出警告, 因为人们打开礼物的速度更快.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusSkil.en:
{{skillNameA}} was written in coal dust across the first page. {{skillNameB}} appeared when the dust was wiped away. The table underneath stayed clean.

That is not a miracle. It is a warning with tidy hands. {{openerName}} should take the knowledge and leave the dust.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusSkil.ch:
{{skillNameA}}是用煤灰寫在第一頁上的. 把灰擦掉, {{skillNameB}}就浮現出來. 底下的桌面卻始終乾乾淨淨.

那不是奇蹟. 那是一記由整潔的手發出的警告.{{openerName}}該把知識帶走, 把灰留下.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusSkil.cn:
{{skillNameA}} 用煤粉写在第一页上. 尘埃一擦, {{skillNameB}}就出现了. 下面的桌子保持干净.

这并不是什么奇迹. 这是用干净的手发出的警告.{{openerName}}应该带走知识, 留下尘埃.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusSkil.en:
Good children listen. Living adults practice. {{authorName}} wrote {{skillNameA}} because listening stopped being enough, then added {{skillNameB}} after {{dangerNoun}} reached the porch.

If {{openerName}} wants to stay off the wrong list, usefulness is a better start than innocence.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusSkil.ch:
乖孩子聽話. 活著的大人練習.{{authorName}}寫下{{skillNameA}}, 是因為光聽話已經不夠了; 等{{dangerNoun}}上了門廊, 又補上了{{skillNameB}}.

如果{{openerName}}不想上錯名單, 從派得上用場開始, 會比從天真無邪開始更好.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusSkil.cn:
好孩子会听. 活着的成年人练习.{{authorName}} 写下了 {{skillNameA}}, 因为光听话已经不够, 然后在 {{dangerNoun}} 到达门廊后添加了 {{skillNameB}}.

如果 {{openerName}} 想要远离错误的名单, 有用性是比天真更好的开始.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusSkil.en:
The wrapping paper showed tiny sleighs circling a county map. Every route ended at the same black square. Inside, {{skillNameA}} and {{skillNameB}} were the only things not crossed out.

{{openerName}} should take that as generosity. Or threat. The difference is mostly timing.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusSkil.ch:
包裝紙上印著小小的雪橇, 繞著一張郡地圖盤旋. 每條路線的終點都是同一個黑色方塊. 裡面, 只有{{skillNameA}}和{{skillNameB}}沒被劃掉.

{{openerName}}可以把這當成慷慨. 或是威脅. 差別多半只在於時機.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusSkil.cn:
包装纸上画着小雪橇在县地图上盘旋. 每条路线的终点都是同一个黑色方块. 在里面, {{skillNameA}} 和 {{skillNameB}} 是唯一没有划掉的东西.

{{openerName}} 应该将此视为慷慨. 或者威胁. 区别主要在于时机.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusSlei.en:
The tracks behind the school were too narrow for a truck and too deep for a deer. They circled the playground seven times, then stopped at the quarantine notice like something had paused to read.

Inside the package were {{entryNameA}}, {{entryNameB}}, and a smell like old snow. {{openerName}} should use the first two and ignore the smell if it starts giving advice.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusSlei.ch:
學校後面的痕跡, 說是卡車留的又太窄, 說是鹿留的又太深. 它們繞著操場轉了七圈, 然後停在隔離公告前, 像是有什麼東西停下來讀了一會兒.

包裹裡有{{entryNameA}}, {{entryNameB}}, 還有一股陳年舊雪般的氣味.{{openerName}}用前兩樣就好; 要是那股氣味開始給你出主意, 別理它.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusSlei.cn:
学校后面的痕迹对于卡车来说太窄, 对于鹿来说又太深. 它们绕着操场转了七圈, 然后在隔离通知前停了下来, 就像有什么东西停下来阅读一样.

包裹里有{{entryNameA}}, {{entryNameB}}, 还有一股旧雪的味道.{{openerName}} 应该使用前两个, 如果气味开始提供建议, 请忽略它.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusSnow.en:
The snowman outside city hall had coal eyes, twig arms, and teeth that were not coal. Every morning it faced a different house. Every night one more window went dark.

{{authorName}} hid {{entryNameA}} in the scarf and {{entryNameB}} under the hat. {{openerName}} can take the notes, but leave the teeth. Gifts should not bite back.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusSnow.ch:
市政廳外的雪人有煤炭做的眼睛, 樹枝做的手臂, 還有一口不是煤炭的牙齒. 每天早上它都面向不同的房子. 每天晚上就又多一扇窗戶暗下去.

{{authorName}}把{{entryNameA}}藏在圍巾裡, 把{{entryNameB}}藏在帽子下.{{openerName}}可以把筆記拿走, 但牙齒留著別動. 禮物不該反咬人一口.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusSnow.cn:
市政厅外的雪人有煤炭般的眼睛, 树枝状的手臂和不是煤炭的牙齿. 每天早上它都面对着不同的房子. 每天晚上, 又有一扇窗户变暗.

{{authorName}} 将 {{entryNameA}} 藏在围巾中, 将 {{entryNameB}} 藏在帽子下.{{openerName}} 可以拿走笔记, 但把牙齿留下. 礼物不应该反噬.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusToll.en:
The toll booth kept taking payment after the road closed. Coins, teeth, wedding rings, confessions. {{authorName}} said the basket was empty every morning and full of frost by noon.

This gift passed through that booth. {{skillName}} is yours, {{recipeName}} is borrowed, and {{traitName}} may be collected later if {{omenNoun}} decides you underpaid.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusToll.ch:
道路封閉之後, 收費亭仍照收不誤. 硬幣, 牙齒, 結婚戒指, 懺悔.{{authorName}}說, 籃子每天早上都是空的, 到了中午就結滿了霜.

這份禮物就是從那個亭子過來的.{{skillName}}是你的, {{recipeName}}是借來的; 至於{{traitName}}, 要是{{omenNoun}}認定你付得不夠, 之後可能會被收走.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_KrampusToll.cn:
道路封闭后, 收费站仍继续收费. 硬币, 牙齿, 结婚戒指, 忏悔.{{authorName}}说, 每天早上篮子都是空的, 到了中午就满是霜.

这份礼物是经过那个收费亭的.{{skillName}} 是你的, {{recipeName}} 是借来的, 如果 {{omenNoun}} 判定你少付, {{traitName}} 可能会在稍后收取.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_WornBackRoa.en:
{{survivorName}} said the state roads were traps, so we followed fence lines and mailboxes until the map stopped admitting we existed. Every farmhouse had the same story: one door kicked in, one radio left on, one pot gone cold on the stove.

For {{openerName}}, the route notes are useless now, but the practice is not. Trust {{skillNameA}}, keep {{entryNameB}} dry, and never assume {{noun}} is empty just because it looks {{adjective}}.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_WornBackRoa.ch:
{{survivorName}}說州道全是陷阱, 所以我們沿著圍欄和信箱走, 走到地圖都不再承認我們存在為止. 每間農舍都是同一個故事: 一扇被踹開的門, 一台還開著的收音機, 一鍋在爐子上放涼了的東西.

對{{openerName}}來說, 這些路線筆記如今已經沒用了, 但練出來的本事還管用. 相信{{skillNameA}}, 讓{{entryNameB}}保持乾燥, 也永遠別因為{{noun}}看起來{{adjective}}, 就以為裡面是空的.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_WornBackRoa.cn:
{{survivorName}} 说州道是陷阱, 所以我们沿着栅栏线和邮箱走, 直到地图不再承认我们的存在. 每个农舍都有同样的故事: 一扇门被踢开, 一台收音机开着, 炉子上的一锅凉了.

对于{{openerName}}, 这些路线笔记现在没用了, 但练出来的本事还有用. 相信 {{skillNameA}}, 保持 {{entryNameB}} 干燥, 并且永远不要仅仅因为 {{noun}} 看起来 {{adjective}} 就认为它是空的.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_WornBirthda.en:
Somebody had a birthday during the first week and we sang because not singing felt worse. The cake was canned peaches on crackers. The candles were cigarette lighters. The wish was obvious and still did not come true.

I wrote {{entryNameA}} after the song and {{entryNameB}} after the screaming. If {{openerName}} finds this, celebrate small things quickly. They attract attention if they last too long.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_WornBirthda.ch:
第一週就有人過生日, 我們還是唱了歌, 因為不唱感覺更糟. 蛋糕是餅乾上鋪的水蜜桃罐頭. 蠟燭是打火機. 願望人人都猜得到, 卻還是沒有實現.

唱完歌我寫下了{{entryNameA}}, 尖叫過後我寫下了{{entryNameB}}.如果{{openerName}}找到了這本日記, 記得小小的慶祝要快快辦完. 拖得太久, 它們會引來注意.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_WornBirthda.cn:
有人在第一周过生日, 我们唱歌, 因为不唱歌感觉更糟. 蛋糕是放在饼干上的桃罐头. 蜡烛是打火机. 这个愿望很明显, 但仍然没有实现.

我在歌曲之后写了 {{entryNameA}}, 在尖叫之后写了 {{entryNameB}}.如果 {{openerName}} 找到了这个, 请尽快庆祝一些小事情. 如果持续时间太长, 它们就会引起注意.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_WornChurchB.en:
The church basement filled before the sanctuary did. People trusted concrete more than stained glass once {{dangerNoun}} reached the steps, and the preacher traded sermons for inventory lists by candlelight.

{{authorName}} wrote these pages beside {{stashNoun}} while the radio upstairs promised order. Keep {{entryNameA}} close, copy {{entryNameB}} if the page tears, and remember that locked doors make neighbors honest.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_WornChurchB.ch:
教堂的地下室比正殿先擠滿了人. 自從{{dangerNoun}}爬上台階, 人們對混凝土的信任就勝過了彩繪玻璃, 牧師也在燭光下不再講道, 改列物資清單.

{{authorName}}在{{stashNoun}}旁寫下這些書頁, 樓上的收音機還在保證秩序終將恢復. 把{{entryNameA}}帶在身邊; 書頁要是破了, 就把{{entryNameB}}抄一份; 還要記住, 鎖上的門能讓鄰居保持誠實.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_WornChurchB.cn:
教堂的地下室在圣所之前就被填满了. 当 {{dangerNoun}} 到达台阶时, 人们更信任混凝土而不是彩色玻璃, 传教士在烛光下把布道换成了物资清单.

{{authorName}} 在 {{stashNoun}} 旁边写下了这些书页, 而楼上的收音机仍在承诺秩序. 把 {{entryNameA}} 带在身边, 如果书页撕破就抄一份 {{entryNameB}}, 并记住锁上的门能让邻居诚实.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_WornClinic.en:
The clinic smelled like bleach, sweat, and lies. They told us the bites were panic injuries. They told us the fever was stress. They told us the coughing people in the back room were being transferred to Louisville for better care, but the ambulance never moved and the drivers sat in the cab playing cards for six hours until they stopped playing cards and started screaming.

{{authorName}} wrote these notes between shifts because hands need something to do when belief runs out. {{traitName}} kept me useful when the clinic stopped having supplies and started having debates about who deserved the last morphine. I didn't win the debate. I just kept working. {{traitName}} makes you keep working even when working feels pointless.

Use {{skillNameA}} first. Use {{skillNameB}} if supplies hold. Do not let {{traitName}} make you generous with masks, with gloves, with the last of anything. Generosity is a luxury for people who aren't counting days in water bottles and hours in daylight. Be practical. Be alive. Be the person who knows {{skillNameA}} well enough to do it in the dark, because the dark is coming and it doesn't care about your good intentions.

The doctor I worked with had good intentions. He was going to save everyone. He was going to write a book about it afterward, about how we persevered, about the human spirit, about lessons learned. He stopped writing in his journal on July 14th. I found it in his locker. The last entry was about a child he couldn't save. I burned it. Some stories don't need to be told. Some stories just need to end.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_WornClinic.ch:
診所裡瀰漫著漂白水, 汗水和謊言的氣味. 他們告訴我們, 那些咬傷是恐慌造成的. 他們告訴我們, 發燒是壓力所致. 他們告訴我們, 後面房間裡那些咳嗽的人正要轉送到路易斯維爾接受更好的照護, 但救護車從沒動過, 司機們坐在駕駛室裡打了六個小時的牌, 直到他們不再打牌, 開始尖叫.

{{authorName}}在輪班的空檔寫下這些筆記, 因為當信念耗盡時, 雙手總得找點事做. 當診所不再有物資, 開始爭論誰才配得到最後一劑嗎啡時, 是{{traitName}}讓我還有點用處. 我沒有贏得那場爭論. 我只是繼續工作.{{traitName}}會讓你即使覺得工作毫無意義, 也仍然繼續工作.

先用{{skillNameA}}.如果物資撐得住, 再用{{skillNameB}}.別讓{{traitName}}使你對口罩, 手套, 或任何僅存的東西太過大方. 慷慨是一種奢侈, 只屬於那些不必用水瓶計算日子, 用日光計算時間的人. 務實一點. 活下去. 做那個把{{skillNameA}}練到能在黑暗中操作的人, 因為黑暗就要來了, 而它不在乎你的善意.

和我共事的那位醫生心懷善意. 他要拯救所有人. 他打算事後寫一本書, 寫我們如何撐過來, 寫人性的光輝, 寫學到的教訓.7月14日, 他的日記停筆了. 我在他的置物櫃裡找到了它. 最後一篇寫的是一個他救不回來的孩子. 我把它燒了. 有些故事不需要被講述. 有些故事只需要結束.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_WornClinic.cn:
诊所里充满了漂白剂, 汗水和谎言的味道. 他们告诉我们这些咬伤是恐慌造成的. 他们告诉我们发烧是压力造成的. 他们告诉我们, 后面房间里咳嗽的人正被转移到路易斯维尔以获得更好的护理, 但救护车从未移动过, 司机们坐在驾驶室里打牌了六个小时, 直到他们停止打牌并开始尖叫.

{{authorName}} 在轮班之间写下这些笔记, 因为当信念耗尽时, 双手需要做点什么. 当诊所停止供应并开始争论谁应该获得最后吗啡时, {{traitName}} 让我继续发挥作用. 我没有赢得辩论. 我只是继续工作.{{traitName}} 让你即使在感觉工作毫无意义的情况下也能继续工作.

先使用{{skillNameA}}.如果供应充足, 请使用 {{skillNameB}}.别让{{traitName}}让你在口罩, 手套或任何仅存的东西上太过大方. 对于那些不计算水瓶里的日子和白天的时间的人来说, 慷慨是一种奢侈. 务实一点. 活着. 做一个足够了解{{skillNameA}}的人, 在黑暗中做这件事, 因为黑暗即将来临, 它不会在乎你的善意.

和我一起工作的医生是出于好意. 他要拯救所有人. 之后他打算写一本关于这件事的书, 关于我们如何坚持下去, 关于人类精神, 关于吸取的教训.7 月 14 日, 他停止写日记. 我在他的储物柜里找到了它. 最后一篇文章是关于一个他无法拯救的孩子. 我把它烧了. 有些故事不需要讲. 有些故事只是需要结束.

We pinned the county map to drywall and stabbed it full of guesses. Red for blocked roads, blue for water, black for places nobody came back from. By Friday, black was winning.

{{authorName}} wrote what the map could not. {{entryNameA}} is for moving, {{entryNameB}} is for stopping, and {{traitName}} is for knowing which one you are doing before {{dangerNoun}} decides for you.

{{authorName}}寫下了地圖無法呈現的東西.{{entryNameA}}是為了移動, {{entryNameB}}是為了停下, 而{{traitName}}則是為了在{{dangerNoun}}替你做決定之前, 先知道自己正在做的是哪一件.

我们把县地图钉在干墙上, 并在上面充满了猜测. 红色代表道路堵塞, 蓝色代表水, 黑色代表没有人回来的地方. 到周五, 黑色占了上风.

{{authorName}} 写了地图上写不到的东西.{{entryNameA}}用于移动, {{entryNameB}}用于停止, {{traitName}}用于在{{dangerNoun}}为你决定之前知道你在做什么.

公交车站成了那些差点离开的人的去处. 行李箱仍然装满, 票留在口袋里, 每个时刻表都坚持说另一趟班车就要发车了.{{survivorName}} 对此大笑, 直到自动售货机旁的 {{noun}} {{verb}}.

The diner stayed open longer than sense allowed. Coffee made people brave, pancakes made them human, and the bell over the door made everyone reach for something sharp. {{survivorName}} kept saying normal would come back hungry.

It did not. I left {{skillName}} in the margin beside the old specials and folded {{recipeName}} into the register tape. If {{openerName}} finds the place, do not eat anything from the fridge unless you enjoy regret.

這家餐館營業得比理智所允許的還要久. 咖啡讓人變得勇敢, 鬆餅讓人找回人樣, 而門上的鈴鐺讓每個人都伸手去摸利器.{{survivorName}}一直說, 正常的日子會餓著肚子回來.

它沒有回來. 我把{{skillName}}寫在舊特餐單旁的空白處, 把{{recipeName}}摺進了收銀機的紙捲裡. 如果{{openerName}}找到了這個地方, 別吃冰箱裡的任何東西, 除非你喜歡後悔的滋味.

So {{authorName}} wrote down {{skillNameA}} and {{skillNameB}} instead. They're less polite than speeches, less inspiring than broadcasts, but {{openerName}} may find them more useful when the radio stops playing music and starts playing the emergency broadcast on a loop, and then stops playing anything at all.

The radio was my friend for the first week. It told me what was happening in Louisville, what the military was saying, what the President was saying, what the CDC was saying. Then it told me the same things on repeat. Then it told me static. Then it told me something else, something that wasn't any station I recognized, speaking in a voice that knew my name. I turned it off. I haven't turned it on since.

{{skillNameA}} and {{skillNameB}} don't need batteries. They don't need signals. They don't know your name. They're just skills, sitting on the page, waiting for hands to try them. Try them.

The recipe for {{recipeName}} is on page four, written in the margin because the main page was full of inventory numbers that don't matter anymore.

{{recipeName}} kept us eating when the canned goods ran out. It's not delicious. It's food. There's a difference. Delicious is for people who have choices. Food is for people who have hunger. UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideMal.en:
The mall music never stopped. That was the worst part. It played over broken glass, over evacuation notices being read by people who didn't believe them, over the food court full of chairs pushed against doors that wouldn't hold, over the sound of {{dangerNoun}} learning that escalators go both ways and food courts have multiple entrances. The song wished us joy while we waited for the joy to run out along with the food, the water, the hope that someone was coming to restore order because that's what the second verse promised, something about peace on earth, which was a lie, which had always been a lie, which was just now more obvious.

{{survivorName}} laughed once because the absurdity was too much to hold. We were going to die to the sound of a choir singing about winter wonderlands while the actual winter outside was full of teeth and the wonderland was just Kentucky with fewer people and more things that used to be people. I didn't laugh. I was busy writing {{skillNameA}} on a receipt from a store that sold electronics nobody could power anymore. I was busy folding {{recipeName}} into the pages of a holiday catalog that showed families eating turkey dinners in houses with intact windows.

I left the notes in a gift box because boxes are for keeping things safe, even when the things inside aren't safe, even when the safety is temporary, even when the box is just cardboard that will dissolve in rain or blood or the damp of a basement where {{openerName}} might find it months from now when the holiday is just a date and the music has finally stopped either because the power died or because someone found the speakers and did what needed to be done.

If {{openerName}} finds batteries for the mall speaker, turn it off. Don't listen to the songs. They're haunted now, not by ghosts but by memory, by the weight of knowing what those songs meant before and what they mean now and how much space there is between those two meanings. Fill the space with {{skillNameA}}. Fill it with the knowledge that you are still here, still reading, still capable of learning what someone else knew. That's the gift. That's the only gift that matters when the wrapping is torn and the boxes are empty and the season of giving has become the season of taking whatever you can carry.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideMal.ch:
商場的音樂從來沒有停過. 那是最糟的部分. 它蓋過碎玻璃聲, 蓋過由不相信內容的人唸出來的疏散通知, 蓋過美食街裡整排抵著撐不住的門的椅子, 蓋過 {{dangerNoun}} 弄懂手扶梯其實雙向都能走, 弄懂美食街有好幾個入口時的動靜. 那首歌祝我們喜樂, 而我們正等著喜樂連同食物和飲水一起耗盡, 等著那個以為會有人來恢復秩序的希望也一併耗盡, 因為那是第二段歌詞的承諾, 什麼人間和平之類的, 而那是謊言, 從頭到尾都是謊言, 只是現在更明顯了而已.

{{survivorName}} 笑了一次, 因為這荒謬沉重得讓人撐不住. 我們就要在唱詩班歌頌冬日仙境的歌聲裡死去, 而外頭真正的冬天滿是牙齒, 所謂仙境不過就是肯塔基, 只是人變少了, 曾經是人的東西變多了. 我沒有笑. 我正忙著把 {{skillNameA}} 寫在一張收據背面, 開收據的那家店賣的電子產品, 已經沒有人有電可以用了. 我正忙著把 {{recipeName}} 夾進一本節日型錄, 型錄上印著一個個家庭在窗戶完好無缺的房子裡吃著火雞大餐.

我把這些筆記放進一個禮物盒, 因為盒子就是用來保護東西的, 即使裡面的東西並不安全, 即使那份安全只是暫時的, 即使盒子不過是一塊紙板, 遲早會在雨水, 血水, 或某間地下室的潮氣裡爛掉, 而 {{openerName}} 也許會在幾個月後在那裡找到它, 到那時節日只剩下一個日期, 音樂也終於停了, 不是因為斷電, 就是因為有人找到了喇叭, 做了該做的事.

如果 {{openerName}} 找到能讓商場喇叭響起來的電池, 把它關掉. 別聽那些歌. 它們如今在鬧鬼, 纏著它們的不是亡魂, 而是記憶, 是那份重量: 你知道那些歌從前是什麼意思, 也知道它們現在是什麼意思, 更知道這兩種意思之間隔著多大的距離. 用 {{skillNameA}} 把那段距離填滿. 用這個事實填滿它: 你還在這裡, 還在閱讀, 還有能力學會別人曾經懂得的事. 那就是禮物. 當包裝被撕破, 盒子空了, 給予的季節變成了能拿什麼就拿什麼的季節, 那就是唯一還重要的禮物.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideMal.cn:
商场里的音乐从未停止过. 那是最糟糕的部分. 它在破碎的玻璃上播放, 在不相信的人读到的疏散通知上播放, 在美食广场上摆满了椅子推到无法固定的门上, 在{{dangerNoun}}学习自动扶梯是双向的以及美食广场有多个入口的声音中播放. 当我们等待欢乐连同食物, 水一起耗尽时, 这首歌祝愿我们快乐, 希望有人会来恢复秩序, 因为这就是第二节所承诺的, 关于地球和平的东西, 这是一个谎言, 一直是一个谎言, 现在更加明显.

{{survivorName}}笑了一次, 因为荒唐到了难以忍受的地步. 我们快要被唱诗班唱着冬季仙境的声音淹没了, 而外面真正的冬天却充满了牙齿, 而仙境只是肯塔基州, 人少了, 曾经是人的东西却多了. 我没有笑. 我正忙着在一家商店的收据上写下“{{skillNameA}}”, 这家商店出售的电子产品无人能再供电. 我正忙着将 {{recipeName}} 折叠成假日目录的页面, 其中显示家庭在窗户完好无损的房子里吃火鸡晚餐.

我把纸条放在礼品盒里, 因为盒子是用来保证东西安全的, 即使里面的东西不安全, 即使安全是暂时的, 即使盒子只是会溶解在雨水或血液中的纸板, 或者地下室的潮湿, {{openerName}}可能会在几个月后发现它, 那时假期只是一个约会, 音乐最终停止了, 要么是因为停电, 要么是因为有人找到了扬声器并做了需要做的事情.

如果 {{openerName}} 找到商场扬声器的电池, 请将其关闭. 不要听歌曲. 它们现在被困扰, 不是被鬼魂, 而是被记忆, 被知道这些歌曲以前的含义和现在的含义以及这两种含义之间有多少空间的重量所困扰. 用 {{skillNameA}} 填充该空间. 用你还在这里, 仍在阅读, 仍然有能力学习别人所知道的知识来填充它. 这就是礼物. 当包装被撕破, 盒子空了, 送礼的季节变成了拿走任何你能携带的东西的季节时, 这是唯一重要的礼物.

{{authorName}} left these notes because faith and preparation are not enemies. {{entryNameA}} is practical. {{entryNameB}} is kind. {{openerName}} should try both before deciding which one failed.

{{authorName}} 留下這些筆記, 是因為信仰和準備並不是敵人. {{entryNameA}} 很實用. {{entryNameB}} 很仁慈. {{openerName}} 應該兩樣都先試過, 再來判斷辜負你的是哪一樣.

{{authorName}} 留下这些笔记是因为信念和准备不是敌人.{{entryNameA}}很实用.{{entryNameB}} 很友善.{{openerName}} 应该在决定哪一个失败之前尝试两者.

I wrapped {{entryNameA}} because {{openerName}} might deserve a chance. I wrapped {{entryNameB}} because deserving stopped being the measure once the snow turned red.

我把 {{entryNameA}} 包了起來, 因為 {{openerName}} 也許值得一次機會. 我把 {{entryNameB}} 也包了起來, 因為自從雪變紅之後, 值不值得就不再是衡量的標準了.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideNau.cn:

我包装了 {{entryNameA}} 因为 {{openerName}} 可能值得一个机会. 我包装了 {{entryNameB}}, 因为一旦雪变红, 应得的就不再是衡量标准了.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletidePos.en:
The post office kept receiving letters after nobody delivered them. Cards to grandparents, bills, one envelope addressed to Santa in a child's red marker. The dead did not care about mail, which made them poor citizens.

I tucked {{skillName}} and {{recipeName}} behind the sorting bins. If {{openerName}} finds the red envelope, leave it closed. Some wishes deserve privacy.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletidePos.ch:

我把 {{skillName}} 和 {{recipeName}} 塞在分信櫃後面. 如果 {{openerName}} 找到那個紅色的信封, 別拆開它. 有些願望值得保有隱私.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletidePos.cn:

我把 {{skillName}} 和 {{recipeName}} 塞在分拣箱后面. 如果 {{openerName}} 找到那个红色的信封, 别拆开它. 有些愿望值得保有隐私.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideRad.en:
A carol played over the emergency band for eleven minutes before a man cut in and begged someone to let his family through the fence at the checkpoint. He had the right papers, he said. He had the stamps, the signatures, the proof that they weren't sick, weren't exposed, weren't any threat to containment. Then the song started again from the first verse like nothing had happened, like no one had been begging, like the music was more important than the voice or the voice had never been there at all or the voice had been part of the song, another instrument, another note in the arrangement.

Santa heard it. So did {{authorName}}. So did {{dangerNoun}}, who don't celebrate holidays but do recognize patterns, do respond to sound, do gather where the music is loudest because the living gather there too, trying to hear, trying to know, trying to feel normal for the length of a song they remember from before the smell came, before the phones died, before the fences went up and the world got small and dangerous and full of teeth.

The gift for {{openerName}} is {{skillNameA}}, which is practical, and {{recipeName}}, which is comforting in a way that music used to be comforting, in the way that warm food and full bellies used to be comforting. There's advice too: turn the dial if the music knows your name. If the carol seems to be addressing you directly, if the lyrics change to include details they shouldn't know, if the third verse mentions your mother's name or your childhood address or the thing you did at the roadblock that you haven't told anyone about - turn it off. Unplug the radio. Remove the batteries. Break the antenna if you have to.

The music is supposed to be a signal that help exists, that order persists, that someone is still broadcasting and therefore someone is still receiving and therefore the connection between people hasn't been completely severed. But the Knox Event changed what broadcasts mean. Changed what signals are for. The music might be bait. The music might be a trap dressed in nostalgia. The music might be {{omenNoun}} learning to sing. Take the gift of {{skillNameA}} and {{recipeName}} and be careful what you listen to. Not all carols are holy. Not all presents are freely given. Not all silence is safe, but some silences are safer than the wrong kind of sound.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideRad.ch:
一首頌歌在緊急頻段上播了十一分鐘, 然後一個男人插了進來, 哀求有人放他的家人通過檢查站的圍欄. 他說, 他有正確的文件. 他有印章, 有簽名, 有能證明他們沒生病, 沒有暴露, 對封鎖隔離毫無威脅的證據. 然後那首歌又從第一段重新開始, 彷彿什麼都沒發生過, 彷彿沒有人哀求過, 彷彿音樂比那個聲音更重要, 或者那個聲音從來就不存在, 又或者那個聲音本來就是歌曲的一部分——另一件樂器, 編曲裡的另一個音符.

聖誕老人聽見了.{{authorName}}也聽見了.{{dangerNoun}}也聽見了——它們不過節, 卻懂得辨認模式, 會對聲音起反應, 會聚集在音樂最響亮的地方, 因為活人也聚集在那裡, 想聽清楚, 想弄明白, 想在一首歌的長度裡感覺自己還正常——那是他們記憶中的歌, 來自那股氣味出現之前, 電話斷訊之前, 圍欄立起之前, 來自世界變得狹小, 危險, 滿是利齒之前.

給{{openerName}}的禮物是{{skillNameA}}, 它很實用; 還有{{recipeName}}, 它帶來的安慰, 就像音樂曾經帶來的安慰, 就像熱食與飽足曾經帶來的安慰. 另外還有一句忠告: 如果音樂知道你的名字, 就轉開旋鈕. 如果頌歌似乎在直接對你說話, 如果歌詞變了, 多出它們不該知道的細節, 如果第三段唱出你母親的名字, 你童年的住址, 或你在路障那裡做過, 卻從未告訴任何人的那件事——關掉它. 拔掉收音機的插頭. 取出電池. 必要的話, 折斷天線.

音樂本該是一種訊號, 代表救援存在, 秩序仍在, 代表有人還在廣播, 因此有人還在接收, 因此人與人之間的連結尚未完全斷絕. 但諾克斯事件改變了廣播的意義. 改變了訊號的用途. 音樂可能是誘餌. 音樂可能是披著懷舊外衣的陷阱. 音樂可能是{{omenNoun}}在學著唱歌. 收下{{skillNameA}}和{{recipeName}}這份禮物, 並小心你所聆聽的東西. 並非所有頌歌都神聖. 並非所有禮物都是白白給的. 並非所有寂靜都安全, 但有些寂靜, 比錯誤的聲音安全得多.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideRad.cn:
一首颂歌在紧急频段上播放了十一分钟, 然后一名男子插了进来, 恳求有人让他的家人穿过检查站的栅栏. 他说, 他有正确的文件. 他有印章, 签名, 证明他们没有生病, 没有暴露, 对封锁隔离没有任何威胁. 然后这首歌又从第一节开始, 就像什么都没发生过, 就像没有人乞求过, 就像音乐比声音更重要, 或者声音根本不存在, 或者声音已经成为歌曲的一部分, 另一种乐器, 编曲中的另一个音符.

圣诞老人听到了.{{authorName}} 也是如此.{{dangerNoun}}也是如此, 他们不庆祝节日, 但确实识别模式, 确实对声音做出反应, 确实聚集在音乐最响亮的地方, 因为活着的人也聚集在那里, 试图听到, 试图了解, 试图在一首歌的长度里感觉正常——那是他们记忆中的歌, 来自气味到来之前, 电话没电之前, 栅栏升起之前, 世界变得狭小, 危险和充满牙齿之前.

送给{{openerName}}的礼物是{{skillNameA}}, 它很实用, 还有{{recipeName}}, 它让人感到安慰, 就像音乐曾经让人感到安慰一样, 就像温暖的食物和饱腹的感觉曾经让人感到安慰一样. 还有建议: 如果音乐知道你的名字, 请转动旋钮. 如果颂歌似乎直接对你说话, 如果歌词更改为包含他们不应该知道的细节, 如果第三节提到你母亲的名字或你童年的地址或你在路障那里所做的, 却没有告诉任何人的事情 - 将其关闭. 拔掉收音机的插头. 取出电池. 如有必要, 请折断天线.

音乐应该是一种信号, 表明帮助存在, 秩序持续存在, 有人仍在广播, 因此有人仍在接收, 因此人与人之间的联系还没有完全切断. 但诺克斯事件改变了广播的含义. 改变了信号的用途. 音乐可能是诱饵. 音乐可能是一个披着怀旧气息的陷阱. 音乐可能是{{omenNoun}}在学着唱歌. 接受 {{skillNameA}} 和 {{recipeName}} 的礼物, 小心你听到的内容. 并非所有颂歌都是神圣的. 并非所有礼物都是免费赠送的. 并非所有的沉默都是安全的, 但有些沉默比错误的声音更安全.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideRoo.en:
The rooftop lights came on by timer every night even after the family vanished. They blinked red, green, red, green, inviting every hungry thing on the block to admire the season.

{{authorName}} climbed up to cut the cord and found this journal under the shingles. I added {{entryNameA}} because survival needs maintenance, and {{entryNameB}} because beauty is dangerous when it glows.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideRoo.ch:
即使那家人消失之後, 屋頂的燈每晚仍會按定時器亮起. 紅, 綠, 紅, 綠地閃爍著, 邀請街區裡每一個飢餓的東西前來欣賞佳節.

{{authorName}}爬上去剪斷電線, 在屋瓦下發現了這本日記. 我加上了{{entryNameA}}, 因為生存需要維護; 也加上了{{entryNameB}}, 因為美麗一旦發光就變得危險.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideRoo.cn:
即使家人失踪后, 屋顶的灯每天晚上都会按定时器亮起. 它们闪烁着红, 绿, 红, 绿的光芒, 邀请街区里所有饥饿的东西来欣赏这个季节.

{{authorName}} 爬上去割断电线, 并在木瓦下发现了这本日记本. 我添加了 {{entryNameA}}, 因为生存需要维护, 添加了 {{entryNameB}}, 因为美丽发光时是危险的.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideRoo.en:
The rooftops were safer before the snow started showing footprints that led nowhere, that circled the same HVAC unit three times, that stopped at the edge and started again on the next building over without any way to cross between. Santa saw {{authorName}} leave {{supplyNoun}} under a plastic tree in the break room and call it tradition. That counts, apparently. That counts as Christmas.

For {{openerName}}, these pages are wrapped in the only paper I could find - a map of the county that is wrong now, that shows roads that are ditches and bridges that are ash and towns that are just collections of buildings where the doors don't lock because the locks were removed by people who needed the metal for other purposes. {{entryNameA}} is for surviving the cold, which is the enemy that doesn't stop, that doesn't sleep, that seeps into everything through gaps you didn't know were gaps. {{entryNameB}} is for surviving the living, who are colder than the snow in ways that don't have thermometers.

The ribbon is from the mall. I found it in a store that sold things nobody needed anymore - scented candles, decorative pillows, picture frames for family photos that would never be taken. The ribbon was in a clearance bin, which is funny because everything is clearanced now, everything is reduced to take, to use, to survive. Nothing has a price because money is just paper that isn't as useful as this paper, paper with {{skillNameA}} written on it, paper with {{recipeName}} in the margins, paper that might keep you alive when the scented candles are burned out and the decorative pillows are stuffed with straw for insulation.

Santa is a story. I know that. You know that. But stories are what we have when the facts are too cold to touch. So this is a story about a gift, about {{openerName}} finding something useful in a useless season, about the dead outside not getting in, about the cold outside not winning. It's a true story, or it will be if you make it true. Open the pages. Learn the lessons. Stay alive. That's the miracle. That's the gift. That's the whole story, right there.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideRoo.ch:
在雪地開始浮現那些腳印之前, 屋頂本來還算安全——那些腳印不通往任何地方, 繞著同一台空調主機轉了三圈, 在屋緣停住, 又在隔壁那棟樓的屋頂上重新出現, 中間卻沒有任何能跨過去的路. 聖誕老人看見{{authorName}}把{{supplyNoun}}留在休息室的塑膠聖誕樹下, 還稱之為傳統. 顯然, 這樣也算數. 這樣就算是聖誕節了.

給{{openerName}}: 這些書頁包在我唯一找得到的紙裡——一張如今已經不準的郡地圖, 上面畫的道路成了溝渠, 橋樑成了灰燼, 城鎮只剩一堆一堆的房子, 門都鎖不上, 因為鎖被那些需要金屬做其他用途的人拆走了.{{entryNameA}}是為了在寒冷中活下來——寒冷是不會停, 不會睡的敵人, 會從你不知道是縫隙的縫隙滲進一切.{{entryNameB}}是為了在活人手中活下來——他們比雪更冷, 冷得沒有溫度計量得出來.

緞帶來自購物中心. 我在一家賣著再也沒人需要的東西的店裡找到它——香氛蠟燭, 裝飾抱枕, 再也不會拍的全家福相框. 緞帶躺在清倉特價箱裡, 這很諷刺, 因為如今一切都在清倉, 一切都被賤價處理, 只為了拿走, 用掉, 活下去. 沒有東西還有價格, 因為錢不過是紙, 還不如這疊紙有用——寫著{{skillNameA}}的紙, 頁邊記著{{recipeName}}的紙, 在香氛蠟燭燒盡, 裝飾抱枕被塞進稻草充當隔熱材料之後, 還可能讓你活下去的紙.

聖誕老人是個故事. 我知道. 你也知道. 但當事實冷得無法觸碰時, 我們擁有的就只剩故事. 所以這是一個關於禮物的故事, 關於{{openerName}}在無用的季節裡找到有用的東西, 關於外頭的死者進不來, 關於外頭的寒冷贏不了. 這是個真實的故事——或者說, 只要你讓它成真, 它就會是. 翻開書頁. 學會這些教訓. 活下去. 那就是奇蹟. 那就是禮物. 整個故事, 就在這裡.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideRoo.cn:
在雪开始显出那些脚印之前, 屋顶还比较安全——那些脚印无处可去, 绕着同一个暖通空调装置转了三圈, 停在边缘, 又在下一座建筑物上重新开始, 中间没有任何可以跨越的路. 圣诞老人看到 {{authorName}} 将 {{supplyNoun}} 留在休息室的塑料树下, 并称其为传统. 显然, 这样也算数. 这就算是圣诞节了.

对于{{openerName}}, 这些页面被包裹在我能找到的唯一一张纸中——一张现在错误的县地图, 它显示道路是沟渠, 桥梁是灰烬, 城镇只是建筑物的集合, 门没有锁, 因为锁被需要金属用于其他目的的人拆除了.{{entryNameA}} 是为了在寒冷中生存, 寒冷是一个不停歇, 不睡觉, 通过你不知道是缝隙的缝隙渗透到一切的敌人.{{entryNameB}} 是为了在活人手中生存, 他们比雪还冷, 冷得没有温度计能测量.

丝带来自商场. 我在一家卖没人需要的东西的商店里找到了它——香薰蜡烛, 装饰枕头, 永远不会拍的家庭照片相框. 丝带在一个清仓箱里, 这很有趣, 因为现在所有东西都在清仓, 一切都被降价处理, 只为了拿走, 使用, 活下去. 没有什么东西有价格, 因为钱只是纸, 还没有这些纸有用——上面写着{{skillNameA}}的纸, 页边写着{{recipeName}}的纸, 当香薰蜡烛燃尽, 装饰枕头被塞满稻草用来隔热时, 还能让你活下去的纸.

圣诞老人是一个故事. 我知道. 你知道的. 但当事实冷得无法触碰时, 我们就有了故事. 所以这是一个关于礼物的故事, 关于{{openerName}}在无用的季节找到有用的东西, 关于外面的死人无法进入, 关于外面的寒冷无法获胜. 这是一个真实的故事, 或者如果你把它变成真的, 它就会是真实的. 打开页面. 吸取教训. 活着. 这就是奇迹. 这就是礼物. 这就是整个故事, 就在那里.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideShe.en:
Someone hung stockings in the shelter because children were watching. By morning, the stockings held ration crackers, loose nails, and one note from {{survivorName}} asking Santa to bring the phones back.

I could not manage that. I could manage {{entryNameA}} and {{entryNameB}}. If {{openerName}} finds these pages, give someone else the warm corner when you can afford it.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideShe.ch:
有人在避難所裡掛起了聖誕襪, 因為孩子們在看. 到了早上, 襪子裡裝著口糧餅乾, 幾根零散的釘子, 還有一張{{survivorName}}寫的字條, 求聖誕老人把電話帶回來.

那個我辦不到. 我辦得到的是{{entryNameA}}和{{entryNameB}}.如果{{openerName}}找到這些書頁, 在你負擔得起的時候, 把溫暖的角落讓給別人吧.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideShe.cn:
有人在避难所里挂了长袜, 因为孩子们在旁边看着. 到了早上, 袜子里装着口粮饼干, 零散的钉子, 还有 {{survivorName}} 写的一张纸条, 求圣诞老人把电话带回来.

我无法做到那一点. 我能做到的是 {{entryNameA}} 和 {{entryNameB}}.如果 {{openerName}} 找到这些页面, 请在你负担得起的情况下将温暖的角落留给其他人.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.en:
Nice people share food. Useful people share knowledge. {{authorName}} tried to be both and wrote {{skillNameA}} while the house smelled like smoke.

The page on {{skillNameB}} is the better gift. {{openerName}} should take it without guilt. Surviving can be polite later.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.ch:
善良的人分享食物. 有用的人分享知識.{{authorName}}想兩者兼顧, 於是在滿屋煙味中寫下了{{skillNameA}}.

關於{{skillNameB}}的那一頁是更好的禮物.{{openerName}}拿走它就是, 不必內疚. 活下來之後, 再講禮貌也不遲.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.cn:
好人分享食物. 有用的人分享知识.{{authorName}} 试图两者兼而有之, 并在房子闻起来有烟味时写下了 {{skillNameA}}.

关于{{skillNameB}}的那一页是更好的礼物.{{openerName}}应该毫无愧疚地接受它. 幸存下来以后才能有礼貌.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.en:
The ribbon is mostly for morale, and morale is mostly for people who haven't learned that decorations are just targets that sparkle. The real gift is {{skillNameA}}, written carefully enough for cold fingers to follow, and {{skillNameB}}, written twice because winter makes ink stubborn and survivors need redundancy.

{{openerName}} should open this before the candles burn low. A practical lesson is still a present. The paper is wrapping paper, salvaged from the mall that played carols over the sound of barricades being constructed, over the screams of people who thought holiday sales were still happening, over the slow realization that the emergency broadcast had replaced "Jingle Bells" and nobody was coming to fix it.

{{authorName}} called it a poor holiday. I call it honest. Last year there was too much, too many gifts, too much food, too much certainty that next year would be the same. This year there is {{skillNameA}}, there is {{skillNameB}}, there is the knowledge that someone cared enough to write them down before the cold or the dead or the despair took them away. That is enough. That is more than enough. That is abundance measured in usefulness instead of calories.

If {{openerName}} survives because of what is in these pages, the gift worked. Santa didn't deliver it. The elves didn't manufacture it in a workshop at the North Pole. A person wrote it, a person who was cold and scared and probably dying, a person who still thought the future deserved a chance to know things. That person was the miracle. These skills are just the proof.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.ch:
緞帶主要是為了士氣, 而士氣主要是給那些還沒學到「裝飾品只是會閃閃發光的靶子」的人. 真正的禮物是{{skillNameA}}——寫得夠仔細, 凍僵的手指也能照著做; 還有{{skillNameB}}——寫了兩遍, 因為冬天讓墨水變得倔強, 而倖存者需要備份.

{{openerName}}應該在蠟燭燒短之前打開它. 一堂實用的課依然是一份禮物. 這紙是包裝紙, 從購物中心搶救回來的——那裡的頌歌蓋過了搭建路障的聲響, 蓋過了還以為節慶特賣仍在進行的人們的尖叫, 蓋過了眾人慢慢意識到緊急廣播已經取代《聖誕鈴聲》, 而且不會有人來修好這一切的過程.

{{authorName}}說這是個寒酸的節日. 我說這叫誠實. 去年什麼都太多——太多禮物, 太多食物, 太多「明年也會一樣」的篤定. 今年有{{skillNameA}}, 有{{skillNameB}}, 有這樣一份認知: 在寒冷, 死亡或絕望帶走他們之前, 有人在乎得願意把這些寫下來. 這就夠了. 這遠遠不止夠了. 這是用實用性而非熱量來衡量的富足.

如果{{openerName}}因為這些書頁裡的內容而活了下來, 這份禮物就成功了. 它不是聖誕老人送來的. 也不是精靈在北極的工坊裡製造的. 寫下它的是一個人——一個又冷又怕, 大概快要死去的人, 一個仍然認為未來值得有機會知道這些事的人. 那個人才是奇蹟. 這些技能只是證明.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.cn:
丝带主要是为了士气, 而士气主要是为了那些还不知道装饰品只是闪闪发光的目标的人. 真正的礼物是{{skillNameA}}, 写得足够仔细, 足以让冰冷的手指跟随, 而{{skillNameB}}, 写了两次, 因为冬天使墨水顽固, 幸存者需要冗余.

{{openerName}} 应该在蜡烛烧低之前打开它. 实践课仍然是一份礼物. 这张纸是包装纸, 是从商场里回收来的, 商场里播放着颂歌, 盖过了修建路障的声音, 盖过了以为节日销售仍在进行的人们的尖叫声, 盖过了人们慢慢意识到紧急广播已经取代了《铃儿响叮当》, 而没有人会来修复它的过程.

{{authorName}} 称这是一个糟糕的假期. 我称之为诚实. 去年有太多东西——太多的礼物, 太多的食物, 太多“明年也会一样”的确定. 今年有{{skillNameA}}, 有{{skillNameB}}, 有这样一份认知: 在寒冷, 死亡或绝望带走他们之前, 有人足够在乎, 把它们写了下来. 这就够了. 这已经足够了. 这是用有用性而不是卡路里来衡量的丰富性.

如果 {{openerName}} 由于这些页面中的内容而幸存下来, 那么这份礼物就起作用了. 圣诞老人没有送来. 精灵们并不是在北极的工厂里制造它的. 写下它的是一个人, 一个寒冷, 害怕, 可能快要死的人, 一个仍然认为未来应该有机会了解事情的人. 那个人就是奇迹. 这些技能只是证明.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.en:
Snow makes every mistake visible. The footprints that lead nowhere and then lead back. The dropped tools that mark where panic happened. The bad routes that circle the same {{noun}} three times before the person realizes they're walking in their own tracks. The panic circles around {{noun}} that show exactly where hope failed and instinct took over.

{{authorName}} learned {{skillNameA}} by watching what the snow accused them of doing wrong. Every error preserved in white, every misjudgment saved for review, every wrong turn frozen in place until spring or until the dead found the trail and added their own tracks to the record. The snow is an honest witness. The snow does not forget. The snow shows {{openerName}} exactly what happened here, and if {{openerName}} is smart, they will read the snow before they add their own story to it.

{{skillNameB}} came after dark, when the snow stopped being a teacher and started being a blanket that covered sounds and shapes and the difference between a bush and a person standing very still. I learned it by firelight in a house that wasn't mine, using tools that belonged to someone who wouldn't need them anymore, following instructions that were missing steps but had extra warnings that turned out to be more important than the missing steps.

Winter doesn't care about the holiday. December 25th is just another day when the sun sets early and the cold seeps through walls and the dead don't shiver because they don't feel anything. But people care. People need markers, need reasons to keep going, need to pretend that the calendar still means something even when the days blur together into survival. {{skillNameA}} and {{skillNameB}} are reasons. They're proof that someone was here, that someone knew things, that someone wanted you to know things too.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.ch:
雪讓每一個錯誤都無所遁形. 那些不通往任何地方, 然後又折返的腳印. 那些標記出恐慌發生地點的掉落工具. 那些糟糕的路線, 繞著同一個{{noun}}轉了三圈, 走的人才發現自己一直踩在自己的足跡上. 那些繞著{{noun}}打轉的恐慌圈, 準確地標出希望在哪裡崩潰, 本能在哪裡接管.

{{authorName}}是看著雪地指控自己犯下的錯, 才學會了{{skillNameA}}.每一個失誤都以白色保存, 每一次誤判都被存檔待查, 每一個走錯的彎都凍結在原地, 直到春天來臨, 或直到死者找到這條足跡, 把自己的腳印也添進紀錄裡. 雪是誠實的見證者. 雪不會忘記. 雪會準確地讓{{openerName}}看見這裡發生過什麼; 如果{{openerName}}夠聰明, 就會先讀懂雪, 再把自己的故事寫上去.

{{skillNameB}}是天黑之後才來的——那時雪不再是老師, 而成了一條毯子, 蓋住聲音, 蓋住形狀, 蓋住一叢灌木與一個站著一動也不動的人之間的差別. 我是在一間不屬於我的房子裡就著火光學會它的, 用著那些再也用不到工具的人留下的工具, 照著一份缺了步驟的說明做——但上面多出來的警告, 事後證明比缺掉的步驟更重要.

冬天不在乎節日.12 月 25 日不過是又一個太陽早早落下, 寒氣滲進牆壁的日子, 而死者不會發抖, 因為他們什麼也感覺不到. 但人在乎. 人需要標記, 需要撐下去的理由, 需要假裝日曆仍然有意義——即使日子在求生中糊成一片.{{skillNameA}}和{{skillNameB}}就是理由. 它們證明有人來過這裡, 有人懂得一些事情, 有人希望你也能懂.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.cn:
雪让每一个错误都变得显而易见. 那些无处可去却又会回来的脚印. 掉落的工具标记了恐慌发生的位置. 糟糕的路线在人们意识到他们在自己的轨道上行走之前, 绕着同一个 {{noun}} 三圈. 围绕 {{noun}} 的恐慌准确地表明了希望失败和本能取而代之的地方.

{{authorName}} 通过看雪指控他们做错的事, 学会了{{skillNameA}}.每一个错误都以白色保存下来, 每一个误判都被保存以供审查, 每一个错误的转弯都被冻结在原地, 直到春天或直到死者找到踪迹并将自己的足迹添加到记录中. 雪是诚实的见证人. 雪不会忘记. 雪准确地向{{openerName}}展示了这里发生的事情, 如果{{openerName}}很聪明, 他们会在添加自己的故事之前阅读雪.

{{skillNameB}} 是在天黑之后到来的, 那时雪不再是老师, 而是开始成为一条毯子, 覆盖声音和形状, 以及灌木丛和静止不动的人之间的区别. 我在不属于我的房子里通过火光学会了它, 使用属于不再需要它们的人的工具, 遵循缺少步骤但有额外警告的说明, 这些警告比缺少的步骤更重要.

冬天不关心假期.12 月 25 日又是一天, 太阳落得很早, 寒气渗透墙壁, 死者不会发抖, 因为他们没有任何感觉. 但人们关心. 人们需要标记, 需要继续前进的理由, 需要假装日历仍然有意义, 即使日子在生存中模糊不清.{{skillNameA}} 和 {{skillNameB}} 就是理由. 它们证明有人曾在这里, 有人知道一些事情, 有人希望你也知道一些事情.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.en:
The stocking held no candy, only folded pages. {{skillNameA}} was tucked in the toe. {{skillNameB}} was pinned near the cuff with a bent safety pin.

{{authorName}} called it a poor holiday. I call it honest. If {{openerName}} survives because of it, the gift worked.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.ch:
聖誕襪裡沒有糖果, 只有摺好的書頁.{{skillNameA}}塞在襪尖裡.{{skillNameB}}用一根彎掉的安全別針別在襪口旁.

{{authorName}}說這是個寒酸的節日. 我說這叫誠實. 如果{{openerName}}因此活了下來, 這份禮物就成功了.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.cn:
袜子里没有糖果, 只有折叠的纸页.{{skillNameA}} 塞在袜尖里.{{skillNameB}} 用弯曲的安全别针别在袜口附近.

{{authorName}} 称这是一个糟糕的假期. 我称之为诚实. 如果 {{openerName}} 因此幸存下来, 那么这份礼物就起作用了.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.en:
Workshop rule: if it keeps someone alive, it is a toy for grownups. {{skillNameA}} belongs on the top shelf. {{skillNameB}} belongs near the door. Everything else is decoration.

{{openerName}} can unwrap the lesson now. No batteries required, no assembly except practice.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.ch:
工坊守則: 只要能讓人活命, 它就是大人的玩具.{{skillNameA}}該放在最上層的架子.{{skillNameB}}該放在門邊. 其他一切都只是裝飾.

{{openerName}}現在就可以拆開這堂課了. 不需要電池, 也不需要組裝——只需要練習.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.cn:
工作室规则: 如果它能让人活下去, 那它就是大人的玩具.{{skillNameA}} 属于顶层架子.{{skillNameB}} 属于靠近门的位置. 其他一切都是装饰.

{{openerName}} 现在可以拆开这堂课了. 无需电池, 除了练习之外无需组装.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSno.en:
The snowplow made it farther than the convoy. It shoved cars, luggage, and bad decisions into the ditch until the fuel died near {{noun}}. After that, winter took the road back one inch at a time.

{{openerName}} gets the useful pieces: {{skillName}} for the body, {{recipeName}} for the pot, and {{traitName}} for whatever stubborn part refuses to lie down.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSno.ch:
掃雪車比車隊走得更遠. 它把汽車, 行李和糟糕的決定通通推進溝裡, 直到燃料在{{noun}}附近耗盡. 在那之後, 冬天一寸一寸地把道路收了回去.

{{openerName}}得到的是有用的部分: {{skillName}}給身體, {{recipeName}}給鍋子, {{traitName}}則給你身上那個拒絕倒下的頑固部分.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSno.cn:
扫雪机比车队走得更远. 它将汽车, 行李和错误的决定推入沟渠, 直到 {{noun}} 附近的燃料耗尽. 此后, 冬天一寸一寸地把道路夺了回去.

{{openerName}} 获得有用的部分: {{skillName}} 给身体, {{recipeName}} 给锅, {{traitName}} 给那个拒绝躺下的顽固部分.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSou.en:
The soup kitchen kept ladling until the pot was mostly water and hope, until the ladle scraped the bottom and the sound was loud enough to make people nervous, to make them look at the door, to make them remember that hunger makes the living dangerous too, not just the dead. People said thank you like manners could keep the fever out, like please and thank you were antibodies, like gratitude was a form of PPE that you could wear over your face instead of a mask that had already been worn by someone else and never properly cleaned.

{{authorName}} wrote names on cups so the living could feel counted, so they could hold something with their identity on it even when the soup was thin and the bread was the kind that gets harder instead of softer when it sits out. The cups were from a donation drive last year, branded with a church logo and a slogan about salvation. The irony was noted but not discussed. Discussion was for people who had calories to spare on talking.

For {{openerName}}, these pages are hot soup in paper form: {{skillNameA}} first, because the body needs to be capable before the mind can be useful. {{recipeName}} second, because the mind needs to know how to feed the body even when the church donations stop and the cups run out and the only thing left is what you can make yourself from what's left in the pantries of people who don't need pantries anymore. {{traitName}} third, because surviving the holidays still counts as a miracle even when the angels are all dead and the herald angels aren't singing anything except the emergency broadcast on a loop.

If you can carry {{traitName}} without spilling it, without letting it leak out and make you vulnerable, without letting it become a burden that slows you down when you need to move - carry it. If you can't, leave it here with the cups and the names and the thin soup. Some gifts are too heavy for some people. That's not failure. That's just physics. That's just the reality of what you can hold versus what the world keeps piling on. Take what you can. Leave what you must. Keep moving. That's the gift that matters: motion, continuation, the refusal to become part of the scenery, the scenery that is increasingly full of things that don't move except to chase things that do.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSou.ch:
施粥站不停地舀著, 直到鍋裡剩下的大多是水和希望, 直到湯勺刮到鍋底, 那聲音大得讓人緊張, 讓人望向門口, 讓人想起飢餓也會讓活人變得危險——不只是死者. 人們說著謝謝, 彷彿禮貌能把熱病擋在門外, 彷彿「請」和「謝謝」是抗體, 彷彿感激是一種能罩在臉上的防護裝備, 而不是一個別人戴過, 又從來沒好好清潔過的口罩.

{{authorName}}在杯子上寫下名字, 好讓活著的人覺得自己被算在內, 好讓他們即使湯很稀, 麵包放久了只會變硬不會變軟, 也能握著一件寫有自己身分的東西. 杯子來自去年的募捐活動, 印著教會的標誌和一句關於救贖的標語. 這份諷刺大家都注意到了, 只是沒人討論. 討論是留給那些還有多餘熱量能花在說話上的人的.

給{{openerName}}: 這些書頁是紙做的熱湯: {{skillNameA}}排第一, 因為身體得先有能力, 頭腦才派得上用場.{{recipeName}}排第二, 因為頭腦得知道怎麼餵飽身體——即使教會的捐助斷了, 杯子用完了, 只剩下你能從那些再也不需要食物儲藏室的人家的儲藏室裡翻出來的東西, 自己動手做.{{traitName}}排第三, 因為就算天使全死了, 報佳音的天使除了循環播放的緊急廣播之外什麼也不唱, 能撐過節日仍然算是一樁奇蹟.

如果你能帶著{{traitName}}而不灑出來, 不讓它漏出去害你變得脆弱, 不讓它在你必須移動時成為拖慢你的負擔——那就帶上它. 如果不能, 就把它和杯子, 名字, 稀湯一起留在這裡. 有些禮物對某些人來說太重了. 那不是失敗. 那只是物理. 那只是「你拿得動多少」對上「世界不斷往你身上堆多少」的現實. 能拿的就拿. 該留的就留. 繼續前進. 那才是真正重要的禮物: 移動, 延續, 拒絕成為風景的一部分——這片風景裡, 愈來愈多的東西一動也不動, 一動起來就只為了追逐會動的東西.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSou.cn:
施粥处不停地舀着汤, 直到锅里大部分是水和希望, 直到勺子刮到锅底, 声音大得让人紧张, 让他们向门口看去, 让他们记住, 饥饿使生者也变得危险, 而不仅仅是死者. 人们说“谢谢”, 就像礼貌可以把热病挡在外面一样, 就像“请”和“谢谢”是抗体, 就像感激是一种个人防护装备, 你可以戴在脸上, 而不是别人已经戴过且从未正确清洁过的口罩.

{{authorName}} 在杯子上写上名字, 这样生者就会感到被重视, 这样即使汤很稀, 面包放在外面会变得更硬而不是更软, 他们也可以拿着带有自己身份的东西. 这些杯子来自去年的捐赠活动, 上面印有教堂标志和有关救赎的口号. 人们注意到了这一讽刺, 但没有进行讨论. 讨论是为那些有多余热量可以花在说话上的人准备的.

对于{{openerName}}, 这些页面是纸质形式的热汤: 首先是{{skillNameA}}, 因为身体需要有能力, 头脑才能有用.{{recipeName}} 其次, 因为头脑需要知道如何养活身体, 即使教堂的捐款停止了, 杯子用完了, 唯一剩下的就是你可以用那些不再需要食品储藏室的人的食品储藏室里剩下的东西来自己制作东西.{{traitName}} 第三, 因为即使天使都死了, 报佳音的天使除了循环播放的紧急广播之外什么也没唱, 在假期中幸存仍然算得上是一个奇迹.

如果你可以携带 {{traitName}} 而不会洒落它, 不会让它泄漏并让你变得脆弱, 不会让它成为你需要移动时减慢你速度的负担 - 携带它. 如果你不能, 就把它和杯子, 名字还有稀汤一起留在这儿. 有些礼物对某些人来说太重了. 那不是失败. 这只是物理学. 这就是你能持有的东西与世界不断堆积的东西的现实. 能拿的就拿. 该留的就留. 继续前进. 这就是重要的礼物: 运动, 延续, 拒绝成为风景的一部分, 风景越来越充满除了追逐移动的事物之外不移动的事物.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideToy.en:
The toy store was untouched because nobody wanted to admit children still existed. We took batteries, blankets, and one stuffed rabbit that smelled like smoke. {{noun}} {{verb}} in the back room and every music box started at once.

{{openerName}} can have the notes on {{entryNameA}} and {{entryNameB}}. Leave the toys unless you need something soft enough to remember mercy.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideToy.ch:
玩具店沒人動過, 因為沒有人願意承認孩子們還存在. 我們拿走了電池, 毯子, 還有一隻聞起來帶著煙味的絨毛兔子. 後面房間裡的{{noun}}{{verb}}, 每個音樂盒同時響了起來.

關於{{entryNameA}}和{{entryNameB}}的筆記就留給{{openerName}}.別動那些玩具, 除非你需要一件柔軟得足以讓人想起仁慈的東西.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideToy.cn:
玩具店没人动过, 因为没有人愿意承认孩子们还存在. 我们拿走了电池, 毯子, 还有一只闻起来带着烟味的毛绒兔子. 后面房间里的{{noun}}{{verb}}, 每个音乐盒都同时响了起来.

关于{{entryNameA}}和{{entryNameB}}的笔记就留给{{openerName}}.别动那些玩具, 除非你需要一件柔软得足以让人想起怜悯的东西.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideTre.en:
The tree farm smelled so normal it hurt. Pine, mud, gasoline, and somebody's old thermos coffee. We cut branches for camouflage and pretended the wreaths on the office door were not covering bullet holes.

{{survivorName}} left {{supplyNoun}} there for strangers. I left {{entryNameA}} and {{entryNameB}} for the same reason. If {{openerName}} hears bells in the rows, do not follow them.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideTre.ch:
林場的氣味平常得讓人心痛. 松樹, 泥土, 汽油, 還有某人保溫瓶裡的舊咖啡. 我們砍下樹枝拿來偽裝, 還假裝辦公室門上的花環沒有蓋住彈孔.

{{survivorName}}把{{supplyNoun}}留在那裡給陌生人. 我出於同樣的理由留下了{{entryNameA}}和{{entryNameB}}.如果{{openerName}}在樹的行列間聽見鈴聲, 千萬別跟著走.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideTre.cn:
林场的气味平常得令人心痛. 松树, 泥土, 汽油, 还有某人保温瓶里的旧咖啡. 我们砍下树枝进行伪装, 并假装办公室门上的花环没有遮住弹孔.

{{survivorName}}把{{supplyNoun}}留在那里给陌生人. 我出于同样的原因留下了{{entryNameA}}和{{entryNameB}}.如果{{openerName}}在树行间听到铃声, 千万不要跟着走.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideWor.en:
The workshop is not at the North Pole this year. It is any garage with a locked door, any kitchen with a sharp knife, any clinic with one clean bandage left. Good people make gifts out of whatever keeps someone breathing.

So here: {{entryNameA}}, {{entryNameB}}, and a little note saying {{exclamation}}. {{openerName}} can decide which part is festive.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideWor.ch:
今年的工坊不在北極. 它可以是任何一間鎖著門的車庫, 任何一間有一把利刀的廚房, 任何一間只剩一條乾淨繃帶的診所. 好人會用任何能讓人繼續呼吸的東西來做禮物.

所以這裡有: {{entryNameA}}, {{entryNameB}}, 還有一張寫著{{exclamation}}的小紙條. 哪一部分算是有節日氣氛, 就交給{{openerName}}來決定.

UI_ETW_Help_FAQ.en: <H1> FAQ <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: How do I stop/change the sound notifications? How do I resize window? <LINE> <TEXT> A: Esc -> Options -> Mod Options. There are also some other options sprinkled in there <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: How do I get trait XYZ? <LINE> <TEXT> A: Hover your mouse over UI elements. There are a lot of tooltips which explain stuff. If it's still not understandable, check sandbox tooltips. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: Text in UI overlaps, how to fix? <LINE> <TEXT> A: There are some settings in Mod Options that might help. UI is designed to try to automatically account for different font sizes, but it is DESIGNED to be used with english language and Game Options -> User Interface (UI) -> Font Size set to 16px. Different languages and font sizes might cause some overlapping despite my efforts to make it auto-resize <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: Difference between Permanent and Non-Permanent tabs? <LINE> <TEXT> A: Permanent tab shows traits that have only one direction of progression, and once you gain or lose them, they are permanent. The progression on that tab is 'Lose bad trait' -> 'Gain good trait' and anything in between. Non-Permanent tab shows traits that can be gained and lost multiple times, so progression goes 'Gain bad trait' <-> 'Lose bad trait' <-> 'Lose good trait' <-> 'Gain good trait'. Vitals tab is equivalent to 'Non-permanent' tab, but it shows only vitals-related traits as those averages can affect rate of gaining/losing other traits <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: I gained a trait but my skill levels didn't change? <LINE> <TEXT> A: Intended. Gaining a trait doesn't change your skill levels, but it changes your exp multiplier for those skills and any additional special mechanics that come with traits.
UI_ETW_Help_FAQ.ch: <H1> 常見問題 <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: 如何停止/更改聲音通知? 如何調整視窗大小? <LINE> <TEXT> A: Esc->選項->模組選項. 那裡也散布著一些其他選項 <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: 我要怎麼獲得某某特質? <LINE> <TEXT> A: 將滑鼠懸停在UI元素上. 有大量工具提示會解釋各種內容. 如果還是看不懂, 請檢視沙盒工具提示. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: UI中的文字重疊, 如何修復? <LINE> <TEXT> A: 模組選項中有一些設定可能有幫助. UI設計上會嘗試自動適應不同字型大小, 但它是以英文語言以及遊戲選項->使用者介面 (UI)->字型大小設為16px為基準設計的. 儘管我已盡力讓它自動調整大小, 不同語言和字型大小仍可能導致部分重疊. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: 永久性特質與非永久性特質分頁有什麼差別? <LINE> <TEXT> A: 永久性特質分頁顯示只有單一方向進程的特質, 一旦獲得或失去便是永久的. 該分頁的進程為「失去負面特質」-> 「獲得正面特質」以及兩者之間的所有階段. 非永久性特質分頁顯示可以反覆獲得與失去的特質, 進程為「獲得負面特質」<->「失去負面特質」<->「失去正面特質」<->「獲得正面特質」. 生命徵象分頁等同於非永久性特質分頁, 但只顯示與生命徵象相關的特質, 因為那些平均值會影響其他特質的獲得/失去速率 <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: 我獲得了特質, 但技能等級沒有改變? <LINE> <TEXT> A: 這是刻意設計. 獲得特質不會改變你的技能等級, 但會改變那些技能的經驗值倍率, 以及特質附帶的其他特殊機制.
UI_ETW_Help_FAQ.cn: <H1> 常见问题 <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: 如何停止/更改声音通知? 如何调整窗口大小? <LINE> <TEXT> A: Esc->选项->模组选项. 那里也散布着一些其他选项 <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: 我要怎么获得某某特质? <LINE> <TEXT> A: 将鼠标悬停在UI元素上. 有大量工具提示会解释各种内容. 如果还是看不懂, 请查看沙盒工具提示. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: UI中的文字重叠, 如何修复? <LINE> <TEXT> A: 模组选项中有一些设置可能有帮助. UI设计上会尝试自动适应不同字体大小, 但它是以英文语言以及游戏选项->用户界面 (UI)->字体大小设为16px为基准设计的. 尽管我已尽力让它自动调整大小, 不同语言和字体大小仍可能导致部分重叠. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: 永久特质与非永久特质页签有什么区别? <LINE> <TEXT> A: 永久特质页签显示只有单一方向进程的特质, 一旦获得或失去便是永久的. 该页签的进程为“失去负面特质”-> “获得正面特质”以及两者之间的所有阶段. 非永久特质页签显示可以反复获得与失去的特质, 进程为“获得负面特质”<->“失去负面特质”<->“失去正面特质”<->“获得正面特质”. 生命体征页签等同于非永久特质页签, 但只显示与生命体征相关的特质, 因为那些平均值会影响其他特质的获得/失去速率 <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: 我获得了特质, 但技能等级没有改变? <LINE> <TEXT> A: 这是刻意设计. 获得特质不会改变你的技能等级, 但会改变那些技能的经验值倍率, 以及特质附带的其他特殊机制.

Tooltip_CannabisEffects.en: Relaxes the mind and eases stress.
Tooltip_CannabisEffects.ch: 放鬆心神, 緩解壓力.
Tooltip_CannabisEffects.cn: 放松心神, 缓解压力.

UI_gain_smoker.en: I'm really craving a cigarette right about now...
UI_gain_smoker.ch: 我現在真的很想來根菸…
UI_gain_smoker.cn: 我现在真的很想来根烟…

UI_lost_stoner.en: Been a while since I last smoked some weed...

UI_regain_smoker.en: I feel like having a cigarette...

UI_speech_seed1.ch: 這朵花蕾裡是不是有顆種子?
UI_speech_seed1.cn: 这朵花蕾里是不是有颗种子?

UI_trait_stonerdesc.en: Does not get sleepy or hungry from smoking pot, but needs more for the same effect.
UI_trait_stonerdesc.ch: 抽大麻不會想睡也不會餓, 但要抽更多才能達到同樣效果.
UI_trait_stonerdesc.cn: 抽大麻不会想睡也不会饿, 但要抽更多才能达到同样效果.

UI_KD_BenzoAddict_desc.en: You were hooked up on benzos before the apocalypse.
UI_KD_BenzoAddict_desc.ch: 末日之前你就對苯二氮平類藥物成癮了.
UI_KD_BenzoAddict_desc.cn: 末日之前你就对苯二氮䓬类药物成瘾了.

UI_KD_BrainDamaged_desc.en: You had brain damaged. Focusing is now harder.
UI_KD_BrainDamaged_desc.ch: 你的大腦受過損傷. 現在更難集中注意力.
UI_KD_BrainDamaged_desc.cn: 你的大脑受过损伤. 现在更难集中注意力.

UI_KD_DrugKnowledge_desc.en: You are interested in drugs and made a little too much researches.
UI_KD_DrugKnowledge_desc.ch: 你對毒品很感興趣, 而且研究得有點過頭.
UI_KD_DrugKnowledge_desc.cn: 你对毒品很感兴趣, 而且研究得有点过头.

UI_KD_Huffer_desc.en: You like to sniff things that shouldn't be...
UI_KD_Huffer_desc.ch: 你喜歡吸一些本來不該吸的東西…
UI_KD_Huffer_desc.cn: 你喜欢吸一些本来不该吸的东西…

UI_KD_LightStimulantsDependant_desc.en: You took the habit of consumming low stimulant a little too much...
UI_KD_LightStimulantsDependant_desc.ch: 你養成了服用輕度興奮劑的習慣, 而且用得有點多…
UI_KD_LightStimulantsDependant_desc.cn: 你养成了服用轻度兴奋剂的习惯, 而且用得有点多…

UI_KD_OpiumAddict_desc.en: Idk how but you're addicted to raw opium
UI_KD_OpiumAddict_desc.ch: 不知怎麼的, 你對生鴉片上癮了
UI_KD_OpiumAddict_desc.cn: 不知怎么的, 你对生鸦片上瘾了

UI_KD_Tweaker_desc.ch: 你已離不開甲基安非他命.
UI_KD_Tweaker_desc.cn: 你已离不开甲基苯丙胺.

UI_item_AdamantiumSkeletonTooltip.en: Your skeleton is indestructable. Doesn't mean you are.
UI_item_AdamantiumSkeletonTooltip.ch: 你的骨骼堅不可摧. 但你可不是.
UI_item_AdamantiumSkeletonTooltip.cn: 你的骨骼坚不可摧. 但你可不是.

UI_item_PlotArmorTooltip.en: Just because you can't see it doesn't mean it's not real.
UI_item_PlotArmorTooltip.ch: 看不見不代表它不存在.
UI_item_PlotArmorTooltip.cn: 看不见不代表它不存在.

UI_options_CelerityDodgeTooltip.en: If you have the Celerity trait you will be notified when dodging a dragdown.
UI_options_CelerityDodgeTooltip.ch: 若你擁有神速特質, 閃避被拖倒時會收到通知.
UI_options_CelerityDodgeTooltip.cn: 若你拥有神速特质, 闪避被拖倒时会收到通知.

UI_options_DeadshotAmmoTooltip.en: If you have the Deadshot trait you will be notified when ammo is restored.
UI_options_DeadshotAmmoTooltip.ch: 若你擁有神射手特質, 恢復彈藥時會收到通知.
UI_options_DeadshotAmmoTooltip.cn: 若你拥有神射手特质, 恢复弹药时会收到通知.

UI_options_InvisibilityAssassinateToolti.en: If you have the Invisibility trait you will be notified when triggering an assassination.
UI_options_InvisibilityAssassinateToolti.ch: 若你擁有隱形特質, 觸發暗殺時會收到通知.
UI_options_InvisibilityAssassinateToolti.cn: 若你拥有隐形特质, 触发暗杀时会收到通知.

UI_options_PopClawsTooltip.en: If you have the Adamantium trait you will be notified when claws are extended.
UI_options_PopClawsTooltip.ch: 若你擁有亞德曼合金特質, 伸出利爪時會收到通知.
UI_options_PopClawsTooltip.cn: 若你拥有艾德曼合金特质, 伸出利爪时会收到通知.

UI_options_TelekinesisPushTooltip.en: If you have the Telekenisis trait you will be notified when pushing a zombie back.
UI_options_TelekinesisPushTooltip.ch: 若你擁有念力特質, 推開殭屍時會收到通知.
UI_options_TelekinesisPushTooltip.cn: 若你拥有念力特质, 推开僵尸时会收到通知.

UI_trait_AdamantiumDesc.en:
Start with an indestructable adamantium skeleton.
Pop adamantium claws when attacking unarmed.
UI_trait_AdamantiumDesc.ch:
開局即擁有堅不可摧的亞德曼合金骨骼.
徒手攻擊時彈出亞德曼合金爪.
UI_trait_AdamantiumDesc.cn:
开局即拥有坚不可摧的艾德曼合金骨骼.
徒手攻击时弹出艾德曼合金爪.

UI_trait_CelerityDesc.en:
Superhuman speed and reaction time.
Faster combat and recovery animations.
Faster movement and timed actions.
Chance to dodge zombie attacks.
Dextrous
UI_trait_CelerityDesc.ch:
超乎常人的速度與反應.
戰鬥與恢復動作更快.
移動與計時動作更快.
有機率閃避殭屍攻擊.
眼疾手快
UI_trait_CelerityDesc.cn:
超乎常人的速度与反应.
战斗与恢复动作更快.
移动与计时动作更快.
有几率闪避僵尸攻击.
眼疾手快

UI_trait_DeadshotDesc.en:
One shot. One kill. Every time.
Firearms degrade more slowly, and may restore ammo when fired.
Desensitized
Eagle Eyed
UI_trait_DeadshotDesc.ch:
一槍一命, 從不落空.
槍械磨損更慢, 射擊時可能恢復彈藥.
麻木不仁
目光銳利
UI_trait_DeadshotDesc.cn:
一枪一命, 从不落空.
枪械磨损更慢, 射击时可能恢复弹药.
麻木不仁
目光锐利

UI_trait_EideticDesc.en:
Perfect recall and comprehension.
Gain skill levels by reading skill books.
Automatically know all recipes.
Fast Learner
Fast Reader
UI_trait_EideticDesc.ch:
記憶與理解力完美無缺.
閱讀技能書即可提升技能等級.
自動學會所有配方.
學習神速
閱讀神速
UI_trait_EideticDesc.cn:
记忆与理解力完美无缺.
阅读技能书即可提升技能等级.
自动学会所有配方.
学习神速
阅读神速

UI_trait_FlightDesc.en:
Sky roads are faster than walking.
Double tap the vehicle key to toggle flight mode. Page Up/Down to change elevation.
Constant feather fall.
UI_trait_FlightDesc.ch:
走天路比走路快.
連按兩次載具鍵切換飛行模式. 用 Page Up/Down 調整高度.
永久羽落效果.
UI_trait_FlightDesc.cn:
走天路比走路快.
连按两次车辆键切换飞行模式. 用 Page Up/Down 调整高度.
永久羽落效果.

UI_trait_HammerDesc.en:
Explosive hammer strikes.
Will blow the pants right off you.
Works with blunt weapons.
UI_trait_HammerDesc.ch:
爆炸性的錘擊.
威力大到能把你的褲子轟飛.
適用於鈍器.
UI_trait_HammerDesc.cn:
爆炸性的锤击.
威力大到能把你的裤子轰飞.
适用于钝器.

UI_trait_InvisibilityDesc.en:
Become invisible while sneaking.
Assassinate enemies while invisible.
Graceful
Inconspicuous
UI_trait_InvisibilityDesc.ch:
潛行時變得隱形.
隱形時可暗殺敵人.
身輕如燕
毫不起眼
UI_trait_InvisibilityDesc.cn:
潜行时变得隐形.
隐形时可暗杀敌人.
身轻如燕
毫不起眼

UI_trait_LaserEyesDesc.en:
Shoot fricken' laser beams out of your eyes.
Wear any eyewear to activate. Equip from the hotbar, then point and shoot.
Eagle Eyed
UI_trait_LaserEyesDesc.ch:
從眼睛射出該死的雷射光束.
戴上任何眼部裝備即可啟用. 從快捷欄裝備後瞄準射擊.
目光銳利
UI_trait_LaserEyesDesc.cn:
从眼睛射出该死的激光光束.
戴上任何眼部装备即可启用. 从快捷栏装备后瞄准射击.
目光锐利

UI_trait_LastStandDesc.en: Explode in a last stand of defiance when about to be dragged down.
UI_trait_LastStandDesc.ch: 即將被拖倒時, 以最後的反抗引爆自身.
UI_trait_LastStandDesc.cn: 即将被拖倒时, 以最后的反抗引爆自身.

UI_trait_OnePunchDesc.en:
One punch. Everything dies.
Obliterate doors, trees, zombies, and zombie hordes with a single unarmed strike.
UI_trait_OnePunchDesc.ch:
一拳. 萬物皆滅.
徒手一擊即可粉碎門扉, 樹木, 殭屍與整群屍潮.
UI_trait_OnePunchDesc.cn:
一拳. 万物皆灭.
徒手一击即可粉碎门扉, 树木, 僵尸与整群尸潮.

UI_trait_PlotArmorDesc.en:
Start with nigh-impenetrable plot armor.
Just don't forget to equip it.
UI_trait_PlotArmorDesc.ch:
開局即擁有幾乎無法穿透的主角光環.
只是別忘了把它裝備上.
UI_trait_PlotArmorDesc.cn:
开局即拥有几乎无法穿透的主角光环.
只是别忘了把它装备上.

UI_trait_PsychoticDesc.en:
Violence is a part of you now.
Increased boredom.
Boost mood with every kill.
UI_trait_PsychoticDesc.ch:
暴力已成為你的一部分.
更容易感到無聊.
每次擊殺都能提振心情.
UI_trait_PsychoticDesc.cn:
暴力已成为你的一部分.
更容易感到无聊.
每次击杀都能提振心情.

UI_trait_RegenerationDesc.en:
Wounds heal in minutes.
Never become diseased or infected.
Immune to zombification.
Fast Healer
UI_trait_RegenerationDesc.ch:
傷口幾分鐘就癒合.
永不生病或感染.
免疫殭屍化.
快速恢復
UI_trait_RegenerationDesc.cn:
伤口几分钟就愈合.
永不生病或感染.
免疫僵尸化.
快速恢复

UI_trait_TelekinesisDesc.en:
Passively push zombies away with telekinetic shields.
Shout to project devastating telekinetic blasts.
Drains endurance; will fail if you get too tired.
UI_trait_TelekinesisDesc.ch:
被動以念力護盾推開殭屍.
大喊即可發出毀滅性的念力衝擊波.
會消耗耐力; 太過疲勞時將會失敗.
UI_trait_TelekinesisDesc.cn:
被动以念力护盾推开僵尸.
大喊即可发出毁灭性的念力冲击波.
会消耗耐力; 太过疲劳时将会失败.

UI_trait_ThunderstrikeDesc.en:
Shout to summon the wrath of the heavens.
Only works outside.
Beware of fires!
UI_trait_ThunderstrikeDesc.ch:
大喊即可召喚天罰.
僅能在室外使用.
小心引發火災!
UI_trait_ThunderstrikeDesc.cn:
大喊即可召唤天罚.
仅能在室外使用.
小心引发火灾!

UI_trait_UnstoppableDesc.en:
Sprint straight through your enemies. They will regret it.
Just don't run out of endurance in the middle of a horde.
UI_trait_UnstoppableDesc.ch:
直接衝過敵人. 他們會後悔的.
只是別在屍潮中間耗盡耐力.
UI_trait_UnstoppableDesc.cn:
直接冲过敌人. 他们会后悔的.
只是别在尸潮中间耗尽耐力.

UI_HCB_Hive_AlreadyHasQueen.en: This hive already has a queen.
UI_HCB_Hive_AlreadyHasQueen.ch: 這個蜂箱已經有蜂后了.
UI_HCB_Hive_AlreadyHasQueen.cn: 这个蜂箱已经有蜂后了.

UI_HCB_Hive_ApiphobiaBaneAutoApplied.en: Apiphobia bane automatically applied to this queen.
UI_HCB_Hive_ApiphobiaBaneAutoApplied.ch: 已自動對這隻蜂后套用懼蜂症減益.
UI_HCB_Hive_ApiphobiaBaneAutoApplied.cn: 已自动对这只蜂后应用惧蜂症减益.

UI_HCB_Hive_ApiphobiaBaneAutoAppliedShor.ch: 已自動套用懼蜂症減益.
UI_HCB_Hive_ApiphobiaBaneAutoAppliedShor.cn: 已自动应用惧蜂症减益.

UI_HCB_Hive_ApiphobiaBlocksBeekeeperBoon.ch: 懼蜂症阻擋了養蜂人增益.
UI_HCB_Hive_ApiphobiaBlocksBeekeeperBoon.cn: 惧蜂症阻挡了养蜂人增益.

UI_HCB_Hive_BeekeeperBoonApplied.en: Beekeeper boon applied to this queen.
UI_HCB_Hive_BeekeeperBoonApplied.ch: 已對這隻蜂后套用養蜂人增益.
UI_HCB_Hive_BeekeeperBoonApplied.cn: 已对这只蜂后应用养蜂人增益.

UI_HCB_Hive_CagedQueenReinserted.ch: 已將籠中的蜂后放回蜂箱 (%1 小時). 養蜂效果: %2.
UI_HCB_Hive_CagedQueenReinserted.cn: 已将笼中的蜂后放回蜂箱 (%1 小时). 养蜂效果: %2.

UI_HCB_Hive_ClickApplyBeekeeperBoon.en: Click icon to apply Beekeeper boon.
UI_HCB_Hive_ClickApplyBeekeeperBoon.ch: 點選圖示以套用養蜂人增益.
UI_HCB_Hive_ClickApplyBeekeeperBoon.cn: 点击图标以应用养蜂人增益.

UI_HCB_Hive_ClickPlaceQueenLarvae.en: Click to place Queen Larvae from your inventory.
UI_HCB_Hive_ClickPlaceQueenLarvae.ch: 點選以從你的物品欄放入蜂后幼蟲.
UI_HCB_Hive_ClickPlaceQueenLarvae.cn: 点击以从你的物品栏放入蜂后幼虫.

UI_HCB_Hive_HarvestCompletePropolis.ch: 採收完成. 獲得蜂膠 x%1.
UI_HCB_Hive_HarvestCompletePropolis.cn: 采收完成. 获得蜂胶 x%1.

UI_HCB_Hive_HarvestCompleteSmokerCalm.en: Harvest complete. The smoker kept the bees calm.
UI_HCB_Hive_HarvestCompleteSmokerCalm.ch: 採收完成. 燻煙器讓蜂群保持平靜.
UI_HCB_Hive_HarvestCompleteSmokerCalm.cn: 采收完成. 熏烟器让蜂群保持平静.

UI_HCB_Hive_KeepersNeedLivingQueen.en: A living queen is required to apply keeper effects.
UI_HCB_Hive_KeepersNeedLivingQueen.ch: 需要一隻活著的蜂后才能套用養蜂效果.
UI_HCB_Hive_KeepersNeedLivingQueen.cn: 需要一只活着的蜂后才能应用养蜂效果.

UI_HCB_Hive_NeedLitBeeSmoker.en: You need a lit Bee Smoker.
UI_HCB_Hive_NeedLitBeeSmoker.ch: 你需要一個點燃的蜂箱燻煙器.
UI_HCB_Hive_NeedLitBeeSmoker.cn: 你需要一个点燃的蜂箱熏烟器.

UI_HCB_Hive_NeedQueenOrCagedQueen.en: You need a Queen Bee or a Queen Cage with a queen.
UI_HCB_Hive_NeedQueenOrCagedQueen.ch: 你需要一隻蜂后, 或一個裝有蜂后的蜂后籠.
UI_HCB_Hive_NeedQueenOrCagedQueen.cn: 你需要一只蜂后, 或一个装有蜂后的蜂后笼.
