UI_AGD_GarageManagerEmptyHelp.en:
Select a garage on the left, then use the buttons to manage it.

How it works:
  1) Discover the keypad code (code shows as Hidden until discovered).
  2) Set a public frequency (F-####) once the code is discovered.
  3) Pair a remote/controller to the garage and operate it.

Tips:
- Stand by a garage door and use 'Add Current (nearby)' to create an entry.
- 'Update Proximity' fills missing coordinates only when you're near the door; once set, coords stay locked.
- Codes are Hidden until discovered via the keypad; once discovered, you can set a public frequency (F-####).
- Drag-and-drop entries in the list to reorder them; order is saved.
- 'Keypad: Locked Out' means too many wrong attempts; wait or use appropriate tools (if available).
- Renaming a garage updates paired remote labels automatically.
UI_AGD_GarageManagerEmptyHelp.ch:
在左側選擇一個車庫, 然後使用按鈕進行管理.

工作原理:
  1) 探索出鍵盤密碼 (發現前密碼顯示為「已隱藏」).
  2) 密碼發現後即可設定公開頻率 (F-####).
  3) 將遙控器/控制器配對到車庫即可操作.

提示:
- 站在車庫門旁時使用「新增目前位置 (附近)」以建立條目.
- 「更新位置」僅在你靠近門時填入缺少的座標; 一旦設定, 座標將保持鎖定.
- 密碼在透過鍵盤發現前均為「已隱藏」;發現後即可設定公開頻率 (F-####).
- 在清單中拖放條目即可重新排序; 順序會被儲存.
- 「鍵盤: 已鎖定」表示錯誤嘗試次數過多; 請等待或使用適當的工具 (若有).
- 重新命名車庫時, 已配對遙控器的標籤會自動更新.
UI_AGD_GarageManagerEmptyHelp.cn:
在左侧选择一个车库, 然后使用按钮进行管理.

工作原理:
  1) 探索出键盘密码 (发现前密码显示为“已隐藏”).
  2) 密码发现后即可设置公开频率 (F-####).
  3) 将遥控器/控制器配对到车库即可操作.

提示:
- 站在车库门旁时使用“添加当前位置 (附近)”以创建条目.
- “更新位置”仅在你靠近门时填入缺少的坐标; 一旦设置, 坐标将保持锁定.
- 密码在通过键盘发现前均为“已隐藏”;发现后即可设置公开频率 (F-####).
- 在列表中拖放条目即可重新排序; 顺序会被保存.
- “键盘: 已锁定”表示错误尝试次数过多; 请等待或使用适当的工具 (若有).
- 重命名车库时, 已配对遥控器的标签会自动更新.

UI_AGD_TipPairRemoteGarage.cn: 将遥控器配对到此车库

UI_ETW_Vitals_Mental_tooltip.en: Records your anger, stress, unhappiness, and panic every in-game minute. These stats are normalized and averaged, then inverted so 1 represents the best mental state and 0 the worst. Minute samples are rolled into hourly averages, hourly samples into daily averages, and daily samples into the 31-day average shown here.
UI_ETW_Vitals_Mental_tooltip.ch: 每個遊戲分鐘記錄你的憤怒, 壓力, 不高興與恐慌. 這些數值會經過正規化與平均, 再取反向, 因此1代表最佳精神狀態, 0代表最差. 分鐘取樣彙整為每小時平均, 每小時取樣彙整為每日平均, 每日取樣再彙整為此處顯示的31天平均.
UI_ETW_Vitals_Mental_tooltip.cn: 每个游戏分钟记录你的愤怒, 压力, 不高兴与恐慌. 这些数值会经过归一化与平均, 再取反向, 因此1代表最佳精神状态, 0代表最差. 分钟采样汇总为每小时平均, 每小时采样汇总为每日平均, 每日采样再汇总为此处显示的31天平均.

UI_quick_tip_joke10.en: West Point was founded by the pioneer James Young in 1789.
UI_quick_tip_joke10.ch: 肯塔基州西點鎮由拓荒者 James Young 於 1789 年創立.
UI_quick_tip_joke10.cn: 肯塔基州西点镇由拓荒者 James Young 于 1789 年创立.

UI_quick_tip_joke15.en: Have you uncovered Knox Event origins?
UI_quick_tip_joke15.ch: 你查明諾克斯事件的起源了嗎?
UI_quick_tip_joke15.cn: 你查明诺克斯事件的起源了吗?

UI_quick_tip_joke16.en: Have you visited Black Forest Research Facility?
UI_quick_tip_joke16.ch: 你去過黑森林研究設施了嗎?
UI_quick_tip_joke16.cn: 你去过黑森林研究设施了吗?

UI_quick_tip_joke17.en: Don't hurt zombies! They have feelings too!
UI_quick_tip_joke17.ch: 別傷害殭屍! 牠們也是有感情的!
UI_quick_tip_joke17.cn: 别伤害丧尸! 它们也是有感情的!

UI_quick_tip_joke18.en: Beware of lightnings! They can reanimate Frankenstein
UI_quick_tip_joke18.ch: 小心閃電! 它可能會讓科學怪人復活
UI_quick_tip_joke18.cn: 小心闪电! 它可能会让弗兰肯斯坦复活

UI_quick_tip_joke19.en: There is gang of Santa Claus in town, but they will likely steal Christmas
UI_quick_tip_joke19.ch: 鎮上有一群聖誕老人, 但他們八成是來偷走聖誕節的
UI_quick_tip_joke19.cn: 镇上有一群圣诞老人, 但他们八成是来偷走圣诞节的

UI_quick_tip_joke20.en: The resurrection of the dead. I guess that's not what the Bible meant.
UI_quick_tip_joke20.ch: 死者復活. 我想聖經指的應該不是這個.
UI_quick_tip_joke20.cn: 死者复活. 我想圣经指的应该不是这个.

UI_quick_tip_joke21.ch: 你去過斯皮福總部了嗎?
UI_quick_tip_joke21.cn: 你去过斯皮福总部了吗?

UI_quick_tip_joke22.en: Have you visited the Louisville Bruiser factory?
UI_quick_tip_joke22.ch: 你去過路易斯維爾布魯瑟工廠了嗎?
UI_quick_tip_joke22.cn: 你去过路易斯维尔布鲁瑟工厂了吗?

UI_quick_tip_joke23.en: Have you visited Scarlet Oak Distillery?

UI_quick_tip_joke24.en: Always know where your towel is.
UI_quick_tip_joke24.ch: 隨時都要知道你的毛巾在哪裡.
UI_quick_tip_joke24.cn: 随时都要知道你的毛巾在哪里.

UI_quick_tip_joke8.ch: 如果你聽到烏鴉叫 - 快跑!
UI_quick_tip_joke8.cn: 如果你听到乌鸦叫 - 快跑!

UI_quick_tip_joke9.en: Horror author Abe Quern has sold over a million books in Kentucky alone!
UI_quick_tip_joke9.ch: 恐怖小說作家亞伯·奎恩光是在肯塔基州就賣出超過一百萬本書!
UI_quick_tip_joke9.cn: 恐怖小说作家亚伯·奎恩光是在肯塔基州就卖出超过一百万本书!

UI_ImmersiveBlackouts_LightFlickeringMod.en: If enabled, lights will flicker before a blackout.
UI_ImmersiveBlackouts_LightFlickeringMod.ch: 如果啟用, 燈光在停電前會閃爍.
UI_ImmersiveBlackouts_LightFlickeringMod.cn: 如果启用, 灯光在停电前会闪烁.

UI_alertSystem_noUpdates.en: No mod updates in the last two weeks.
UI_alertSystem_noUpdates.ch: 最近兩週沒有模組更新.
UI_alertSystem_noUpdates.cn: 最近两周没有模组更新.

UI_modselector_LocalMod_tooltip.en:
This mod will not be downloaded on the client side.

Reason: Workshop ID not found (local mod).

If you are the author of this mod, you need to publish it to the Workshop and subscribe to it.
UI_modselector_LocalMod_tooltip.ch:
此模組不會在客戶端下載.

原因: 找不到 Workshop ID (本機模組).

如果你是此模組的作者, 需要先將它發布到 Workshop 並訂閱它.
UI_modselector_LocalMod_tooltip.cn:
此模组不会在客户端下载.

原因: 找不到 Workshop ID (本地模组).

如果你是此模组的作者, 需要先将它发布到 Workshop 并订阅它.

UI_BurdJournals_BaselineRetryExhausted.en: Character data is still unavailable. Close and reopen the journal to retry.
UI_BurdJournals_BaselineRetryExhausted.ch: 仍然無法取得角色資料. 請關閉並重新開啟日記以重試.
UI_BurdJournals_BaselineRetryExhausted.cn: 仍然无法获取角色数据. 请关闭并重新打开日记以重试.

UI_BurdJournals_DebugToggleVisibleRecipe.en: Learn or forget all visible recipes.
UI_BurdJournals_DebugToggleVisibleRecipe.ch: 學習或遺忘所有可見的配方.
UI_BurdJournals_DebugToggleVisibleRecipe.cn: 学习或遗忘所有可见的配方.

UI_trait_AllScratchedUpDesc.ch: 開局時身上有十處抓傷.
UI_trait_AllScratchedUpDesc.cn: 开局时身上有十处抓伤.

UI_trait_BlackoutDesc.en: You get out of the shower and fall badly. You're blind drunk, and have a nasty cold. On top of all this, the house is on fire!
UI_trait_BlackoutDesc.ch: 你剛洗完澡就重重摔了一跤. 你爛醉如泥, 還得了重感冒. 更慘的是, 房子還著火了!
UI_trait_BlackoutDesc.cn: 你刚洗完澡就重重摔了一跤. 你烂醉如泥, 还得了重感冒. 更惨的是, 房子还着火了!

UI_trait_BleedingOutDesc.en: Start with a glass shard lodged in your neck, bleeding profusely.
UI_trait_BleedingOutDesc.ch: 開局時頸部插著一塊玻璃碎片, 大量失血.
UI_trait_BleedingOutDesc.cn: 开局时颈部插着一块玻璃碎片, 大量失血.

UI_trait_BurnPatientDesc.en: Start covered in bandaged burns in various states of cleanliness.
UI_trait_BurnPatientDesc.ch: 開局時全身包紮著燒傷, 敷料的乾淨程度不一.
UI_trait_BurnPatientDesc.cn: 开局时全身包扎着烧伤, 敷料的干净程度不一.

UI_trait_CarCrashDesc.en: A recent crash leaves you broken and bleeding.
UI_trait_CarCrashDesc.ch: 一場剛發生的車禍讓你骨折又流血.
UI_trait_CarCrashDesc.cn: 一场刚发生的车祸让你骨折又流血.

UI_trait_CrushedHandsDesc.en: Start with two fractured hands, preventing the use of weapons until splinted.
UI_trait_CrushedHandsDesc.ch: 開局時雙手骨折, 在上夾板前無法使用武器.
UI_trait_CrushedHandsDesc.cn: 开局时双手骨折, 在上夹板前无法使用武器.

UI_trait_FlamingWreckageDesc.en: Having crawled out of a flaming wreck, you're left burned, broken, and bleeding.
UI_trait_FlamingWreckageDesc.ch: 你從燃燒的車體殘骸中爬出, 留下燒傷, 骨折與流血.
UI_trait_FlamingWreckageDesc.cn: 你从燃烧的车体残骸中爬出, 留下烧伤, 骨折与流血.

UI_trait_HeadshotDesc.en: Start with a bleeding gunshot to the head.
UI_trait_HeadshotDesc.ch: 開局時頭部有一處流血的槍傷.
UI_trait_HeadshotDesc.cn: 开局时头部有一处流血的枪伤.

UI_trait_HouseFireDesc.en: Start with a raging fire consuming your house. (Not functional in MP)
UI_trait_HouseFireDesc.ch: 開局時你的房子正被熊熊大火吞噬. (多人模式無效)
UI_trait_HouseFireDesc.cn: 开局时你的房子正被熊熊大火吞噬. (多人模式无效)

UI_trait_LeftForDeadDesc.en: Barely clinging to life in a horrible state with every injury imaginable.
UI_trait_LeftForDeadDesc.ch: 身受各種能想到的傷勢, 狀況慘烈, 勉強吊著一口氣.
UI_trait_LeftForDeadDesc.cn: 身受各种能想到的伤势, 状况惨烈, 勉强吊着一口气.

UI_trait_MauledDesc.en: Mauled by an animal, start covered with several bites and a scratch.
UI_trait_MauledDesc.ch: 被動物撲咬, 開局時身上佈滿數處咬傷和一道抓傷.
UI_trait_MauledDesc.cn: 被动物扑咬, 开局时身上布满数处咬伤和一道抓伤.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Anxious_Desc.en: It feels your fear, and hates it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Anxious_Desc.ch: 它感受到你的恐懼, 並為此憎惡.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Anxious_Desc.cn: 它感受到你的恐惧, 并为此憎恶.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Cold_Desc.en: Just a tool. Nothing has marked it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Cold_Desc.ch: 不過是件工具. 還沒有任何事物在它身上留下痕跡.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Cold_Desc.cn: 不过是件工具. 还没有任何事物在它身上留下痕迹.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Damp_Desc.en: Rain and red run together. Nothing sticks.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Damp_Desc.ch: 雨水與血色一同流下. 什麼也沾不住.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Damp_Desc.cn: 雨水与血色一同流下. 什么也沾不住.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dreaming_Desc.en: Late and still. It dreams of edges it has met.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dreaming_Desc.ch: 夜深而靜. 它夢見自己交手過的每一道鋒刃.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dreaming_Desc.cn: 夜深而静. 它梦见自己交手过的每一道锋刃.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dripping_Desc.en: It won't come clean. It doesn't try.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dripping_Desc.ch: 它擦不乾淨. 它也不打算擦.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dripping_Desc.cn: 它擦不干净. 它也不打算擦.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Drowsing_Desc.en: Idle and indoors. It dozes against your side.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Drowsing_Desc.ch: 閒置於室內. 它靠在你身側打盹.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Drowsing_Desc.cn: 闲置于室内. 它靠在你身侧打盹.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Feral_Desc.en: Blooded in the dark. It pulls toward the next one.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Feral_Desc.ch: 在黑暗中飲過血. 它拉扯著奔向下一個.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Feral_Desc.cn: 在黑暗中饮过血. 它拉扯着奔向下一个.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Flickering_Desc.en: Your dread strikes a spark in it, then nothing.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Flickering_Desc.ch: 你的恐懼在它體內擦出一星火花, 隨即歸於虛無.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Flickering_Desc.cn: 你的恐惧在它体内擦出一星火花, 随即归于虚无.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gloaming_Desc.en: The light goes. It feels the long dark coming on.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gloaming_Desc.ch: 天光將盡. 它感覺到漫長的黑暗正在逼近.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gloaming_Desc.cn: 天光将尽. 它感觉到漫长的黑暗正在逼近.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gorged_Desc.en: Slick to the grip and full — and hungry anyway.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gorged_Desc.ch: 握柄濕滑, 已然飽足——卻依舊飢渴.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gorged_Desc.cn: 握柄湿滑, 已然饱足——却依旧饥渴.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Greying_Desc.en: Grey at the edges — you've lasted the night. It eases.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Greying_Desc.ch: 天邊泛起灰白——你熬過了這一夜. 它鬆弛下來.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Greying_Desc.cn: 天边泛起灰白——你熬过了这一夜. 它松弛下来.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Humming_Desc.en: Quiet warmth in the daylight. Content, briefly.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Humming_Desc.ch: 日光下靜靜地溫著. 短暫地心滿意足.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Humming_Desc.cn: 日光下静静地温着. 短暂地心满意足.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Hunting_Desc.en: Half-fed in the dark, casting for more.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Hunting_Desc.ch: 在黑暗中半飽, 仍四處搜尋著下一口.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Hunting_Desc.cn: 在黑暗中半饱, 仍四处搜寻着下一口.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Quiet_Desc.en: No voice in it — only the weight of the dead.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Quiet_Desc.ch: 它體內沒有聲音——只有亡者的重量.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Quiet_Desc.cn: 它体内没有声音——只有亡者的重量.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Remembering_Desc.en: Quiet — but it counts the dead it has made.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Remembering_Desc.ch: 靜默——但它清點著自己造就的亡者.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Remembering_Desc.cn: 静默——但它清点着自己造就的亡者.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Restless_Desc.en: It won't settle. It paces in your hand.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Restless_Desc.ch: 它靜不下來. 在你手中來回踱步.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Restless_Desc.cn: 它静不下来. 在你手中来回踱步.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Rinsing_Desc.en: The rain takes the blood. It lets go, for now.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Rinsing_Desc.ch: 雨水帶走血跡. 它暫時鬆手了.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Rinsing_Desc.cn: 雨水带走血迹. 它暂时松手了.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Roused_Desc.en: Awake to the work now. It wants the rhythm to hold.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Roused_Desc.ch: 它已為這場活計醒來. 它想讓這節奏持續下去.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Roused_Desc.cn: 它已为这场活计醒来. 它想让这节奏持续下去.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Settling_Desc.en: Clean and sheltered, it forgets what it saw.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Settling_Desc.ch: 潔淨而有遮蔽, 它忘了自己看過什麼.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Settling_Desc.cn: 洁净而有遮蔽, 它忘了自己看过什么.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Singing_Desc.en: It rings between every blow. It does not want to stop.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Singing_Desc.ch: 每一擊之間它都在鳴響. 它不想停下.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Singing_Desc.cn: 每一击之间它都在鸣响. 它不想停下.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Still_Desc.en: Resting. Patient. It has all the time there is.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Still_Desc.ch: 歇息. 耐心. 它擁有世上全部的時間.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Still_Desc.cn: 歇息. 耐心. 它拥有世上全部的时间.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Straining_Desc.en: Heavier than it was. It blames your tired arm.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Straining_Desc.ch: 比先前更沉了. 它怪罪你疲憊的手臂.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Straining_Desc.cn: 比先前更沉了. 它怪罪你疲惫的手臂.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Thirsting_Desc.en: Clean under a dead sky. It wants that to change.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Thirsting_Desc.ch: 在死寂的天空下潔淨無染. 它想改變這一點.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Thirsting_Desc.cn: 在死寂的天空下洁净无染. 它想改变这一点.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Trembling_Desc.en: Too much death, too fast — it shudders to keep up.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Trembling_Desc.ch: 死亡太多, 太快——它顫抖著才勉強跟上.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Trembling_Desc.cn: 死亡太多, 太快——它颤抖着才勉强跟上.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Uneasy_Desc.en: The dark leans in. It almost understands why.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Uneasy_Desc.ch: 黑暗傾身逼近. 它幾乎明白了緣由.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Uneasy_Desc.cn: 黑暗倾身逼近. 它几乎明白了缘由.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Warm_Desc.en: The blood leaves a warmth it can't name.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Warm_Desc.ch: 血留下一種它無法名狀的溫熱.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Warm_Desc.cn: 血留下一种它无法名状的温热.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Watchful_Desc.en: Awake in the dark, listening with you.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Watchful_Desc.ch: 在黑暗中醒著, 與你一同傾聽.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Watchful_Desc.cn: 在黑暗中醒着, 与你一同倾听.

UI_TWF_QOL_FOOD_DBLCLICK_EATALL.en: Double-click food eats the whole item

UI_TWF_QOL_FOOD_DBLCLICK_EATALL_TT.en: When enabled, double-clicking food uses the vanilla behavior and eats the whole item instead of smart partial eating.
UI_TWF_QOL_FOOD_DBLCLICK_EATALL_TT.ch: 啟用後, 雙擊食物將採用原版行為, 直接吃掉整份, 而非智慧分次進食.
UI_TWF_QOL_FOOD_DBLCLICK_EATALL_TT.cn: 启用后, 双击食物将采用原版行为, 直接吃掉整份, 而非智能分次进食.

UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.ch: 搜尋: 忽略附帶種子
UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.cn: 搜寻: 忽略附带种子

UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.en: Singleplayer: controlled only by Mod Options and overrides Sandbox. Multiplayer: controlled by the server Sandbox setting. When enabled, wild crops found through foraging still give the food item, but the automatically generated extra seed items are ignored.
UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.ch: 單人遊戲: 僅由模組選項控制, 並覆寫沙盒設定. 多人遊戲: 由伺服器沙盒設定控制. 啟用後, 搜尋找到的野生作物仍會給予食物物品, 但自動產生的額外種子物品會被忽略.
UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.cn: 单人游戏: 仅由模组选项控制, 并覆盖沙盒设置. 多人游戏: 由服务器沙盒设置控制. 启用后, 搜寻找到的野生作物仍会给予食物物品, 但自动产生的额外种子物品会被忽略.

UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_CLEANUP_W.en: Reload cleanup options are mutually exclusive: enable either dropping leftovers or deleting leftovers, never both. Deleting permanently removes the leftover item from your inventory.
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_CLEANUP_W.ch: 裝填清理選項互斥: 丟棄殘件與刪除殘件只能擇一啟用, 不可同時開啟. 刪除會將殘件從你的物品欄中永久移除.
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_CLEANUP_W.cn: 装填清理选项互斥: 丢弃残件与删除残件只能择一启用, 不可同时开启. 删除会将残件从你的物品栏中永久移除.

UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.ch: 裝填鍵: 刪除損壞殘件
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.cn: 装填键: 删除损坏残件

UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.en: Optional cleanup. Whenever a melee reload is executed by quick reload or by selecting a weapon from the hold-reload radial menu, broken melee leftovers are permanently deleted from the main inventory. This removes the leftover item from your inventory and cannot be used together with Drop Broken Leftovers.
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.ch: 選用的清理功能. 每當透過快速裝填, 或從按住裝填鍵開啟的環形選單中選擇武器而執行近戰裝填時, 損壞的近戰殘件會從主物品欄中永久刪除. 此選項會將殘件從你的物品欄移除, 且不可與「丟棄損壞殘件」同時使用.
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.cn: 可选的清理功能. 每当通过快速装填, 或从按住装填键打开的环形菜单中选择武器而执行近战装填时, 损坏的近战残件会从主物品栏中永久删除. 此选项会将残件从你的物品栏移除, 且不可与“丢弃损坏残件”同时使用.

UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_ENABLE_TT.en: When enabled, combat-stance movement speed uses the selected Nimble limit only if your real Nimble level is higher. XP is not reduced.
UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_ENABLE_TT.ch: 啟用後, 只有在你實際的靈活等級高於所選上限時, 戰鬥姿態的移動速度才會套用該上限. 經驗值不會減少.
UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_ENABLE_TT.cn: 启用后, 只有在你实际的灵活等级高于所选上限时, 战斗姿态的移动速度才会应用该上限. 经验值不会减少.

UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_LEVEL_TT.en: Sets the maximum effective Nimble level for combat-stance movement speed. If your real Nimble level is equal or lower, nothing is changed.
UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_LEVEL_TT.ch: 設定戰鬥姿態移動速度所採用的靈活等級上限. 若你實際的靈活等級等於或低於此值, 則不會有任何變化.
UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_LEVEL_TT.cn: 设定战斗姿态移动速度所采用的灵活等级上限. 若你实际的灵活等级等于或低于此值, 则不会有任何变化.

UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK.en: Double-click traps to add best bait
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK.ch: 雙擊陷阱自動放入最佳誘餌
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK.cn: 双击陷阱自动放入最佳诱饵

UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK_TT.en: Double-click an empty trap to automatically use the best available fresh bait from your inventory. Rabbit bait is preferred when the trap can catch rabbits.
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK_TT.ch: 雙擊空陷阱時, 自動從你的物品欄取用最佳的新鮮誘餌. 若該陷阱能捕捉兔子, 會優先使用兔子誘餌.
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK_TT.cn: 双击空陷阱时, 自动从你的物品栏取用最佳的新鲜诱饵. 若该陷阱能捕捉兔子, 会优先使用兔子诱饵.

UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_REARM_TT.en: After placing a trap, automatically starts placing another trap of the same type if one is still available in your inventory.
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_REARM_TT.ch: 放置陷阱後, 若物品欄中仍有同類型陷阱, 會自動接著放置下一個.
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_REARM_TT.cn: 放置陷阱后, 若物品栏中仍有同类型陷阱, 会自动接着放置下一个.

UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT.en: Color trap highlight by bait state
UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT.ch: 依誘餌狀態顯示陷阱高亮顏色
UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT.cn: 依诱饵状态显示陷阱高亮颜色

UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TT.en: Hovered traps use different highlight colors depending on whether they are baited, empty, or sprung.
UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TT.ch: 滑鼠移過陷阱時, 會依已放餌, 空置或已觸發等狀態顯示不同的高亮顏色.
UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TT.cn: 鼠标移过陷阱时, 会依已放饵, 空置或已触发等状态显示不同的高亮颜色.

UI_BT_OPTION_NEARBY_HIGHLIGHT_TT.en: Continuously highlights nearby traps around you. Disabled by default for performance and visual clarity.
UI_BT_OPTION_NEARBY_HIGHLIGHT_TT.ch: 持續高亮你周圍的陷阱. 為兼顧效能與畫面清晰, 預設為停用.
UI_BT_OPTION_NEARBY_HIGHLIGHT_TT.cn: 持续高亮你周围的陷阱. 为兼顾性能与画面清晰, 默认为禁用.

UI_BCI_ShowCoverageChanges_tooltip.en: Show compact body-part warmth, wind, and protection changes in wear previews.
UI_BCI_ShowCoverageChanges_tooltip.ch: 在穿著預覽中以精簡形式顯示各身體部位的保溫, 防風和防護變化.
UI_BCI_ShowCoverageChanges_tooltip.cn: 在穿着预览中以精简形式显示各身体部位的保温, 防风和防护变化.

UI_BCI_UseKeybindForComparison.ch: 穿著預覽需按住快捷鍵
UI_BCI_UseKeybindForComparison.cn: 穿着预览需按住快捷键

UI_BCI_UseKeybindForComparison_tooltip.en: Only show the inventory-hover wear preview while the keybind is pressed.
UI_BCI_UseKeybindForComparison_tooltip.ch: 僅在按住快捷鍵時才顯示物品欄懸停的穿著預覽.
UI_BCI_UseKeybindForComparison_tooltip.cn: 仅在按住快捷键时才显示物品栏悬停的穿着预览.

UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_DebugOutput_T.en: Controls diagnostic output for troubleshooting. Detailed logging may affect performance, so enable it only while reproducing an issue.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_DebugOutput_T.ch: 控制用於排除問題的診斷輸出. 詳細記錄可能影響效能, 請僅在重現問題時啟用.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_DebugOutput_T.cn: 控制用于排查问题的诊断输出. 详细日志可能影响性能, 请仅在复现问题时启用.

UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreDisman.en: Returns materials obtained by dismantling an item to the container the dismantled item came from.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreDisman.ch: 將拆解物品所得的材料放回被拆解物品原本所在的容器.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreDisman.cn: 将拆解物品所得的材料放回被拆解物品原本所在的容器.

UI_SaucedCarts_CantDoThatWithCart.en: I can't do that while pushing this cart.
UI_SaucedCarts_CantDoThatWithCart.ch: 推著這輛手推車時我沒辦法這麼做.
UI_SaucedCarts_CantDoThatWithCart.cn: 推着这辆手推车时我没办法这么做.

UI_CMRB_Message_VehicleSkinChanged.en: The skin value of the selected vehicle was changed.
UI_CMRB_Message_VehicleSkinChanged.ch: 已更改選取車輛的塗裝數值.
UI_CMRB_Message_VehicleSkinChanged.cn: 已更改选中车辆的涂装数值.

UI_MyOwnWell_MENU_CleanWater_Rain.en: It's raining, you can't clean the water!
UI_MyOwnWell_MENU_CleanWater_Rain.ch: 正在下雨, 無法淨化水!
UI_MyOwnWell_MENU_CleanWater_Rain.cn: 正在下雨, 无法净化水!

UI_optionscreen_TchAL_KeyLock_tooltip.en: Locks movement keys while leaning to avoid vanilla Get Up to occure within bed tiles. <LINE> You can deactivate if you are stuck in leaning / sleeping position.
UI_optionscreen_TchAL_KeyLock_tooltip.ch: 鎖定倚靠時的移動按鍵, 避免在床鋪圖塊上觸發原版的起身動作. <LINE> 如果你卡在倚靠/睡眠姿勢中, 可以停用此選項.
UI_optionscreen_TchAL_KeyLock_tooltip.cn: 锁定倚靠时的移动按键, 避免在床铺图块上触发原版的起身动作. <LINE> 如果你卡在倚靠/睡眠姿势中, 可以禁用此选项.

UI_Btn_CharLoad_tooltip.en: You need to quit and reload to synchronize your inventory and traits
UI_Btn_CharLoad_tooltip.ch: 你需要退出並重新載入才能同步你的物品欄與特質.
UI_Btn_CharLoad_tooltip.cn: 你需要退出并重新加载才能同步你的物品栏与特质.

UI_ClothingType_BSizeClothes.ch: 衣櫃: B 尺寸服裝
UI_ClothingType_BSizeClothes.cn: 衣柜: B 尺寸服装

UI_trait_FashionmancerDesc.en:
Do you know what is most important in an apocalypse? style!
Start the game knowing all the clothing recipes from the Bianca Wardrobe Mod.
+1 Tailoring
UI_trait_FashionmancerDesc.ch:
你知道末日中最重要的是什麼嗎? 品味!
開局即掌握 Bianca 衣櫃模組的所有服裝配方.
+1 縫紉
UI_trait_FashionmancerDesc.cn:
你知道末日中最重要的是什么吗? 品味!
开局即掌握 Bianca 衣柜模组的所有服装配方.
+1 缝纫

UI_breathingTechniquefullendurance.en: You feel that your breathing is steady again
UI_breathingTechniquefullendurance.ch: 你感覺呼吸又平穩下來了
UI_breathingTechniquefullendurance.cn: 你感觉呼吸又平稳下来了

UI_trait_AgileDesc.en: Nimble, quick & knows the basics of fluid movement.
UI_trait_AgileDesc.ch: 靈巧敏捷, 掌握流暢移動的基本功.
UI_trait_AgileDesc.cn: 灵巧敏捷, 掌握流畅移动的基本功.

UI_trait_AgriculturistDesc.en:
Expert in crop cultivation.
Highly skilled in managing diverse crops, their specific requirements & growing optimization.
UI_trait_AgriculturistDesc.ch:
作物栽培的專家.
精通各類作物的管理、各自的需求以及生長優化.
UI_trait_AgriculturistDesc.cn:
作物栽培的专家.
精通各类作物的管理、各自的需求以及生长优化.

UI_trait_Aim1Desc.ch: 接受過瞄準與射擊的基礎訓練.
UI_trait_Aim1Desc.cn: 接受过瞄准与射击的基础训练.

UI_trait_Aim2Desc.en: Trained survivor in advanced aiming & shooting techniques.
UI_trait_Aim2Desc.ch: 受過進階瞄準與射擊技巧訓練的倖存者.
UI_trait_Aim2Desc.cn: 受过进阶瞄准与射击技巧训练的幸存者.

UI_trait_Aim3Desc.en:
Highly skilled & trained survivor.
Excels at precise shooting with ranged weapons.
UI_trait_Aim3Desc.ch:
技巧高超且訓練有素的倖存者.
擅長以遠程武器進行精準射擊.
UI_trait_Aim3Desc.cn:
技巧高超且训练有素的幸存者.
擅长以远程武器进行精准射击.

UI_trait_AllHailCaesarDesc.en:
Apes! Together! Strong!
[+30% foraging bonus to firewood and stones]
UI_trait_AllHailCaesarDesc.ch:
猿族! 團結! 力量!
[搜尋木柴與石頭時 +30%% 加成]
UI_trait_AllHailCaesarDesc.cn:
猿族! 团结! 力量!
[搜寻木柴与石头时 +30%% 加成]

UI_trait_Axe1Desc.en: Survivor learning basics of hatchet combat
UI_trait_Axe1Desc.ch: 正在學習手斧戰鬥基礎的倖存者
UI_trait_Axe1Desc.cn: 正在学习手斧战斗基础的幸存者

UI_trait_Axe2Desc.en: Seasoned warrior adept in axe combat & is able to cut through both wood & undead flesh with ease.
UI_trait_Axe2Desc.ch: 精通斧頭戰鬥的老練戰士, 無論木材還是殭屍的血肉都能輕鬆劈開.
UI_trait_Axe2Desc.cn: 精通斧头战斗的老练战士, 无论木材还是僵尸的血肉都能轻松劈开.

UI_trait_Axe3Desc.en:
Highly skilled logger & axe handler.
Known for their unparalleled ability to cleave through hordes of undeads.
UI_trait_Axe3Desc.ch:
技藝高超的伐木者與用斧高手.
以能劈開成群殭屍的無雙本領聞名.
UI_trait_Axe3Desc.cn:
技艺高超的伐木者与用斧高手.
以能劈开成群僵尸的无双本领闻名.

UI_trait_BagsAndBeltsDesc.en:
Trader who is well-versed in efficient bags and belts usage.
Has higher maximum carrying capacity during their travels and trades.
Increased maximum carrying capacity.
[32 at max strength]
UI_trait_BagsAndBeltsDesc.ch:
深諳如何高效使用包袋與腰帶的商人.
在旅途與交易中擁有更高的負重上限.
提高負重上限.
[力量滿級時為 32]
UI_trait_BagsAndBeltsDesc.cn:
深谙如何高效使用包袋与腰带的商人.
在旅途与交易中拥有更高的负重上限.
提高负重上限.
[力量满级时为 32]

UI_trait_BlacksmithMasterDesc.en: Can create exquisite weaponry with rare resources
UI_trait_BlacksmithMasterDesc.ch: 能以稀有資源打造精良的武器
UI_trait_BlacksmithMasterDesc.cn: 能以稀有资源打造精良的武器

UI_trait_Blade1Desc.en: Survivor learning the art of sword combat.
UI_trait_Blade1Desc.ch: 正在學習刀劍戰鬥技藝的倖存者.
UI_trait_Blade1Desc.cn: 正在学习刀剑战斗技艺的幸存者.

UI_trait_Blade2Desc.en: Seasoned warrior skilled in sword combat, adept at slicing through undead.
UI_trait_Blade2Desc.ch: 精通刀劍戰鬥的老練戰士, 擅長劈開殭屍.
UI_trait_Blade2Desc.cn: 精通刀剑战斗的老练战士, 擅长劈开僵尸.

UI_trait_Blade3Desc.en:
Masterful warrior trained in the ancient art of the blade.
Deadly force that elegantly slices through undead ranks with unparalleled skill & precision
UI_trait_Blade3Desc.ch:
受過古老刀術訓練的大師級戰士.
以無雙的技巧與精準, 優雅地劈開殭屍的行列, 致命而俐落
UI_trait_Blade3Desc.cn:
受过古老刀术训练的大师级战士.
以无双的技巧与精准, 优雅地劈开僵尸的行列, 致命而利落

UI_trait_BleederDesc.en:
Wounds bleed excessively, heightening their severity and endangering survival.
[+100% damage from bleeding]
UI_trait_BleederDesc.ch:
傷口出血過量, 使傷勢加重並危及生存.
[流血傷害 +100%%]
UI_trait_BleederDesc.cn:
伤口出血过量, 使伤势加重并危及生存.
[流血伤害 +100%%]

UI_trait_Blunt1Desc.en: Survivor learning basics of long blunt combat
UI_trait_Blunt1Desc.ch: 正在學習長棍戰鬥基礎的倖存者
UI_trait_Blunt1Desc.cn: 正在学习长棍战斗基础的幸存者

UI_trait_Blunt2Desc.en: Skilled in long blunt combat, adept at breaking through obstacles & undead.
UI_trait_Blunt2Desc.ch: 精於長棍戰鬥, 擅長破開障礙與殭屍.
UI_trait_Blunt2Desc.cn: 精于长棍战斗, 擅长破开障碍与僵尸.

UI_trait_Blunt3Desc.en: Powerful fighter wielding long blunt weapons, bulldozes through undead hordes effortlessly.
UI_trait_Blunt3Desc.ch: 揮舞長棍的強力戰士, 能輕鬆推平成群的殭屍.
UI_trait_Blunt3Desc.cn: 挥舞长棍的强力战士, 能轻松推平成群的僵尸.

UI_trait_BookLoverDesc.en: This survivor treasures two well-preserved books, one of the few really rare finds in the apocalypse.
UI_trait_BookLoverDesc.ch: 這名倖存者珍藏著兩本保存良好的書, 是末日中少數真正難得的收穫.
UI_trait_BookLoverDesc.cn: 这名幸存者珍藏着两本保存良好的书, 是末日中少数真正难得的收获.

UI_trait_BrittleBodyDesc.en: Feels like every step is an effort, and every lift a strain.
UI_trait_BrittleBodyDesc.ch: 每走一步都很費力, 每次舉起東西都很吃力.
UI_trait_BrittleBodyDesc.cn: 每走一步都很费力, 每次举起东西都很吃力.

UI_trait_ChronicPainDesc.en:
Constant pain at night plagues this survivor, making their daily life uncomfortable.
Painkillers are crucial.
[Receives random pain levels nightly, ranging from "Pain" to "Severe Pain" (rarely "Agony")]
UI_trait_ChronicPainDesc.ch:
夜裡不斷的疼痛折磨著這名倖存者, 讓日常生活很不好受.
止痛藥至關重要.
[每晚隨機獲得疼痛等級, 從「很痛」到「非常痛」 (偶爾為「痛不欲生」)]
UI_trait_ChronicPainDesc.cn:
夜里不断的疼痛折磨着这名幸存者, 让日常生活很不好受.
止痛药至关重要.
[每晚随机获得疼痛等级, 从“很痛”到“非常痛” (偶尔为“痛不欲生”)]

UI_trait_CoffeeLoverDesc.en:
Treasures a rare find: a pack of premium coffee.
A precious commodity in the apocalypse.
UI_trait_CoffeeLoverDesc.ch:
珍藏著一項難得的收穫: 一包高級咖啡.
在末日中是珍貴的商品.
UI_trait_CoffeeLoverDesc.cn:
珍藏着一项难得的收获: 一包高级咖啡.
在末日中是珍贵的商品.

UI_trait_ComicGeekDesc.en: True comic lover at heart, treasures two well-preserved exemplars.
UI_trait_ComicGeekDesc.ch: 骨子裡的真正漫畫迷, 珍藏著兩本保存良好的樣本.
UI_trait_ComicGeekDesc.cn: 骨子里的真正漫画迷, 珍藏着两本保存良好的样本.

UI_trait_CommSpecialistDesc.en:
Highly skilled in operation, crafting & maintenance of communication devices.
Proficient at establishing contact and surveilling frequencies.
UI_trait_CommSpecialistDesc.ch:
精通通訊裝置的操作、製作與維護.
擅長建立聯絡管道並監聽頻率.
UI_trait_CommSpecialistDesc.cn:
精通通讯设备的操作、制作与维护.
擅长建立联络管道并监听频率.

UI_trait_Cook3Desc.en: Knows recipes from pre fall & how to decently fry a fresh rat
UI_trait_Cook3Desc.ch: 熟知末日前的食譜, 也懂得怎麼把新鮮老鼠煎得像樣
UI_trait_Cook3Desc.cn: 熟知末日前的食谱, 也懂得怎么把新鲜老鼠煎得像样

UI_trait_Cooking1Desc.en:
Skilled at making meals that won't kill you.... instantly.
Consider it a culinary survival test.
UI_trait_Cooking1Desc.ch:
擅長做出不會…立刻害死你的餐點.
就當作是一場料理生存測驗吧.
UI_trait_Cooking1Desc.cn:
擅长做出不会…立刻害死你的餐点.
就当作是一场料理生存测验吧.

UI_trait_DislikesHeavyLoadDesc.en:
Carrying too much makes this survivor gradually stressed.
[+Stress if over 80% of the max carry capacity]
UI_trait_DislikesHeavyLoadDesc.ch:
背負太多會讓這名倖存者逐漸感到壓力.
[負重超過上限的 80%% 時增加壓力]
UI_trait_DislikesHeavyLoadDesc.cn:
背负太多会让这名幸存者逐渐感到压力.
[负重超过上限的 80%% 时增加压力]

UI_trait_DrunkenMasterDesc.en:
Survivor who uses intoxication to enhance combat.
However each undead defeated brings them closer to sobriety.
[+25% DMG while being drunk]
UI_trait_DrunkenMasterDesc.ch:
靠醉意提升戰力的倖存者.
但每擊倒一個殭屍, 就離清醒更近一步.
[醉酒時傷害 +25%%]
UI_trait_DrunkenMasterDesc.cn:
靠醉意提升战力的幸存者.
但每击倒一个僵尸, 就离清醒更近一步.
[醉酒时伤害 +25%%]

UI_trait_Elect1Desc.en: Has basic knowledge of electrical systems.
UI_trait_Elect1Desc.ch: 具備電力系統的基礎知識.
UI_trait_Elect1Desc.cn: 具备电力系统的基础知识.

UI_trait_Elect2Desc.en:
Intermediate skill in electrical systems
Proficient in repairing complex circuits & electrical devices.
UI_trait_Elect2Desc.ch:
具備中階的電力系統技能
擅長修復複雜電路與電器裝置.
UI_trait_Elect2Desc.cn:
具备中级的电力系统技能
擅长修复复杂电路与电器设备.

UI_trait_EngineBuilderDesc.en:
Highly skilled mechanic.
Knows the maintenance & repair of all vehicle models.
UI_trait_EngineBuilderDesc.ch:
技術高超的技工.
熟悉所有車型的維護與維修.
UI_trait_EngineBuilderDesc.cn:
技术高超的技工.
熟悉所有车型的维护与维修.

UI_trait_Farm2Desc.en:
Highly advanced understanding of crop cultivation
Knowledgeable in diverse crops & their specific needs for optimal growth.
UI_trait_Farm2Desc.ch:
對作物栽培有極為深入的理解
熟知各類作物及其達到最佳生長所需的條件.
UI_trait_Farm2Desc.cn:
对作物栽培有极为深入的理解
熟知各类作物及其达到最佳生长所需的条件.

UI_trait_Farm3Desc.en:
Advanced understanding of crop cultivation
Knowledgeable in diverse crops & their specific needs for optimal growth.
UI_trait_Farm3Desc.ch:
對作物栽培有深入的理解
熟知各類作物及其達到最佳生長所需的條件.
UI_trait_Farm3Desc.cn:
对作物栽培有深入的理解
熟知各类作物及其达到最佳生长所需的条件.

UI_trait_FieldMedicDesc.en:
Veteran in emergency care, very experienced in diagnosing & treating injuries & illnesses.
Adept at using whatever's on hand to provide effective medical aid in the field.
UI_trait_FieldMedicDesc.ch:
急救領域的老手, 在診斷與治療傷病方面經驗豐富.
擅長就地取材, 在野外提供有效的醫療協助.
UI_trait_FieldMedicDesc.cn:
急救领域的老手, 在诊断与治疗伤病方面经验丰富.
擅长就地取材, 在野外提供有效的医疗协助.

UI_trait_Fishing2Desc.en:
Survivor with advanced fishing proficiency.
Adept at catching a variety of fish with specialized techniques & equipment.
UI_trait_Fishing2Desc.ch:
釣魚造詣進階的倖存者.
擅長運用專門的技巧與裝備捕獲各種魚類.
UI_trait_Fishing2Desc.cn:
钓鱼造诣进阶的幸存者.
擅长运用专门的技巧与装备捕获各种鱼类.

UI_trait_FlexTaperDesc.en: Knows how to create the ultimate Flex Tape.
UI_trait_FlexTaperDesc.ch: 懂得如何製作終極萬能膠帶.
UI_trait_FlexTaperDesc.cn: 懂得如何制作终极万能胶带.

UI_trait_Forage1Desc.en: Keen observer of the natural world.

UI_trait_Forage2Desc.en: Experienced in navigating diverse terrains and environments.
UI_trait_Forage2Desc.ch: 在各種地形與環境中行進的經驗豐富.
UI_trait_Forage2Desc.cn: 在各种地形与环境中行进的经验丰富.

UI_trait_Forage3Desc.en:
Master of finding ressources in the wild
Posses highly advanced knowledge of flora & fauna, able to sustain themselves within the wilderness.
UI_trait_Forage3Desc.ch:
在野外尋找資源的大師
擁有極為深厚的動植物知識, 能在荒野中自給自足.
UI_trait_Forage3Desc.cn:
在野外寻找资源的大师
拥有极为深厚的动植物知识, 能在荒野中自给自足.

UI_trait_FrogFriendDesc.en: Welcomes a trusty frog friend into your company, providing companionship as you traverse the world.
UI_trait_FrogFriendDesc.ch: 讓一隻可靠的青蛙朋友加入你的隊伍, 在你行走世界時作伴.
UI_trait_FrogFriendDesc.cn: 让一只可靠的青蛙朋友加入你的队伍, 在你行走世界时作伴.

UI_trait_GuardsmenDesc.en:
Hardened survivor.
Skilled in perimeter defending against both undead & living threats.
UI_trait_GuardsmenDesc.ch:
久經磨練的倖存者.
擅長防守周界, 抵禦殭屍與活人的威脅.
UI_trait_GuardsmenDesc.cn:
久经磨练的幸存者.
擅长防守周界, 抵御僵尸与活人的威胁.

UI_trait_Hoat_CouchPotatoDesc.en:
Always lazy and weak, this survivor has spent more time on the couch than anywhere else.
How they survived this long is anyone's guess.
UI_trait_Hoat_CouchPotatoDesc.ch:
這名倖存者一向懶散又虛弱, 待在沙發上的時間比在任何地方都久.
他能撐到現在, 誰也說不上來.
UI_trait_Hoat_CouchPotatoDesc.cn:
这名幸存者一向懒散又虚弱, 待在沙发上的时间比在任何地方都久.
他能撑到现在, 谁也说不上来.

UI_trait_InsectHunterDesc.en:
An uncanny knack for spotting insects, this survivor can find bugs where others see none.
Increased chances of finding insects in the wilderness.
[+30% foraging bonus for insects & fishbait]
UI_trait_InsectHunterDesc.ch:
這名倖存者有著發現昆蟲的驚人本事, 別人看不到蟲的地方他都找得到.
在野外找到昆蟲的機率提高.
[搜尋昆蟲與魚餌時 +30%% 加成]
UI_trait_InsectHunterDesc.cn:
这名幸存者有着发现昆虫的惊人本事, 别人看不到虫的地方他都找得到.
在野外找到昆虫的几率提高.
[搜寻昆虫与鱼饵时 +30%% 加成]

UI_trait_KillerEcstasyDesc.en:
Every kill fills you with a rush of excitement, boosting happiness & lowering your boredom.
However, the intense thrill makes you sweat more than usual.
UI_trait_KillerEcstasyDesc.ch:
每次擊殺都讓你興奮不已, 提升幸福感並降低無聊.
但強烈的快感也讓你比平常更容易流汗.
UI_trait_KillerEcstasyDesc.cn:
每次击杀都让你兴奋不已, 提升幸福感并降低无聊.
但强烈的快感也让你比平常更容易流汗.

UI_trait_LifterDesc.en:
Comfortable carrying more than most, this survivor sees every additional load as training.
Increased maximum carrying capacity.
[27kg at max strength]
UI_trait_LifterDesc.ch:
這名倖存者比多數人都能扛, 把每次加重都當成訓練.
提高負重上限.
[力量滿級時為 27 公斤]
UI_trait_LifterDesc.cn:
这名幸存者比多数人都能扛, 把每次加重都当成训练.
提高负重上限.
[力量满级时为 27 公斤]

UI_trait_LightLoadLoverDesc.en:
This survivor finds happiness and stress relief when carrying a light load, preferring agility and freedom over heavy burdens.
[+Stress relief & happiness if under 30% of the max carry capacity]
UI_trait_LightLoadLoverDesc.ch:
這名倖存者輕裝時會感到快樂與放鬆, 偏好敏捷與自由勝過沉重的負擔.
[負重低於上限的 30%% 時緩解壓力並提升幸福感]
UI_trait_LightLoadLoverDesc.cn:
这名幸存者轻装时会感到快乐与放松, 偏好敏捷与自由胜过沉重的负担.
[负重低于上限的 30%% 时缓解压力并提升幸福感]

UI_trait_LightweightTravelerDesc.en:
Uncomfortable with carrying too much, this survivor shies away from excessive loads.
Reduced maximum carrying capacity.
[15kg at max strength]
UI_trait_LightweightTravelerDesc.ch:
這名倖存者不習慣背負太多, 會避開過重的負擔.
降低負重上限.
[力量滿級時為 15 公斤]
UI_trait_LightweightTravelerDesc.cn:
这名幸存者不习惯背负太多, 会避开过重的负担.
降低负重上限.
[力量满级时为 15 公斤]

UI_trait_LittleBuddyDesc.en:
This survivor is never without their beloved Spiffo doll, their closest companion in a harsh world.
Losing Spiffo would be the most awful thing that could happen to this survivor.
[Small boost to stress, boredom, and unhappiness when Spiffo is in inventory, but don't you dare lose Spiffo...You will regret it]
UI_trait_LittleBuddyDesc.ch:
這名倖存者身邊總是帶著心愛的斯皮福玩偶, 那是他在殘酷世界中最親密的夥伴.
失去斯皮福會是他遇過最糟糕的事.
[斯皮福在物品欄中時, 壓力、無聊與不快樂會小幅改善, 但千萬別弄丟斯皮福…你會後悔的]
UI_trait_LittleBuddyDesc.cn:
这名幸存者身边总是带着心爱的斯皮福玩偶, 那是他在残酷世界中最亲密的伙伴.
失去斯皮福会是他遇过最糟糕的事.
[斯皮福在物品栏中时, 压力、无聊与不快乐会小幅改善, 但千万别弄丢斯皮福…你会后悔的]

UI_trait_LumberjackDesc.en:
An expert in timber harvesting and preparing wood.
Skilled in felling trees, the undead and the living.
UI_trait_LumberjackDesc.ch:
採伐木材與處理木料的專家.
擅長放倒樹木, 也擅長放倒殭屍與活人.
UI_trait_LumberjackDesc.cn:
采伐木材与处理木料的专家.
擅长放倒树木, 也擅长放倒僵尸与活人.

UI_trait_Maint1Desc.en: Knowledge of basic usage of glue & duct tape.
UI_trait_Maint1Desc.ch: 瞭解膠水與大力膠帶的基本用法.
UI_trait_Maint1Desc.cn: 了解胶水与管道胶带的基本用法.

UI_trait_Maint2Desc.en: Knowledge of advanced equipment repairs & basic optimization.
UI_trait_Maint2Desc.ch: 瞭解進階裝備修理與基礎優化的知識.
UI_trait_Maint2Desc.cn: 了解进阶装备修理与基础优化的知识.

UI_trait_Mechanics3Desc.ch: 具備車輛維修的進階知識
UI_trait_Mechanics3Desc.cn: 具备车辆维修的进阶知识

UI_trait_Mechanics4Desc.en:
Specialist in automotive machinery.
Highly skilled in building & maintaining vehicle systems if provided reference material.
UI_trait_Mechanics4Desc.ch:
汽車機械的專家.
只要有參考資料, 就能出色地組裝與維護車輛系統.
UI_trait_Mechanics4Desc.cn:
汽车机械的专家.
只要有参考资料, 就能出色地组装与维护车辆系统.

UI_trait_Medic2Desc.en:
Proficient in basic medical care
Skilled in treating injuries, illnesses, & first aid.
UI_trait_Medic2Desc.ch:
精通基礎醫療照護
擅長處理外傷, 疾病與急救.
UI_trait_Medic2Desc.cn:
精通基础医疗护理
擅长处理外伤, 疾病与急救.

UI_trait_Medic3Desc.en:
Expert in comprehensive medical care.
Highly skilled in diagnosing & treating injuries, illnesses & conditions effectively.
UI_trait_Medic3Desc.ch:
全面醫療照護的行家.
能高效地診斷與治療外傷, 疾病與各種病症.
UI_trait_Medic3Desc.cn:
全面医疗护理的行家.
能高效地诊断与治疗外伤, 疾病与各种病症.

UI_trait_Metal2Desc.en:
Advanced skill in metalworking.
Proficient in shaping, joining & repairing metal.
UI_trait_Metal2Desc.ch:
具備進階的金工技術.
精通金屬的塑形, 接合與修復.
UI_trait_Metal2Desc.cn:
具备进阶的金工技术.
精通金属的塑形, 接合与修复.

UI_trait_Metal3Desc.en:
Expert in metalworking techniques.
Highly skilled in forging & fabricating intricate metal structures using advanced welding methods.
UI_trait_Metal3Desc.ch:
金工技藝的行家.
能運用進階焊接手法, 鍛造與製作精密的金屬結構.
UI_trait_Metal3Desc.cn:
金工技艺的行家.
能运用进阶焊接手法, 锻造与制作精密的金属结构.

UI_trait_MushroomGathererDesc.en:
Survivor with a keen eye for spotting fungi.
However, they lack knowledge of whether the mushrooms they find are edible or poisonous.
[+30% foraging bonus to mushrooms]
UI_trait_MushroomGathererDesc.ch:
對真菌有敏銳眼光的倖存者.
不過, 他無法分辨找到的蘑菇是可食用還是有毒.
[搜尋蘑菇加成 +30%%]
UI_trait_MushroomGathererDesc.cn:
对真菌有敏锐眼光的幸存者.
不过, 他无法分辨找到的蘑菇是可食用还是有毒.
[搜寻蘑菇加成 +30%%]

UI_trait_NudistDesc.en:
Prefers the freedom of no clothing. Increases happiness when unclothed but causes discomfort when wearing clothes.
[Backpacks, shoes, watches, and all "Accessory" type items do not count as clothing]
UI_trait_NudistDesc.ch:
偏好不穿衣物的自由. 赤身時提升快樂, 穿上衣物則會感到不適.
[背包, 鞋子, 手錶以及所有「配件」類物品不算衣物]
UI_trait_NudistDesc.cn:
偏好不穿衣物的自由. 赤身时提升快乐, 穿上衣物则会感到不适.
[背包, 鞋子, 手表以及所有“配件”类物品不算衣物]

UI_trait_PeacefulDesc.en:
Each zombie kill brings a wave of unease, making you unhappier & more stressed.
What if there are alive and just trapped inside their minds?
UI_trait_PeacefulDesc.ch:
每殺死一隻殭屍都會湧上一陣不安, 讓你更不快樂, 壓力也更大.
萬一牠們其實還活著, 只是被困在自己的意識裡呢?
UI_trait_PeacefulDesc.cn:
每杀死一只僵尸都会涌上一阵不安, 让你更不快乐, 压力也更大.
万一它们其实还活着, 只是被困在自己的意识里呢?

UI_trait_QuietMovementDesc.ch: 習慣悄悄移動的倖存者.
UI_trait_QuietMovementDesc.cn: 习惯悄悄移动的幸存者.

UI_trait_RancherDesc.en:
Knows the rhythm of life and death on the farm.
Proficient in tending livestock and processing them for essential supplies in harsh times.
UI_trait_RancherDesc.ch:
深諳農場上生與死的節奏.
擅長照料牲畜, 並在艱困時期將牠們處理成必需物資.
UI_trait_RancherDesc.cn:
深谙农场上生与死的节奏.
擅长照料牲畜, 并在艰难时期将它们处理成必需物资.

UI_trait_Reload1Desc.ch: 具備槍械裝填的基本知識.
UI_trait_Reload1Desc.cn: 具备枪械装填的基本知识.

UI_trait_Reload2Desc.en:
Experienced survivor in firearm reloading.
Proficient at quicker & smoother reloads under pressure.
UI_trait_Reload2Desc.ch:
在槍械裝填上經驗豐富的倖存者.
能在壓力下更快, 更順暢地完成裝填.
UI_trait_Reload2Desc.cn:
在枪械装填上经验丰富的幸存者.
能在压力下更快, 更顺畅地完成装填.

UI_trait_Reload3Desc.en:
Highly proficient in firearm reloading.
Executes lightning-fast reloads, minimizing downtime in combat.
UI_trait_Reload3Desc.ch:
極為精通槍械裝填.
能以閃電般的速度完成裝填, 將戰鬥中的空檔壓到最低.
UI_trait_Reload3Desc.cn:
极为精通枪械装填.
能以闪电般的速度完成装填, 将战斗中的空档压到最低.

UI_trait_ScrapAnglerDesc.en:
An expert in fishing with a shallow understanding of makeshift metalworking.
Utilizing salvaged materials, they craft and maintain their own fishing gear, transforming scrap into fishing tools.
UI_trait_ScrapAnglerDesc.ch:
釣魚的行家, 對簡易金工也略懂一二.
他利用回收來的材料自製並保養釣具, 把廢料變成漁具.
UI_trait_ScrapAnglerDesc.cn:
钓鱼的行家, 对简易金工也略懂一二.
他利用回收来的材料自制并保养钓具, 把废料变成渔具.

UI_trait_Sew1Desc.ch: 具備中等程度的縫紉技術.
UI_trait_Sew1Desc.cn: 具备中等程度的缝纫技术.

UI_trait_Sew2Desc.en:
Expert in tailoring techniques
Highly skilled in designing and crafting clothing & utilizing advanced sewing skills.
UI_trait_Sew2Desc.ch:
縫紉技藝的行家
擅長設計與製作衣物, 並運用進階的縫紉技巧.
UI_trait_Sew2Desc.cn:
缝纫技艺的行家
擅长设计与制作衣物, 并运用进阶的缝纫技巧.

UI_trait_ShelterBuilderDesc.en:
Mastery in carpentry and construction.
Renowned for crafting sturdy & functional shelters, structures & fortifications.
UI_trait_ShelterBuilderDesc.ch:
精通木工與營建.
以打造堅固實用的庇護所, 建築與防禦工事聞名.
UI_trait_ShelterBuilderDesc.cn:
精通木工与营建.
以打造坚固实用的庇护所, 建筑与防御工事闻名.

UI_trait_ShortBlade1Desc.en: Survivor learning basics of knife combat.
UI_trait_ShortBlade1Desc.ch: 正在學習短刀戰鬥基礎的倖存者.
UI_trait_ShortBlade1Desc.cn: 正在学习短刀战斗基础的幸存者.

UI_trait_ShortBlade2Desc.en: Seasoned warrior skilled in knife combat, adept at silently killing undeads.
UI_trait_ShortBlade2Desc.ch: 精於短刀戰鬥的老練戰士, 擅長無聲擊殺殭屍.
UI_trait_ShortBlade2Desc.cn: 精于短刀战斗的老练战士, 擅长无声击杀僵尸.

UI_trait_ShortBlade3Desc.en:
Masterful fighter wielding knifes.
Strikes with deadly precision, swiftly taking down undead & living foes.
UI_trait_ShortBlade3Desc.ch:
揮舞短刀的大師級鬥士.
出手精準致命, 能迅速擊倒殭屍與活人敵手.
UI_trait_ShortBlade3Desc.cn:
挥舞短刀的大师级斗士.
出手精准致命, 能迅速击倒僵尸与活人敌手.

UI_trait_ShortBlunt1Desc.en: Survivor learning basics of blunt combat.
UI_trait_ShortBlunt1Desc.ch: 正在學習鈍器戰鬥基礎的倖存者.
UI_trait_ShortBlunt1Desc.cn: 正在学习钝器战斗基础的幸存者.

UI_trait_ShortBlunt2Desc.en: Seasoned warrior skilled in blunt combat, adept at taking down obstacles & undead.
UI_trait_ShortBlunt2Desc.ch: 精於鈍器戰鬥的老練戰士, 擅長清除障礙與擊倒殭屍.
UI_trait_ShortBlunt2Desc.cn: 精于钝器战斗的老练战士, 擅长清除障碍与击倒僵尸.

UI_trait_ShortBlunt3Desc.en: Brute force in the field, this fighter wields blunt weapons with unmatched power, smashing through undead hordes with ease.
UI_trait_ShortBlunt3Desc.ch: 戰場上的蠻力化身, 這名鬥士揮動鈍器的力道無人能及, 輕鬆碾碎成群的殭屍.
UI_trait_ShortBlunt3Desc.cn: 战场上的蛮力化身, 这名斗士挥动钝器的力道无人能及, 轻松碾碎成群的僵尸.

UI_trait_ShunnedDesc.en: An outcast among survivors, ostracized for reasons unknown or misunderstood by others.
UI_trait_ShunnedDesc.ch: 倖存者當中的邊緣人, 因不為人知或被誤解的原因遭到排擠.
UI_trait_ShunnedDesc.cn: 幸存者当中的边缘人, 因不为人知或被误解的原因遭到排挤.

UI_trait_SoftWalkerDesc.en: Moves with near silence, making it hard for enemies to detect.
UI_trait_SoftWalkerDesc.ch: 移動時幾乎不發出聲響, 敵人難以察覺.
UI_trait_SoftWalkerDesc.cn: 移动时几乎不发出声响, 敌人难以察觉.

UI_trait_Spear1Desc.en: Survivor learning the art of spear combat.
UI_trait_Spear1Desc.ch: 正在鑽研長矛戰鬥技藝的倖存者.
UI_trait_Spear1Desc.cn: 正在钻研长矛战斗技艺的幸存者.

UI_trait_Spear2Desc.en:
Seasoned warrior skilled in spear combat.
Adept at thrusting through & piercing undead.
UI_trait_Spear2Desc.ch:
精於長矛戰鬥的老練戰士.
擅長以突刺貫穿殭屍.
UI_trait_Spear2Desc.cn:
精于长矛战斗的老练战士.
擅长以突刺贯穿僵尸.

UI_trait_Spear3Desc.en:
Masterful fighter wielding spears.
Perfectly maintains distance, while skewering undead with precision & agility.
UI_trait_Spear3Desc.ch:
揮舞長矛的大師級鬥士.
能完美拿捏距離, 以精準敏捷的身手串起殭屍.
UI_trait_Spear3Desc.cn:
挥舞长矛的大师级斗士.
能完美拿捏距离, 以精准敏捷的身手串起僵尸.

UI_trait_SprinterDesc.en:
Finds joy and relief in sprinting.
[Slowly gains happiness and reduces boredom while sprinting]
UI_trait_SprinterDesc.ch:
從衝刺中獲得快樂與放鬆.
[衝刺時緩慢提升快樂並降低無聊]
UI_trait_SprinterDesc.cn:
从冲刺中获得快乐与放松.
[冲刺时缓慢提升快乐并降低无聊]

UI_trait_StressEaterDesc.en:
Feels hungry whenever stressed, leading to increased food consumption during stressful times.
[Slowly Increases hunger level to "Hungry" when under stress]
UI_trait_StressEaterDesc.ch:
一有壓力就會覺得餓, 導致高壓時期食量大增.
[承受壓力時緩慢將飢餓度提升至「飢餓」]
UI_trait_StressEaterDesc.cn:
一有压力就会觉得饿, 导致高压时期食量大增.
[承受压力时缓慢将饥饿度提升至“很饿”]

UI_trait_ThanathophobicDesc.en:
Intense fear of death causing the survivor constant stress when injured.
[Gains constant stress up to "Agitated" when under 90% HP]
UI_trait_ThanathophobicDesc.ch:
對死亡的強烈恐懼, 使這名倖存者受傷時持續累積壓力.
[生命值低於 90%% 時持續累積壓力, 最高至「非常激動」]
UI_trait_ThanathophobicDesc.cn:
对死亡的强烈恐惧, 使这名幸存者受伤时持续累积压力.
[生命值低于 90%% 时持续累积压力, 最高至“非常激动”]

UI_trait_ThreadSmithDesc.en:
Master of the needle and thread & is known for their unparalleled skill in tailoring.
Very experienced at crafting intricate garments and textile creations.
UI_trait_ThreadSmithDesc.ch:
針線活的大師, 以無與倫比的縫紉技藝聞名.
在製作精緻服飾與紡織品上經驗老到.
UI_trait_ThreadSmithDesc.cn:
针线活的大师, 以无与伦比的缝纫技艺闻名.
在制作精致服饰与纺织品上经验老到.

UI_trait_TrackerDesc.en:
Survivor with special tracking skills, able to read the signs of the wilderness.
Whether it's following the trail of prey or tracking the movements of other survivors, their expertise is highly advanced.
UI_trait_TrackerDesc.ch:
具備特殊追蹤技巧的倖存者, 能讀懂荒野中的種種痕跡.
無論是循著獵物的足跡, 還是追查其他倖存者的行蹤, 他的本事都極為高超.
UI_trait_TrackerDesc.cn:
具备特殊追踪技巧的幸存者, 能读懂荒野中的种种痕迹.
无论是循着猎物的足迹, 还是追查其他幸存者的行踪, 他的本事都极为高超.

UI_trait_TraderDesc.en: Resourceful merchant navigating through dangerous places, seeking profit amidst the chaos.
UI_trait_TraderDesc.ch: 足智多謀的商人, 穿梭於險地之間, 在亂世中尋找商機.
UI_trait_TraderDesc.cn: 足智多谋的商人, 穿梭于险地之间, 在乱世中寻找商机.

UI_trait_TrainedGunmanDesc.en:
Masterful skilled fighter in firearm handling & tactics.
Proficient with various firearms for effective combat against undead & living threats.
UI_trait_TrainedGunmanDesc.ch:
在槍械操作與戰術上技藝精湛的鬥士.
精通各式槍械, 能有效對付殭屍與活人的威脅.
UI_trait_TrainedGunmanDesc.cn:
在枪械操作与战术上技艺精湛的斗士.
精通各式枪械, 能有效对付僵尸与活人的威胁.

UI_trait_Trap1Desc.en: Has basic understanding of traps to catch small game.
UI_trait_Trap1Desc.ch: 對捕捉小型獵物的陷阱有基本的認識.
UI_trait_Trap1Desc.cn: 对捕捉小型猎物的陷阱有基本的认识.

UI_trait_Trap2Desc.en: Proficient in setting snares & simple traps.
UI_trait_Trap2Desc.ch: 精於佈設套索與簡易陷阱.
UI_trait_Trap2Desc.cn: 精于布设套索与简易陷阱.

UI_trait_Trap3Desc.en:
Expert in trapping craft & setup.
Capable of designing & deploying sophisticated traps to catch elusive prey.
UI_trait_Trap3Desc.ch:
誘捕工藝與佈設的行家.
能設計並佈置精巧的陷阱, 捕捉難以捉摸的獵物.
UI_trait_Trap3Desc.cn:
诱捕工艺与布设的行家.
能设计并布置精巧的陷阱, 捕捉难以捉摸的猎物.

UI_trait_VernDesc.en:
Embrace the Vern way!
Vern hates guns and everything that comes with it.
UI_trait_VernDesc.ch:
擁抱維恩之道!
維恩痛恨槍械, 以及與槍有關的一切.
UI_trait_VernDesc.cn:
拥抱维恩之道!
维恩痛恨枪械, 以及与枪有关的一切.

UI_trait_WandererDesc.en: Lone traveler, weaving their own tale in a harsh world teeming with threats.
UI_trait_WandererDesc.ch: 獨行的旅人, 在危機四伏的殘酷世界裡編織自己的故事.
UI_trait_WandererDesc.cn: 独行的旅人, 在危机四伏的残酷世界里编织自己的故事.

UI_trait_WineLoverDesc.en:
Treasures a rare find: a fine bottle of wine & a delicate wine glass.
A really rare commodity in the apocalypse.
UI_trait_WineLoverDesc.ch:
珍藏著難得的收穫: 一瓶好酒與一只精緻的紅酒杯.
在末日中真正稀有的奢侈品.
UI_trait_WineLoverDesc.cn:
珍藏着难得的收获: 一瓶好酒与一只精致的红酒杯.
在末日中真正稀有的奢侈品.

UI_trait_Wood2Desc.en:
Advanced carpentry knowledge.
Proficient in building sturdy structures & furniture.
UI_trait_Wood2Desc.ch:
具備進階的木工知識.
擅長建造堅固的結構與傢俱.
UI_trait_Wood2Desc.cn:
具备进阶的木工知识.
擅长建造坚固的结构与家具.

UI_trait_Wood3Desc.en:
Expert in carpentry
Adept at repurposing salvaged materials to create durable constructions.
UI_trait_Wood3Desc.ch:
木工技藝的行家
擅長把回收材料再利用, 造出耐用的建築.
UI_trait_Wood3Desc.cn:
木工技艺的行家
擅长把回收材料再利用, 造出耐用的建筑.

UI_trait_breathingTechniqueDesc.en:
Survivor who has mastered a special breathing technique, allowing them to recover from exhaustion faster while sitting on the ground.
[+25% endurance recovery bonus while sitting]
UI_trait_breathingTechniqueDesc.ch:
掌握了特殊呼吸法的倖存者, 席地而坐時能更快從疲勞中恢復.
[坐下時耐力恢復加成 +25%%]
UI_trait_breathingTechniqueDesc.cn:
掌握了特殊呼吸法的幸存者, 席地而坐时能更快从疲劳中恢复.
[坐下时耐力恢复加成 +25%%]

UI_trait_tinkerer2Desc.en: The go-to tech guru: adept at repairing gadgets & knows how to craft special explosives.
UI_trait_tinkerer2Desc.ch: 大家公認的技術達人: 擅長修理各種裝置, 也懂得製作特殊爆炸物.
UI_trait_tinkerer2Desc.cn: 大家公认的技术达人: 擅长修理各种装置, 也懂得制作特殊爆炸物.

UI_profdesc_wanderer.ch: 打造屬於你自己的故事
UI_profdesc_wanderer.cn: 打造属于你自己的故事

UI_BF_options_MoodleType.ch: 膀胱 / 腸道狀態圖示類型 (未實作)
UI_BF_options_MoodleType.cn: 膀胱 / 肠道状态图标类型 (未实现)

UI_BF_options_MoodleType_tooltip.en: What you want the bladder / bowel moodle types to be based on.
UI_BF_options_MoodleType_tooltip.ch: 決定膀胱 / 腸道狀態圖示要依據什麼判定.
UI_BF_options_MoodleType_tooltip.cn: 决定膀胱 / 肠道状态图标要依据什么判定.

UI_BodilyFunctionsPanel.en: Bodily functions panel with all detailed values available.
UI_BodilyFunctionsPanel.ch: 生理機能面板, 可檢視所有詳細數值.
UI_BodilyFunctionsPanel.cn: 生理机能面板, 可查看所有详细数值.

UI_trait_zReAntibodiesDesc.en: Your immunity can suppress the zombie virus.
UI_trait_zReAntibodiesDesc.ch: 你的免疫系統能夠壓制殭屍病毒.
UI_trait_zReAntibodiesDesc.cn: 你的免疫系统能够压制僵尸病毒.

UI_BurdJournals_JournalNoLongerAvailable.en: That journal is no longer available here. Open the container again and retry. [BSJ-C03]
UI_BurdJournals_JournalNoLongerAvailable.ch: 這裡已經沒有那本日記了. 請重新開啟容器再試一次. [BSJ-C03]
UI_BurdJournals_JournalNoLongerAvailable.cn: 这里已经没有那本日记了. 请重新打开容器再试一次. [BSJ-C03]

UI_BurdJournals_JournalReturnFailed.en: The journal stayed in your inventory because it could not safely return to its original container. [BSJ-C04]
UI_BurdJournals_JournalReturnFailed.ch: 日記無法安全放回原本的容器, 因此留在你的物品欄中. [BSJ-C04]
UI_BurdJournals_JournalReturnFailed.cn: 日记无法安全放回原本的容器, 因此留在你的物品栏中. [BSJ-C04]

UI_BurdJournals_JournalTransferFailed.en: Could not move the journal into your inventory. Move it manually and try again. [BSJ-C01]
UI_BurdJournals_JournalTransferFailed.ch: 無法將日記移入你的物品欄. 請手動搬移後再試一次. [BSJ-C01]
UI_BurdJournals_JournalTransferFailed.cn: 无法将日记移入你的物品栏. 请手动移动后再试一次. [BSJ-C01]

UI_BurdJournals_JournalTransferPending.en: That journal is already being moved into your inventory. Please wait. [BSJ-C02]
UI_BurdJournals_JournalTransferPending.ch: 該日記正在移入你的物品欄, 請稍候. [BSJ-C02]
UI_BurdJournals_JournalTransferPending.cn: 该日记正在移入你的物品栏, 请稍候. [BSJ-C02]

UI_BurdJournals_RecordNoChangesAlreadyRe.en: Nothing recorded: this journal already has that progress.
UI_BurdJournals_RecordNoChangesAlreadyRe.ch: 未記錄任何內容: 這本日記已經有該進度了.
UI_BurdJournals_RecordNoChangesAlreadyRe.cn: 未记录任何内容: 这本日记已经有该进度了.

UI_BurdJournals_RecordNoChangesNoEligibl.en: Nothing recorded: the server found no eligible entries.
UI_BurdJournals_RecordNoChangesNoEligibl.ch: 未記錄任何內容: 伺服器找不到符合條件的條目.
UI_BurdJournals_RecordNoChangesNoEligibl.cn: 未记录任何内容: 服务器找不到符合条件的条目.

UI_BurdJournals_RecordNoChangesNoEntries.en: Nothing recorded: no entries reached the server.
UI_BurdJournals_RecordNoChangesNoEntries.ch: 未記錄任何內容: 沒有任何條目送達伺服器.
UI_BurdJournals_RecordNoChangesNoEntries.cn: 未记录任何内容: 没有任何条目送达服务器.

UI_BurdJournals_RecordNoChangesStartingP.en: Nothing recorded: the server considers this starting progress.
UI_BurdJournals_RecordNoChangesStartingP.ch: 未記錄任何內容: 伺服器認定這是初始進度.
UI_BurdJournals_RecordNoChangesStartingP.cn: 未记录任何内容: 服务器认定这是初始进度.

RM_777a5d02-d3cc-46b7-9697-996034d6ca9e.cn: 好了! 大部分的工作都完成了, 现在只需要一点耐心!

RM_7b901f5b-71cb-4762-a338-2d0ac4d54f25.cn: 让热水慢慢冲泡出我们的咖啡!

RM_909bad9d-b7ff-42d5-b60c-1857be5598b9.cn: VHS: Sapph 的烹饪秀 EP1 (咖啡)

RM_94f3b733-566e-4c5e-ae09-e23f9ac8f171.ch: 希望大家喜歡 - 我們下次見~[img=music]
RM_94f3b733-566e-4c5e-ae09-e23f9ac8f171.cn: 希望大家喜欢 - 我们下次见~[img=music]

RM_96e0f364-6b24-46fb-bc60-fd955249c5cc.cn: 接着 - 拿一些咖啡豆, 像这样用研磨机磨碎!

RM_d5c8295d-d935-4729-b8a8-a6e5d8f2bc6e.en: and... There! Now, we just need some paper or cloth filters.
RM_d5c8295d-d935-4729-b8a8-a6e5d8f2bc6e.ch: …好了! 現在, 我們只需要一些濾紙或濾布.
RM_d5c8295d-d935-4729-b8a8-a6e5d8f2bc6e.cn: …好了! 现在, 我们只需要一些滤纸或滤布.
